title.zh: 卷115 志九十 职官二
title.raw: 卷115 志九十 职官二

sentences.zh: 志九十

translations.literal: Treatise 90.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 90.

sentences.zh: 職官二

translations.literal: Officials, Part Two.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, Part Two.

sentences.zh: 理籓院都察院五城兵馬司六科給事中通政使司大理寺翰林院文淵閣

translations.literal: Court of Colonial Affairs, Censorate, Five-City Garrison Command, Six Offices reviewing censors, Office of Transmission, Court of Judicial Review, Hanlin Academy, Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Court of Colonial Affairs; Censorate; Five-City Garrison Command; Six Offices reviewing censors; Office of Transmission; Court of Judicial Review; Hanlin Academy; Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 國史館經筵講官起居注詹事府太常寺太僕寺光祿寺鴻臚寺

translations.literal: State Historiography Institute, Classics Mat lecturers, diarists of imperial actions, Household of the Heir Apparent, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Court of the Imperial Stud, Court of Imperial Entertainments, Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: State Historiography Institute; Classics Mat lecturers; diarists of the emperor's actions; Household of the Heir Apparent; Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Court of the Imperial Stud; Court of Imperial Entertainments; Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 國子監衍聖公五經博士欽天監太醫院壇廟官陵寢官僧道錄司

translations.literal: Directorate of Education, Duke Yansheng, erudites of the Five Classics, Imperial Observatory, Imperial Medical Academy, altar and temple officials, mausoleum officials, Buddhist and Taoist Registry.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Education; Duke Yansheng; erudites of the Five Classics; Imperial Observatory; Imperial Medical Academy; altar and temple officials; mausoleum officials; Buddhist and Taoist Registry.

sentences.zh: 理籓院管理院務大臣，滿洲一人。

translations.literal: Court of Colonial Affairs: one supervising minister of court affairs, a Manchu.
translations.idiomatic: At the Court of Colonial Affairs there was one supervising minister of court affairs, always a Manchu.

sentences.zh: 特簡大學士為之。

translations.literal: A grand secretary was specially selected for the post.
translations.idiomatic: A grand secretary was specially appointed to the office.

sentences.zh: 尚書，左、右侍郎，俱各滿洲一人。

translations.literal: Minister and left and right vice ministers, each one a Manchu.
translations.idiomatic: The minister and the left and right vice ministers were each a Manchu.

sentences.zh: 間亦有蒙古人為之。

translations.literal: Occasionally Mongols also held these posts.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols were occasionally appointed to these offices as well.

sentences.zh: 額外侍郎一人。

translations.literal: One additional vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: There was one additional vice minister.

sentences.zh: 以蒙古貝勒、貝子之賢能者任之。

translations.literal: An able Mongol prince or beile was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: The post was filled by an able Mongol beile or beizi.

sentences.zh: 其屬：堂主事，滿檔房滿洲二人、蒙古三人，漢檔房漢軍一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: chancery clerks—in the Manchu archive, two Manchus and three Mongols; in the Chinese archive, one Chinese Bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates were chancery clerks: in the Manchu archive, two Manchus and three Mongols; in the Chinese archive, one Chinese Bannerman.

sentences.zh: 領辦處，員外郎、主事，滿、蒙各一人。

translations.literal: General Affairs Office: one vice director and one section chief, one Manchu and one Mongol each.
translations.idiomatic: The General Affairs Office had one vice director and one section chief, one Manchu and one Mongol apiece.

sentences.zh: 司務□司務，滿、蒙各一人。

translations.literal: Registrars ([character missing] registrars), one Manchu and one Mongol each.
translations.idiomatic: Two registrar posts (a character is missing in the source), one Manchu and one Mongol each.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲三十有六人，蒙古五十有五人，漢軍六人。

translations.literal: Clerks: thirty-six Manchus, fifty-five Mongols, six Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks numbered thirty-six Manchus, fifty-five Mongols, and six Chinese Bannermen.

sentences.zh: 旗籍、王會、柔遠、典屬、理刑、徠遠六清吏司：郎中，宗室一人，柔遠司置。

translations.literal: Six Qing-clerk departments—Banner Registers, Princely Audiences, Pacification of the Distant, Outer Dependencies, Mongol Law, and Reception of the Distant: directors—one imperial clansman, established in the Pacification of the Distant Department.
translations.idiomatic: The six Qing-clerk departments—Banner Registers, Princely Audiences, Pacification of the Distant, Outer Dependencies, Mongol Law, and Reception of the Distant—had directors; one was an imperial clansman, a post established in the Pacification of the Distant Department.

sentences.zh: 滿洲三人，旗籍、王會、典屬司各一人。

translations.literal: Three Manchus, one each in the Banner Registers, Princely Audiences, and Outer Dependencies departments.
translations.idiomatic: Three were Manchus, one apiece in the Banner Registers, Princely Audiences, and Outer Dependencies departments.

sentences.zh: 蒙古八人。

translations.literal: Eight Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Eight were Mongols.

sentences.zh: 旗籍、王會、理刑司各二人。

translations.literal: Two each in the Banner Registers, Princely Audiences, and Mongol Law departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Banner Registers, Princely Audiences, and Mongol Law departments had two each.

sentences.zh: 典屬、徠遠司各一人。

translations.literal: One each in the Outer Dependencies and Reception of the Distant departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Outer Dependencies and Reception of the Distant departments had one each.

sentences.zh: 員外郎，宗室一人，旗籍司置。

translations.literal: Vice directors: one imperial clansman, established in the Banner Registers Department.
translations.idiomatic: Among the vice directors was one imperial clansman, a post established in the Banner Registers Department.

sentences.zh: 滿洲十人，王會、柔遠、典屬、理刑司各二人。

translations.literal: Ten Manchus, two each in the Princely Audiences, Pacification of the Distant, Outer Dependencies, and Mongol Law departments.
translations.idiomatic: Ten were Manchus, with two apiece in the Princely Audiences, Pacification of the Distant, Outer Dependencies, and Mongol Law departments.

sentences.zh: 旗籍、徠遠司各一人。

translations.literal: One each in the Banner Registers and Reception of the Distant departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Banner Registers and Reception of the Distant departments had one each.

sentences.zh: 蒙古二十有四人。

translations.literal: Twenty-four Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four were Mongols.

sentences.zh: 旗籍二人，王會三人，柔遠五人，典屬六人，理刑、徠遠司各一人。

translations.literal: Banner Registers two, Princely Audiences three, Pacification of the Distant five, Outer Dependencies six, Mongol Law and Reception of the Distant one each.
translations.idiomatic: They were distributed as follows: Banner Registers, two; Princely Audiences, three; Pacification of the Distant, five; Outer Dependencies, six; Mongol Law and Reception of the Distant, one each.

sentences.zh: 主事，滿洲二人，旗籍、典屬司各一人。

translations.literal: Section chiefs: two Manchus, one each in the Banner Registers and Outer Dependencies departments.
translations.idiomatic: Section chiefs numbered two Manchus and one each in the Banner Registers and Outer Dependencies departments.

sentences.zh: 蒙古七人。

translations.literal: Seven Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Seven were Mongols.

sentences.zh: 柔遠、典屬、理刑司各一人。

translations.literal: One each in the Pacification of the Distant, Outer Dependencies, and Mongol Law departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification of the Distant, Outer Dependencies, and Mongol Law departments had one each.

sentences.zh: 王會、徠遠司各二人。

translations.literal: Two each in the Princely Audiences and Reception of the Distant departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Princely Audiences and Reception of the Distant departments had two each.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲三十有六人，蒙古五十有五人，漢軍六人。

translations.literal: Clerks: thirty-six Manchus, fifty-five Mongols, six Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks numbered thirty-six Manchus, fifty-five Mongols, and six Chinese Bannermen.

sentences.zh: 銀庫，司官二人，司官內奏委。

translations.literal: Silver Treasury: two department officials, appointed by memorial from among department officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Silver Treasury had two department officials, appointed by memorial from among the court's officials.

sentences.zh: 司庫一人，正七品。

translations.literal: One treasury keeper, rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: There was one treasury keeper of the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 庫使、筆帖式各二人。

translations.literal: Two treasury assistants and two clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There were two treasury assistants and two clerks.

sentences.zh: 以上俱滿洲缺。

translations.literal: All of the above were Manchu posts.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above posts were reserved for Manchus.

sentences.zh: 尚書掌內外籓蒙古、回部及諸番部，制爵祿，定朝會，正刑罰，控馭撫綏，以固邦翰。

translations.literal: The minister supervised inner and outer Mongol banners, Muslim regions, and various frontier peoples; regulated titles and stipends; fixed court audiences; corrected punishments; controlled, guided, and pacified them to secure the state's bulwarks.
translations.idiomatic: The minister oversaw inner and outer Mongol banners, Muslim communities, and other frontier peoples; regulated titles and stipends; set rules for court audiences; adjudicated punishments; and controlled, guided, and pacified them to strengthen the dynasty's frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 侍郎貳之。

translations.literal: The vice ministers assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The vice ministers assisted him.

sentences.zh: 旗籍掌考內扎薩克疆裡，大漠以南曰內蒙古，部二十有四：曰科爾沁，曰扎賚特，曰杜爾伯特，曰郭爾羅斯，曰敖漢，曰奈曼，曰巴林，曰扎魯特，曰阿魯科爾沁，曰翁牛特，曰克什克騰，曰喀爾喀左翼，曰喀喇沁，曰土默特，曰烏珠穆沁，曰浩齊特，曰蘇尼特，曰阿巴噶，曰阿巴哈納爾，曰四子部落，曰茂明安，曰烏喇特，曰喀爾喀右翼，曰鄂爾多斯，為旗四十有九。

translations.literal: Banner Registers kept records of inner jasak territories; south of the Great Desert was called Inner Mongolia, with twenty-four leagues: Khorchin, Jasagt, Dorbed, Gorlos, Aohan, Naiman, Bairin, Jarud, Ar Khorchin, Ujimud, Keshiketeng, Khalkha Left Wing, Kharchin, Tumed, Ujimchin, Khoit, Sunid, Abag, Abaganar, Dörben Jasaq, Muminggan, Urad, Khalkha Right Wing, and Ordos—forty-nine banners in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Banner Registers department maintained registers of inner jasak domains. The region south of the Gobi was called Inner Mongolia. It comprised twenty-four leagues—Khorchin, Jasagt, Dorbed, Gorlos, Aohan, Naiman, Bairin, Jarud, Ar Khorchin, Ujimud, Keshiketeng, Khalkha Left Wing, Kharchin, Tumed, Ujimchin, Khoit, Sunid, Abag, Abaganar, Dörben Jasaq, Muminggan, Urad, Khalkha Right Wing, and Ordos—organized into forty-nine banners.

sentences.zh: 疇封爵，凡六等：一親王，二郡王，三貝勒，四貝子，五鎮國公，六輔國公。

translations.literal: Titles were conferred in six grades: first, prince of the first rank; second, prince of the second rank; third, beile; fourth, beizi; fifth, duke who stabilizes the state; sixth, duke who assists the state.
translations.idiomatic: Titles were conferred in six grades: prince of the first rank, prince of the second rank, beile, beizi, duke who stabilizes the state, and duke who assists the state.

sentences.zh: 不入六等者，曰台吉、塔布囊，亦分四等。

translations.literal: Those outside the six grades were called taiji and tabunang, also divided into four grades.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks outside the six grades were taiji and tabunang, likewise divided into four grades.

sentences.zh: 辨譜系。

translations.literal: It distinguished genealogies.
translations.idiomatic: It verified genealogical lines.

sentences.zh: 凡官屬、扎薩克之輔曰協理台吉。

translations.literal: Among officials, the jasak's assistant was called the assisting taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Among their officials, the jasak's deputy was called the assisting taiji.

sentences.zh: 其屬曰管旗章京，曰副章京，曰參領，曰佐領，曰驍騎校。

translations.literal: Subordinates were called banner-managing zhangjing, deputy zhangjing, company commander, assistant company commander, and captain.
translations.idiomatic: Their subordinates included the banner-managing zhangjing, deputy zhangjing, company commander, assistant company commander, and captain.

sentences.zh: 部眾會盟、盟地六：曰哲裡木，曰卓索圖，曰昭烏達，曰錫林郭勒，曰烏爾察布，曰伊克昭。

translations.literal: League assemblies of the tribes met at six league grounds: Jirem, Josotu, Juu Uda, Xilin Gol, Ulaanchab, and Ike Juu.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal leagues assembled at six league grounds: Jirem, Josotu, Juu Uda, Xilin Gol, Ulaanchab, and Ike Juu.

sentences.zh: 置盟長、副盟長各一人，由扎薩克請簡。

translations.literal: One league chief and one deputy league chief were established, selected at the jasaks' request.
translations.idiomatic: Each league had one chief and one deputy chief, nominated by the jasaks for appointment.

sentences.zh: 軍旅郵傳，並隸治之；

translations.literal: Military affairs and postal relays were also under its jurisdiction;
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs and courier routes also fell under its jurisdiction;

sentences.zh: 兼稽遊牧內屬者。

translations.literal: it also supervised affiliated nomadic groups.
translations.idiomatic: and it also oversaw affiliated nomadic peoples.

sentences.zh: 凡歸化城土默特、黑龍江布特哈皆是。

translations.literal: All such as the Tumed of Guihua City and the Butha of Heilongjiang were included.
translations.idiomatic: These included the Tumed of Guihua City and the Butha of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 王會掌內扎薩克賓禮，典朝覲、貢獻儀式。

translations.literal: Princely Audiences managed guest ritual for inner jasaks and regulated audience and tribute ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: The Princely Audiences department managed guest protocol for inner jasaks and regulated ceremonies for court audiences and tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 凡饗賚、館餼，視等級以為差。

translations.literal: Banquets, gifts, and lodging provisions varied according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Banquets, gifts, and lodging were scaled according to rank.

sentences.zh: 典屬掌外扎薩克部旗封爵，大漠以北曰外蒙古，部四：曰土謝圖汗，曰賽音諾顏，曰車臣汗，曰扎薩克圖汗，為旗八十有六。

translations.literal: Outer Dependencies managed titles and banners of outer jasaks; north of the Great Desert was called Outer Mongolia, with four leagues: Tüsheet Khan, Sayin Noyan, Chingün, and Jasagtu Khan—eighty-six banners in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Outer Dependencies department managed titles and banners for outer jasaks. North of the Gobi was Outer Mongolia, comprising four Khalkha leagues—Tüsheet Khan, Sayin Noyan, Chingün, and Jasagtu Khan—with eighty-six banners in all.

sentences.zh: 又有杜爾伯特部，土爾扈特部，和碩特部，輝特部，綽羅斯部，額魯特部。

translations.literal: There were also the Dorbed, Torghut, Khoshuud, Khoit, Choros, and Oirat leagues.
translations.idiomatic: There were also the Dorbed, Torghut, Khoshuud, Khoit, Choros, and Oirat leagues.

sentences.zh: 別於蒙古者，曰和托輝特，曰哈柳沁，曰托斯，曰奢集努特，曰古羅格沁，並屬。

translations.literal: Groups distinct from the Mongols—Khotogoid, Kharachin, Tos, Sheyishnuud, and Gorlosgin—were also subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Non-Mongol affiliated groups—Khotogoid, Kharachin, Tos, Sheyishnuud, and Gorlosgin—were likewise under its authority.

sentences.zh: 以外扎薩克封爵有汗，以列王、貝勒、貝子、公之右。

translations.literal: Outer jasak titles included khan, ranking above princes, beile, beizi, and dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Outer jasaks could hold the title of khan, which ranked above princes, beile, beizi, and dukes.

sentences.zh: 無塔布囊，有台吉。

translations.literal: There were no tabunang; there were taiji.
translations.idiomatic: They had taiji but not tabunang.

sentences.zh: 治盟會。

translations.literal: It administered league assemblies.
translations.idiomatic: It administered league assemblies.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀四盟：曰汗阿林，曰齊齊爾裡克，曰克魯倫巴爾和屯，曰扎克畢拉色欽畢都爾諾爾。

translations.literal: The four Khalkha leagues: Khan Uul, Tsetserleg, Khüree, and Zasagt Khan.
translations.idiomatic: The four Khalkha leagues were Khan Uul, Tsetserleg, Khüree, and Zasagt Khan.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特二盟：曰賽因濟雅哈圖左翼，曰賽因濟雅哈圖右翼。

translations.literal: The two Dorbed leagues: Sayin Jayagatu Left Wing and Sayin Jayagatu Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorbed had two leagues: Sayin Jayagatu Left Wing and Sayin Jayagatu Right Wing.

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特五盟：曰南烏訥恩素珠克圖，曰北烏訥恩素珠克圖，曰東烏訥恩素珠克圖，曰西烏訥恩素珠克圖，曰青塞特奇勒圖。

translations.literal: The five Torghut leagues: South Uneen Sujaktu, North Uneen Sujaktu, East Uneen Sujaktu, West Uneen Sujaktu, and Kök Setserleg.
translations.idiomatic: The Torghut had five leagues: South, North, East, and West Uneen Sujaktu, and Kök Setserleg.

sentences.zh: 和碩特一盟：曰巴圖塞特奇勒。

translations.literal: The Khoshuud had one league: Batu Setserleg.
translations.idiomatic: The Khoshuud had one league, Batu Setserleg.

sentences.zh: 盟置盟長、副盟長各一人，於同盟扎薩克內簡用。

translations.literal: Each league had one league chief and one deputy, selected from among the jasaks of the same league.
translations.idiomatic: Each league appointed one chief and one deputy, chosen from among its jasaks.

sentences.zh: 惟青海之盟無長。

translations.literal: Only the Qinghai league had no chief.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Qinghai league had no league chief.

sentences.zh: 置郵驛，頒屯田、互市政令；

translations.literal: It established courier stations and issued orders on garrison farming and border trade;
translations.idiomatic: It established courier stations and issued regulations on garrison farming and border trade;

sentences.zh: 兼稽遊牧內屬者。

translations.literal: it also supervised affiliated nomadic groups.
translations.idiomatic: and it also oversaw affiliated nomadic peoples.

sentences.zh: 一曰察哈爾，二曰巴爾呼，三曰額魯特，四曰扎哈沁，五曰明阿特，六曰烏梁海，七曰達木，八曰哈薩克。

translations.literal: namely: first, Chahar; second, Barghu; third, Oirat; fourth, Zhakhchin; fifth, Mingat; sixth, Uriankhai; seventh, Daur; eighth, Kazakh.
translations.idiomatic: These were Chahar, Barghu, Oirat, Zhakhchin, Mingat, Uriankhai, Daur, and Kazakh.

sentences.zh: 柔遠掌治外扎薩克眾部，凡喇嘛、番僧祿廩、朝貢，並司其儀制。

translations.literal: Pacification of the Distant governed the various outer jasak peoples; it managed stipends for lamas and frontier monks, tribute audiences, and their ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification of the Distant department governed outer jasak peoples, administering stipends for lamas and frontier monks, tribute audiences, and the associated ritual protocols.

sentences.zh: 徠遠掌回部扎薩克、伯克歲貢年班，番子、土司亦如之；

translations.literal: Reception of the Distant managed annual tribute and rotation duty of Muslim jasaks and begs, and the same for aboriginal chiefs and native officials;
translations.idiomatic: The Reception of the Distant department managed annual tribute and rotation audiences for Muslim jasaks and begs, and likewise for aboriginal chiefs and native officials;

sentences.zh: 並典外裔職貢。

translations.literal: it also regulated tribute duties of foreign peoples.
translations.idiomatic: and it regulated tribute duties from foreign peoples.

sentences.zh: 附牧回城卡倫外，曰布魯特。

translations.literal: Pasturing outside the Muslim border posts of the Tarim Basin were the Kirghiz.
translations.idiomatic: Pasturing beyond the Muslim border posts of the Tarim Basin were the Kirghiz.

sentences.zh: 內附者各給以銜，歲遣使輸馬。

translations.literal: Those who submitted were each granted a title and sent envoys yearly to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: Affiliated groups were granted titles and sent annual missions presenting horses.

sentences.zh: 他哈薩克，若浩罕，若博羅爾，若巴達克山，若愛烏罕，並各效其職貢。

translations.literal: Other Kazakhs, such as Kokand, Baltistan, Badakhshan, and Afghanistan, each likewise performed their tribute duties.
translations.idiomatic: Other Kazakh and Central Asian states—Kokand, Baltistan, Badakhshan, and Afghanistan—each likewise fulfilled their tribute obligations.

sentences.zh: 理刑掌蒙古、番、回刑獄諍訟。

translations.literal: Mongol Law handled criminal cases and litigation among Mongols, frontier peoples, and Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Law department handled criminal cases and litigation involving Mongols, frontier peoples, and Muslims.

sentences.zh: 領辦處掌綜領眾務。

translations.literal: The General Affairs Office supervised all business in general.
translations.idiomatic: The General Affairs Office coordinated overall administration.

sentences.zh: 銀庫掌帑金出納。

translations.literal: The Silver Treasury managed receipt and disbursement of treasury silver.
translations.idiomatic: The Silver Treasury managed the receipt and disbursement of court funds.

sentences.zh: 其兼領者：蒙古繙譯房，員外郎、主事各一人，司官內奏委。

translations.literal: Concurrently supervised offices: Mongol Translation Bureau, one vice director and one section chief each, appointed by memorial from among department officials.
translations.idiomatic: Offices under concurrent supervision included the Mongol Translation Bureau, with one vice director and one section chief each, appointed by memorial from among the court's officials.

sentences.zh: 校正漢文官二人，滿、蒙內閣侍讀學士、侍讀、翰林院侍讀、侍講學士、侍讀、侍講內奏派。

translations.literal: Two Chinese-text revisers, dispatched by memorial from among Manchu and Mongol grand secretariat reader-expositors, readers, Hanlin reader-expositors, and exposition and reading lecturers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Chinese-text revisers were detailed by memorial from among Manchu and Mongol reader-expositors and readers of the Grand Secretariat and Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 主章奏文移。

translations.literal: They handled memorials and official correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: They handled memorials and official correspondence.

sentences.zh: 內、外館監督各一人，六部司員內充補。

translations.literal: One supervisor each for the inner and outer guest lodges, filled from among the Six Ministries' clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The inner and outer guest lodges each had one supervisor, drawn from clerks of the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十三年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the thirty-third year of Guangxu.
translations.idiomatic: These posts were abolished in Guangxu 33 (1907).

sentences.zh: 主賓館繕完滌除。

translations.literal: They oversaw repair, cleaning, and maintenance of the guest lodges.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw repair, cleaning, and upkeep of the guest lodges.

sentences.zh: 烏蘭哈達、三座塔、八溝司官各一人，分駐塔子溝筆帖式一人，嘉慶十五年撤回，並四處司員俱改為理事官，隸熱河都統，仍由本院司員內簡放。

translations.literal: One department official each at Ulanhada, Sanzuotai, and Bagou, and one clerk stationed at Tazigou; in the fifteenth year of Jiaqing the Tazigou post was withdrawn, and officials at all four places were changed to administrative commissioners subordinate to the Rehe governor-general, still selected from this court's clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There was one department official each at Ulanhada, Sanzuotai, and Bagou, and one clerk at Tazigou. In Jiaqing 15 (1810) the Tazigou clerk was withdrawn; officials at all four posts were redesignated administrative commissioners under the Rehe governor-general, still chosen from this court's staff.

sentences.zh: 分主蒙古部落民人訟事。

translations.literal: They respectively handled litigation among Mongol tribes and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: They handled civil litigation among Mongol tribes and commoners.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾遊牧處理事員外郎十有六人，以在京蒙古各旗與察哈爾各旗官員內番選。

translations.literal: Sixteen vice directors for Chahar nomadic affairs were chosen in rotation from officials of the Mongol banners in the capital and of the Chahar banners.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen vice directors for Chahar nomadic affairs were chosen in rotation from officials of the capital Mongol banners and the Chahar banners.

sentences.zh: 由護軍、驍騎校選用者授員外郎。

translations.literal: Those selected from guards and captains were appointed vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates drawn from the guards and captains were appointed directly as vice directors.

sentences.zh: 由中書、筆帖式選用者，先授主事，三年稱職，升員外郎。

translations.literal: Those selected from secretaries and clerks were first appointed section chiefs; after three years of competent service they were promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates drawn from secretaries and clerks were first appointed section chiefs and, after three years of satisfactory service, promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 分主遊牧察哈爾民人訟事。

translations.literal: They respectively handled litigation among the nomadic Chahar populace.
translations.idiomatic: They handled civil litigation among the nomadic Chahar populace.

sentences.zh: 張家、喜峰、獨石、殺虎、古北諸口管理驛站員外郎、司員內奏委。

translations.literal: Vice directors for managing courier stations at Zhangjiakou, Xifeng, Dushi, Shahu, and Gubei were appointed by memorial from among department clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Vice directors to manage courier stations at Zhangjiakou, Xifeng, Dushi, Shahu, and Gubei were appointed by memorial from among the court's clerks.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式各一人，主蒙古郵驛政令。

translations.literal: One clerk at each post managed Mongol postal regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Each post had one clerk in charge of Mongol postal regulations.

sentences.zh: 圍場總管一人，康熙四十五年置。

translations.literal: One hunting-park superintendent, established in the forty-fifth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: There was one hunting-park superintendent, established in Kangxi 45 (1706).

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年始來隸。

translations.literal: From the fourteenth year of Qianlong it came under this court.
translations.idiomatic: From Qianlong 14 (1749) it came under this court.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年後，改隸熱河都統。

translations.literal: After the seventh year of Jiaqing it was transferred to the Rehe governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiaqing 7 (1802) it was transferred to the Rehe governor-general.

sentences.zh: 左、右翼長各一人，章京八人，初制六品。

translations.literal: One chief each for the left and right wings, eight zhangjing, originally rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: There was one chief for each wing and eight zhangjing, originally of the sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年升五品。

translations.literal: Promoted to rank 5b in the eighteenth year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 (1753) they were raised to the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 驍騎校八人，主守木蘭圍場，專司巡察。

translations.literal: Eight captains guarded the Mulan hunting park and were charged solely with patrol inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Eight captains guarded the Mulan hunting park and were charged solely with patrol and inspection.

sentences.zh: 初，崇德元年，設蒙古衙門，置承政、參政各官。

translations.literal: At the beginning, in the first year of Chongde, the Mongol Office was established with chancellor and vice chancellor posts.
translations.idiomatic: Originally, in Chongde 1 (1636), the Mongol Office was established with chancellor and vice chancellor posts.

sentences.zh: 三年，更名理籓院，定承政，左、右參政，各一人，副理事官八人，啟心郎一人。

translations.literal: In the third year it was renamed the Court of Colonial Affairs, fixing one chancellor, one left and one right vice chancellor, eight assistant administrative commissioners, and one adviser.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year it was renamed the Court of Colonial Affairs, with one chancellor, one left and one right vice chancellor, eight assistant administrative commissioners, and one adviser.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，改承政為尚書，參政為侍郎，滿、蒙參用。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi the chancellor was changed to minister and the vice chancellor to vice minister, with Manchus and Mongols appointed jointly.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) the chancellor became minister and the vice chancellor became vice minister, with Manchus and Mongols appointed jointly.

sentences.zh: 副理事官為員外郎，置二十有一人，康熙二十年增滿、蒙八人。

translations.literal: Assistant administrative commissioners became vice directors; twenty-one were established, and in the twentieth year of Kangxi eight Manchu and Mongol posts were added.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant administrative commissioners were redesignated vice directors; there were twenty-one posts, and in Kangxi 20 (1681) eight Manchu and Mongol posts were added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年省蒙古一人，四十九年改滿洲二人為蒙缺。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Qianlong one Mongol post was cut; in the forty-ninth year two Manchu posts were changed to Mongol posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 (1777) one Mongol post was eliminated; in Qianlong 49 (1784) two Manchu posts were converted to Mongol posts.

sentences.zh: 後滿、蒙司官增減不一。

translations.literal: Later Manchu and Mongol department officials were increased or reduced without fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the numbers of Manchu and Mongol officials changed repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 啟心郎三人，滿洲一人，漢軍二人。

translations.literal: Advisers numbered three: one Manchu and two Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were three advisers: one Manchu and two Chinese Bannermen.

sentences.zh: 十五年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the fifteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: The post was abolished in the fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: 堂主事二人，康熙二十八年增漢文一人。

translations.literal: Two chancery clerks; in the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi one Chinese-text post was added.
translations.idiomatic: There were two chancery clerks; in Kangxi 28 one Chinese-text post was added.

sentences.zh: 司務二人，滿、蒙各一人。

translations.literal: Two registrars, one Manchu and one Mongol each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two registrars, one Manchu and one Mongol apiece.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: They were abolished in Kangxi 38.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年復故。

translations.literal: Restored to the former arrangement in the tenth year of Yongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: The former arrangement was restored in Yongzheng 10.

sentences.zh: 漢副使一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 從八品。

translations.literal: Rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: The rank was 8b.

sentences.zh: 五年，增置漢院判、正六品。

translations.literal: In the fifth year a Chinese vice director was added, rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a Chinese vice director of the sixth positive rank was added.

sentences.zh: 知事正八品。

translations.literal: Administrative aide, rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: The administrative aide held the eighth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 自副使以下，俱康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: From the vice commissioner downward, all were abolished in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: From the vice commissioner downward, all these posts were abolished in Kangxi 38.

sentences.zh: 各一人。

translations.literal: One each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one of each.

sentences.zh: 四年，置唐古忒學教習一人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year one instructor for the Tangut language school was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year one instructor for the Tangut language school was established.

sentences.zh: 給六品俸。

translations.literal: Granted rank-6 salary.
translations.idiomatic: He received a sixth-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 後改司業。

translations.literal: Later changed to vice director of studies.
translations.idiomatic: The post was later redesignated vice director of studies.

sentences.zh: 其助教以他官兼。

translations.literal: Its assistant instructors were held concurrently by other officials.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant instructors were drawn from other offices on a concurrent basis.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五年定為額缺，尋省。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qianlong it was fixed as a quota post, then soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 5 it was made a quota post, but was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 十六年，定以禮部尚書銜掌院事，侍郎銜協理院事。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year it was fixed that the minister of rites by title would manage court affairs and the vice minister by title would assist in managing court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year it was decreed that the minister of rites by title would head the court and the vice minister by title would assist in its administration.

sentences.zh: 越二年，以隸禮部未合舊制，停兼銜，依六部例，令入議政，班居工部後。

translations.literal: Two years later, because subordination to the Ministry of Rites did not accord with the old system, concurrent titles were discontinued; following the Six Ministries precedent, it entered deliberative government and ranked after the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, because placing the court under the Ministry of Rites conflicted with precedent, the concurrent titles were dropped; following the Six Ministries model, it joined deliberative government and ranked after the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 並設錄勳、賓客、柔遠、理刑四司，置滿、蒙郎中共十有一人，乾隆四十二年增蒙古一人。

translations.literal: Four departments were also established—Merit Records, Guests, Pacification of the Distant, and Mongol Law—with eleven Manchu and Mongol directors in all; in the forty-second year of Qianlong one Mongol post was added.
translations.idiomatic: Four departments were also established—Merit Records, Guests, Pacification of the Distant, and Mongol Law—with eleven Manchu and Mongol directors in all; in Qianlong 42 one Mongol post was added.

sentences.zh: 四十九年改滿洲二人為蒙缺。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year two Manchu posts were changed to Mongol posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year two Manchu posts were converted to Mongol posts.

sentences.zh: 員外郎二十有一人，康熙二十年增滿、蒙八人。

translations.literal: Twenty-one vice directors; in the twentieth year of Kangxi eight Manchu and Mongol posts were added.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty-one vice directors; in Kangxi 20 eight Manchu and Mongol posts were added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年省蒙古一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Qianlong one Mongol post was cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 one Mongol post was eliminated.

sentences.zh: 四十九年改滿洲六人為蒙缺。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year six Manchu posts were changed to Mongol posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year six Manchu posts were converted to Mongol posts.

sentences.zh: 主事滿、漢各四人。

translations.literal: Section chiefs: four Manchus and four Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Manchu and four Chinese section chiefs.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十八年省漢缺。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi the Chinese posts were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28 the Chinese posts were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十九年改滿洲二人為蒙缺。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong two Manchu posts were changed to Mongol posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 49 two Manchu posts were converted to Mongol posts.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十年，增蒙古文主事二人。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kangxi two Mongolian-text section chiefs were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20 two Mongolian-text section chiefs were added.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，析柔遠司為二，曰前司，曰後司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year the Pacification of the Distant Department was divided into two, called the front department and the rear department.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year the Pacification of the Distant Department was split into a front and a rear department.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，設銀庫，初制，蒙古王、台吉等入朝，由戶、工二部及光祿寺庀器用，具廩餼。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year the Silver Treasury was established; under the original system, when Mongol princes and taiji came to court, the Boards of Revenue and Works and the Court of Imperial Entertainments prepared utensils and supplied provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year the Silver Treasury was established. Under the original system, when Mongol princes and taiji came to court, the Boards of Revenue and Works and the Court of Imperial Entertainments supplied utensils and provisions.

sentences.zh: 至是始創設。

translations.literal: Only at this time was it first created.
translations.idiomatic: Only then was it first established.

sentences.zh: 置郎中、員外郎各一人，司員內奏派。

translations.literal: One director and one vice director were established, appointed by memorial from among department clerks.
translations.idiomatic: One director and one vice director were appointed by memorial from among the court's clerks.

sentences.zh: 司庫一人，庫使四人。

translations.literal: One treasury keeper and four treasury assistants.
translations.idiomatic: There was one treasury keeper and four treasury assistants.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，始命王、公、大學士領院事，省庫使二人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng princes, dukes, and grand secretaries were first ordered to head court affairs, and two treasury assistants were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 princes, dukes, and grand secretaries were first appointed to head the court, and two treasury assistant posts were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十二年，改錄勳司為典屬，賓客司為王會，柔遠後司為旗籍，前司仍曰柔遠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Qianlong the Merit Records Department was changed to Outer Dependencies, the Guests Department to Princely Audiences, the rear Pacification of the Distant Department to Banner Registers, and the front department still called Pacification of the Distant.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 22 the Merit Records Department became Outer Dependencies, the Guests Department became Princely Audiences, the rear Pacification of the Distant Department became Banner Registers, and the front department retained the name Pacification of the Distant.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，合旗籍、柔遠為一，增設徠遠一司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Banner Registers and Pacification of the Distant were merged into one, and one Reception of the Distant Department was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Banner Registers and Pacification of the Distant were merged, and a Reception of the Distant Department was added.

sentences.zh: 明年，仍析旗籍、柔遠為二。

translations.literal: The next year Banner Registers and Pacification of the Distant were again divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: The following year they were again split into separate Banner Registers and Pacification of the Distant departments.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，改典屬司為旗籍，舊旗籍為典屬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Outer Dependencies Department was changed to Banner Registers, and the old Banner Registers to Outer Dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year the Outer Dependencies and Banner Registers departments exchanged names.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，改滿洲郎中、員外郎各一人為宗室員缺。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing one Manchu director and one Manchu vice director were changed to imperial-clansman posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 one Manchu director and one Manchu vice director were converted to imperial-clansman posts.

sentences.zh: 咸豐五年，定伊犁塔爾巴哈台通商章程，始司外交職務。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianfeng the trade regulations for Ili and Tarbagatai were fixed, and diplomatic duties began to be handled.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 5 the trade regulations for Ili and Tarbagatai were promulgated, and the court first assumed diplomatic functions.

sentences.zh: 見第十七款。

translations.literal: See Article 17.
translations.idiomatic: See Article 17.

sentences.zh: 十年，定中俄續約，以軍機處及本院典外交文移。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Sino-Russian supplementary treaty was fixed, and the Grand Council together with this court managed diplomatic correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Sino-Russian supplementary treaty was concluded, and the Grand Council together with this court handled diplomatic correspondence.

sentences.zh: 見第九款。

translations.literal: See Article 9.
translations.idiomatic: See Article 9.

sentences.zh: 後歸外部。

translations.literal: Later transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: These duties were later transferred to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，更院為部，擬設殖產、邊衛二司。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu the court was changed to a ministry, with plans to establish Production and Frontier Defense departments.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 the court was elevated to a ministry, with plans to establish Production and Frontier Defense departments.

sentences.zh: 嗣先設編纂、調查二局，隸領辦處，以漢檔房、俸檔房、督催所改並。

translations.literal: Later two bureaus for compilation and investigation were first established under the General Affairs Office, formed by merging the Chinese archive, stipend archive, and supervision office.
translations.idiomatic: Two bureaus for compilation and investigation were then established under the General Affairs Office, formed from the Chinese archive, stipend archive, and supervision office.

sentences.zh: 漢檔房主事缺未省。

translations.literal: The Chinese-archive section-chief post was not cut.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese-archive section-chief post was retained.

sentences.zh: 尋置員外郎、主事各一人。

translations.literal: Soon one vice director and one section chief were added.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward one vice director and one section chief were added.

sentences.zh: 蒙古房改。

translations.literal: The Mongol bureau was reorganized.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol bureau was reorganized.

sentences.zh: 俱蒙缺。

translations.literal: All were Mongol posts.
translations.idiomatic: All posts were reserved for Mongols.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改尚書為大臣，侍郎為副大臣，額外侍郎如故。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong the minister was changed to minister of state, the vice minister to vice minister of state, and the additional vice minister remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 the minister became minister of state, the vice minister became vice minister of state, and the additional vice minister remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 理籓一職，歷古未有專官，唯周官大行人差近之。

translations.literal: The duty of managing frontier peoples had never had a dedicated office in history; only the Grand Herald of the Rites of Zhou was roughly similar.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout history there had never been a dedicated office for managing frontier peoples; only the Grand Herald of the Rites in the Rites of Zhou came close.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢以降，略存規制。

translations.literal: From Qin and Han onward, regulations survived only in outline.
translations.idiomatic: From the Qin and Han onward, only fragments of such regulation survived.

sentences.zh: 遐荒絕漠，統治王官，為有清創製。

translations.literal: Governing kings and officials across remote deserts was an institution created by the Qing.
translations.idiomatic: The systematic governance of distant frontiers and their rulers was a Qing innovation.

sentences.zh: 自譯署設，職權漸替已。

translations.literal: Since the translation office was established, its functions have gradually been superseded.
translations.idiomatic: Once the translation office was established, its functions were gradually superseded.

sentences.zh: 都察院左都御史，初制，滿員一品，漢員二品。

translations.literal: Censorate left censor-in-chief: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 1a, Chinese incumbents rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate's left censor-in-chief was originally rank 1a for Manchus and rank 2a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年並改二品。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi both were changed to rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 both were set at the second rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年仍升滿員為一品，九年並定正二品。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi the Manchu post was again raised to rank 1a; in the ninth year both were fixed at rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 the Manchu post was again raised to the first rank; in Kangxi 9 both were fixed at the second positive rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年升從一品。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng it was raised to rank 1b.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 it was raised to the first subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 左副都御史，正三品。

translations.literal: Left vice censor-in-chief, rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: The left vice censor-in-chief held the third positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢二人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus and two Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus and two Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 其屬：經歷司經歷，正六品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: secretariat director, rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates was the secretariat director of the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 都事□都事，正六品。

translations.literal: Administrative secretary [character missing] administrative secretary, rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: Two administrative secretary posts (a character is missing in the source), of the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式四十有二人。

translations.literal: Forty-two clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There were forty-two clerks.

sentences.zh: 十五道掌印監察御史，初制，滿洲、漢軍三品，順治十六年改七品。

translations.literal: Fifteen-circuit supervising censors with seals: under the original system, Manchu and Chinese Banner incumbents rank 3a; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi changed to rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteen-circuit supervising censors with seals were originally rank 3a for Manchus and Chinese Bannermen; in Shunzhi 16 they were reduced to the seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年升四品，九年復為七品。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi raised to rank 4a; in the ninth year restored to rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 they were raised to the fourth rank; in Kangxi 9 they reverted to the seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，改由編、檢、郎員授者正五品。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng those appointed from compilers, revisers, and bureau directors were rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 appointees drawn from Hanlin compilers, revisers, and bureau directors held the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 由主事、中、行、評、博授者正六品。

translations.literal: Those appointed from section chiefs and secretaries of the central, foreign, judicial, and erudite bureaus were rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: Appointees drawn from section chiefs and secretaries of the central, foreign, judicial, and erudite bureaus held the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年並定從五品。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Qianlong both were fixed at rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 both categories were fixed at the fifth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese for each circuit.

sentences.zh: 監察御史，京畿、江西、浙江、福建、湖廣、河南、山西、陝西八道，滿、漢各一人，江南道滿、漢各三人，山東道滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Investigating censors: for the eight circuits of the capital region, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, one Manchu and one Chinese each; for the Jiangnan circuit, three Manchus and three Chinese each; for the Shandong circuit, two Manchus and two Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors were assigned as follows: for the capital region, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Huguang, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi circuits, one Manchu and one Chinese each; for the Jiangnan circuit, three Manchus and three Chinese each; for the Shandong circuit, two Manchus and two Chinese each.

sentences.zh: 左都御史掌察覈官常，參維綱紀。

translations.literal: The left censor-in-chief inspected and verified official conduct and helped maintain state discipline.
translations.idiomatic: The left censor-in-chief inspected official conduct and helped uphold state discipline.

sentences.zh: 率科道官矢言職，率京畿道糾失檢奸，並豫參朝廷大議。

translations.literal: He led the censorial officials in discharging their duty to speak frankly, led the capital-region circuit in correcting misconduct and detecting malfeasance, and took part beforehand in major court deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: He led the censorial corps in frank remonstrance, directed the capital-region circuit in correcting misconduct and exposing wrongdoing, and participated in major court deliberations.

sentences.zh: 凡重辟，會刑部、大理寺定讞。

translations.literal: For all capital cases he joined the Ministry of Justice and the Court of Judicial Review in fixing verdicts.
translations.idiomatic: In capital cases he joined the Ministry of Justice and the Court of Judicial Review in determining verdicts.

sentences.zh: 祭祀、朝會、經筵、臨雍，執法糾不如儀者。

translations.literal: At sacrifices, court assemblies, the Classics Mat, and imperial lectures he enforced ritual and censured those not observing protocol.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices, court assemblies, the Classics Mat, and imperial lectures he enforced protocol and censured lapses in ritual.

sentences.zh: 左副都御史佐之。

translations.literal: The left vice censor-in-chief assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The left vice censor-in-chief assisted him.

sentences.zh: 十五道掌彈舉官邪，敷陳治道，各覈本省刑名。

translations.literal: The fifteen circuits impeached official misconduct, expounded the principles of governance, and each audited criminal cases in its assigned province.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteen circuits impeached official wrongdoing, expounded principles of governance, and each audited criminal cases in its assigned jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 京畿道分理院事，及直隸、盛京刑名，稽察內閣、順天府、大興、宛平兩縣。

translations.literal: The capital-region circuit handled division of court business, criminal cases in Zhili and Shengjing, and inspection of the Grand Secretariat, Shuntian prefecture, and Daxing and Wanping counties.
translations.idiomatic: The capital-region circuit handled internal court business, criminal cases in Zhili and Shengjing, and oversight of the Grand Secretariat, Shuntian prefecture, and the counties of Daxing and Wanping.

sentences.zh: 河南道照刷部院諸司卷宗，稽察吏部、詹事府、步軍統領、五城。

translations.literal: The Henan circuit reviewed archives of the ministries and courts, and inspected the Ministry of Personnel, Household of the Heir Apparent, metropolitan garrison command, and the Five Cities.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan circuit reviewed ministry and court archives and inspected the Ministry of Personnel, Household of the Heir Apparent, metropolitan garrison command, and the Five Cities.

sentences.zh: 江南道稽察戶部、寶泉局、左右翼監督、京倉、總督漕運，磨勘三庫奏銷。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan circuit inspected the Ministry of Revenue, the coinage bureau, left and right wing supervisors, capital granaries, and the grain-transport governor-general, and audited the three treasuries' memorial accounts.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan circuit inspected the Ministry of Revenue, the coinage bureau, left and right wing supervisors, capital granaries, and the grain-transport governor-general, and audited accounts of the three treasuries.

sentences.zh: 浙江道稽察禮部及本院。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang circuit inspected the Ministry of Rites and this court.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang circuit inspected the Ministry of Rites and the Censorate itself.

sentences.zh: 山西道稽察兵部、翰林院、六科、中書科、總督倉場、坐糧□、大通橋監督、通州二倉。

translations.literal: The Shanxi circuit inspected the Ministry of War, Hanlin Academy, Six Offices, Secretariat of the Central Bureau, granary governor-general, grain-receiving official [character missing], Datong Bridge supervisor, and the two Tongzhou granaries.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi circuit inspected the Ministry of War, Hanlin Academy, Six Offices, Secretariat of the Central Bureau, granary governor-general, grain-receiving official (text damaged), Datong Bridge supervisor, and the two Tongzhou granaries.

sentences.zh: 山東道稽察刑部、太醫院、總督河道，催比五城命盜案牘緝捕之事。

translations.literal: The Shandong circuit inspected the Ministry of Justice, Imperial Medical Academy, and canal governor-general, and pressed the Five Cities on homicide and robbery cases and pursuit of culprits.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong circuit inspected the Ministry of Justice, Imperial Medical Academy, and canal governor-general, and pressed the Five Cities on homicide and robbery cases and the pursuit of offenders.

sentences.zh: 陝西道稽察工部、寶源局，覆勘在京工程。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi circuit inspected the Ministry of Works and the mint bureau and re-examined capital construction projects.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi circuit inspected the Ministry of Works and the mint bureau and re-examined construction projects in the capital.

sentences.zh: 湖廣道稽察通政使司、國子監。

translations.literal: The Huguang circuit inspected the Office of Transmission and the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang circuit inspected the Office of Transmission and the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 江西道稽察光祿寺。

translations.literal: The Jiangxi circuit inspected the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi circuit inspected the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 福建道稽察太常寺。

translations.literal: The Fujian circuit inspected the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian circuit inspected the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 四川道稽察鑾儀衛。

translations.literal: The Sichuan circuit inspected the Imperial Guard of Honor.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan circuit inspected the Imperial Guard of Honor.

sentences.zh: 廣東道稽察大理寺。

translations.literal: The Guangdong circuit inspected the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong circuit inspected the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 廣西道稽察太僕寺。

translations.literal: The Guangxi circuit inspected the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi circuit inspected the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 雲南道稽察理籓院、欽天監。

translations.literal: The Yunnan circuit inspected the Court of Colonial Affairs and the Imperial Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan circuit inspected the Court of Colonial Affairs and the Imperial Observatory.

sentences.zh: 貴州道稽察鴻臚寺。

translations.literal: The Guizhou circuit inspected the Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: The Guizhou circuit inspected the Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 其祭祀、監禮、侍班糾儀，科道同之。

translations.literal: In sacrifices, ritual supervision, and attendance in court ranks to correct protocol, the censorial officials shared these duties.
translations.idiomatic: At sacrifices, in ritual supervision, and in attendance to correct breaches of protocol, the censorial officials shared these duties.

sentences.zh: 經歷掌董察吏胥。

translations.literal: The secretariat director supervised clerks and runners.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat director supervised clerks and runners.

sentences.zh: 都事掌繕寫章奏。

translations.literal: The administrative secretary managed drafting of memorials.
translations.idiomatic: The administrative secretary managed the drafting of memorials.

sentences.zh: 其分攝者：巡視五城御史，滿、漢各一人，科道中簡用。

translations.literal: Offices under divided supervision: censors inspecting the Five Cities, one Manchu and one Chinese each, selected from among the censorial officials.
translations.idiomatic: Under divided supervision were the Five-City inspection censors, one Manchu and one Chinese each, chosen from among the censorial corps.

sentences.zh: 一年更替。

translations.literal: They rotated yearly.
translations.idiomatic: They rotated annually.

sentences.zh: 掌綏靖地方，釐剔奸弊。

translations.literal: They pacified the locality and eliminated abuses.
translations.idiomatic: They kept the districts orderly and rooted out abuses.

sentences.zh: 兵馬司指揮、正六品。

translations.literal: Garrison commandant, rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison commandant held the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 副指揮、正七品。

translations.literal: Deputy commandant, rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy commandant held the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 吏目，未入流。

translations.literal: Clerical registrar, outside the regular rank stream.
translations.idiomatic: The clerical registrar held a post outside the regular rank stream.

sentences.zh: 自正指揮以下俱漢員。

translations.literal: From the chief commandant downward, all incumbents were Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: From the chief commandant down, every post was filled by Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 五城各一人，掌巡緝盜賊，平治道路，稽檢囚徒，火禁區為十坊領之。

translations.literal: One for each of the Five Cities; they patrolled and apprehended robbers, maintained roads, inspected prisoners, and for fire prohibition divided the area into ten wards for administration.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the Five Cities had one such officer, charged with patrolling against bandits, keeping roads in order, inspecting prisoners, and enforcing fire bans through ten ward jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 初沿明制，設都察院。

translations.literal: At first following the Ming system, the Censorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate was first established along Ming lines.

sentences.zh: 天聰十年，諭曰：「凡有政事背謬，及貝勒、大臣驕肆慢上者，許直言無隱。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Tiancong, an edict declared: 'Whenever government affairs are mistaken, or princes and grand ministers are arrogant and disrespectful toward superiors, one is permitted to speak directly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 10 (1626) it was decreed: 'When policies go astray, or when princes and ministers grow arrogant and show disrespect to their superiors, officials may speak frankly and without reservation.'

sentences.zh: 」崇德元年，置承政、參政各官。

translations.literal: ' In the first year of Chongde, the posts of chancellor and vice chancellor were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 (1636), chancellor and vice-chancellor offices were established.

sentences.zh: 明年定承政一人，左、右參政滿、蒙、漢理事官各二人。

translations.literal: The next year one chancellor was fixed, and left and right vice chancellors with two Manchu, Mongol, and Han administering officials each.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the quota was set at one chancellor and left and right vice chancellors, each supported by two Manchu, Mongol, and Han administering officials.

sentences.zh: 後省。

translations.literal: Later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: These posts were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，改左都御史掌院事，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, [the post] was changed to left censor-in-chief managing court affairs, one Manchu and one Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) the chancellor became the left censor-in-chief managing the Censorate, with one Manchu and one Chinese incumbent.

sentences.zh: 左副都御史協理院事，各二人。

translations.literal: Left vice censor-in-chief assisted in managing court affairs, two each.
translations.idiomatic: Two left vice censors-in-chief assisted in managing the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 漢左僉都御史一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese left assistant censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese left assistant censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 先用漢軍，後參用漢人。

translations.literal: At first Chinese Bannermen were used; later Han Chinese were also appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese Bannermen were appointed first; Han Chinese officials were added later.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the thirteenth year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: The post was abolished in Qianlong 13 (1748).

sentences.zh: 外省督、撫，並以右系銜。

translations.literal: Provincial governors-general and governors all used right-series titles.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial governors-general and governors all held right-series censorial titles.

sentences.zh: 右都御史、右副都御史、右僉都御史為督、撫坐銜。

translations.literal: Right censor-in-chief, right vice censor-in-chief, and right assistant censor-in-chief served as seated titles for governors-general and governors.
translations.idiomatic: The right censor-in-chief, right vice censor-in-chief, and right assistant censor-in-chief were titular ranks attached to governors-general and governors.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年停右都御史銜。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong the title of right censor-in-chief was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 the right censor-in-chief title was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 司務，後改經歷。

translations.literal: Court affairs clerk, later changed to secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: The court affairs clerk was later redesignated secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 都事，滿洲二人，乾隆十七年改滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Administrative secretary: two Manchus; in the seventeenth year of Qianlong changed to one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchu administrative secretaries; in Qianlong 17 (1752) the quota became one Manchu and one Chinese.

sentences.zh: 漢軍一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese Bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese Banner incumbent.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十九年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: The post was abolished in Kangxi 39 (1700).

sentences.zh: 設十五道。

translations.literal: Fifteen circuits were established.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen censorial circuits were established.

sentences.zh: 河南道參治院事，置監察御史，滿洲六人，河南、江南、浙江、山東、山西、陝西掌印各一人。

translations.literal: The Henan circuit co-administered court affairs; inspecting censors were established, six Manchus, with one circuit supervising censor each for Henan, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan circuit co-managed Censorate affairs; there were six Manchu inspecting censors, with one circuit supervising censor each for Henan, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五年增十有七人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, seventeen were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 5 (1648), seventeen posts were added.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十八年增一人，後復省四人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Kangxi one was added; later four were again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28 (1689) one post was added; four were later abolished again.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年定江南、山東道各三人，京畿、河南、浙江、山西、陝西、湖廣、福建道各二人，四川、廣東、廣西、雲南、貴州道各一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong it was fixed that Jiangnan and Shandong circuits would have three each; Capital Metropolitan, Henan, Zhejiang, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Huguang, and Fujian circuits two each; Sichuan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Guizhou circuits one each.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 (1749) the quotas were set at three each for Jiangnan and Shandong, two each for the Capital Metropolitan, Henan, Zhejiang, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Huguang, and Fujian circuits, and one each for Sichuan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 漢軍八人；

translations.literal: Eight Chinese Bannermen;
translations.idiomatic: There were eight Chinese Banner incumbents;

sentences.zh: 協理河南道一人，餘隸江南等五道。

translations.literal: one co-administered the Henan circuit, the rest were subordinate to Jiangnan and the other five circuits.
translations.idiomatic: one co-managed the Henan circuit, while the rest fell under Jiangnan and the other five circuits.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十九年省入漢缺。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi abolished and merged into Chinese posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 39 these posts were abolished and absorbed into Chinese vacancies.

sentences.zh: 漢員，江南道五人，內掌印一人。

translations.literal: Chinese incumbents: Jiangnan circuit five, including one circuit supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: Among Chinese incumbents, the Jiangnan circuit had five, including one circuit supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 十八年省一人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 (1661) one post was cut.

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 (1726) one post was added.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was added.

sentences.zh: 浙江道六人，內掌印一人。

translations.literal: Zhejiang circuit six, including one circuit supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang circuit had six incumbents, including one circuit supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 九年省一人，十八年省二人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year one was abolished; in the eighteenth year two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 one post was cut, and in Shunzhi 18 two more were cut.

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 one post was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 江西道六人，十六年省一人，十八年省三人。

translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi circuit had six incumbents; in Shunzhi 16 one was cut, and in Shunzhi 18 three were cut.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 福建道五人，十年省一人。

translations.idiomatic: The Fujian circuit had five incumbents; in Shunzhi 10 one was cut.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年省二人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 two posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 湖廣道六人，八年、九年、十五年俱省一人。

translations.literal: Huguang circuit six; in the eighth, ninth, and fifteenth years one was abolished each.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang circuit had six incumbents; in Shunzhi 8, 9, and 15 one post was cut in each year.

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 one post was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 one post was added.

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong one was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was abolished again.

translations.literal: Henan circuit six, including one circuit supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan circuit had six incumbents, including one circuit supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 十年、十八年俱省一人。

translations.literal: In the tenth and eighteenth years one was abolished each.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10 and Shunzhi 18 one post was cut in each year.

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 two posts were abolished.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 6 (1741) one post was added; in Qianlong 14 one was cut again.

translations.literal: Shandong circuit five, including one circuit supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong circuit had five incumbents, including one circuit supervising censor.

translations.literal: Shanxi circuit five, including one circuit supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi circuit had five incumbents, including one circuit supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 十年省一人，十八年省二人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year one was abolished; in the eighteenth year two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10 one post was cut, and in Shunzhi 18 two were cut.

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qianlong one was added; in the fourteenth year one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 6 one post was added; in Qianlong 14 one was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年省一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 廣東道五人，十八年省二人。

translations.literal: Guangdong circuit five; in the eighteenth year two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong circuit had five incumbents; in Shunzhi 18 two were cut.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年省二人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 two posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年增一人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 one post was added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年省一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 廣西道、雲南道各四人，十八年省二人。

translations.literal: Guangxi and Yunnan circuits four each; in the eighteenth year two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi and Yunnan circuits each had four incumbents; in Shunzhi 18 two posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年各省二人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi two were abolished in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 two posts were cut in each circuit.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年各省二人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong two were abolished in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 two posts were cut in each circuit.

sentences.zh: 貴州道四人。

translations.literal: Guizhou circuit four.
translations.idiomatic: The Guizhou circuit had four incumbents.

sentences.zh: 十八年省二人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 two posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年省一人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年增一人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng one was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 one post was added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年省一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong one was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 京畿道無專員。

translations.literal: The Capital Metropolitan circuit had no dedicated staff.
translations.idiomatic: The Capital Metropolitan circuit had no dedicated incumbents.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年定滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 the quota was set at one Manchu and one Chinese.

sentences.zh: 啟心郎，滿洲、漢軍各一人，十五年俱省。

translations.literal: Qixinlang: one Manchu and one Chinese Banner each; all abolished in the fifteenth year.
translations.idiomatic: There were Qixinlang advisers, one Manchu and one Chinese Banner each; all were abolished in Shunzhi 15 (1658).

sentences.zh: 蒙古章京二人。

translations.literal: Two Mongol section chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Mongol section chiefs.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the first year of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: They were abolished in Kangxi 1 (1662).

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲五十有一人，康熙三十八年省十有六人。

translations.literal: Chancery clerks: fifty-one Manchus; in the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi sixteen were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were fifty-one Manchu chancery clerks; in Kangxi 38 (1699) sixteen posts were cut.

sentences.zh: 漢軍七人。

translations.literal: Seven Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were seven Chinese Banner chancery clerks.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省二人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Kangxi two were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 two posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正十二年置蒙古二人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng two Mongols were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1734) two Mongol chancery clerks were added.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十三年，滿、蒙、漢軍共酌留三十人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Guangxu, Manchus, Mongols, and Chinese Bannermen together were provisionally retained at thirty.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 (1907) the quota for Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese Banner clerks was provisionally reduced to thirty.

sentences.zh: 中、東、西、南、北五城兵馬司指揮各一人，副指揮各二人，康熙十一年省五城各一人。

translations.literal: Central, East, West, South, and North Five-City Garrison Command: one commandant each, two deputy commandants each; in the eleventh year of Kangxi one post per city was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Cities—Central, East, West, South, and North—each had one garrison commandant and two deputy commandants; in Kangxi 11 (1672) one post was cut in each city.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十一年改東、西、南、北四城副指揮分駐朝陽、永定、阜成、德勝諸門外，鈐轄關廂，中城如故。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Qianlong the East, West, South, and North deputy commandants were changed to be stationed outside the Chaoyang, Yongding, Fucheng, and Desheng gates respectively, supervising gate districts; the Central City remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 31 (1766) deputy commandants for the eastern, western, southern, and northern cities were reassigned to stations outside the Chaoyang, Yongding, Fucheng, and Desheng gates to supervise the gate districts; the central city was unchanged.

sentences.zh: 吏目各一人。

translations.literal: One clerical registrar each.
translations.idiomatic: Each city had one clerical registrar.

sentences.zh: 是歲定左都御史、左副都御史、監察御史許風聞言事。

translations.literal: That year it was fixed that the left censor-in-chief, left vice censor-in-chief, and inspecting censors were permitted to report on hearsay.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the left censor-in-chief, left vice censor-in-chief, and inspecting censors were authorized to submit memorials on hearsay evidence.

sentences.zh: 給事中同。

translations.literal: Reviewing censors likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same rule applied to reviewing censors.

sentences.zh: 二年，省京畿道。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Capital Metropolitan circuit was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 (1645) the Capital Metropolitan circuit was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三年，定左副都御史滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the third year, left vice censor-in-chief fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 the left vice censor-in-chief quota was set at one Manchu and one Chinese.

sentences.zh: 九年，復設京畿道，專司照刷各署卷宗。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Capital Metropolitan circuit was re-established, specializing in reviewing archives of each office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 (1652) the Capital Metropolitan circuit was restored to review archives for every yamen.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年改歸河南道。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong changed to be transferred to the Henan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 these duties were reassigned to the Henan circuit.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年停止刷卷。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu archive review was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) archive review was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 並置五城漢軍理事官，是為巡城之始。

translations.literal: At the same time Five-City Chinese Banner administering officials were established; this was the beginning of city patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese Banner administering officials were also appointed for the Five Cities—marking the start of metropolitan city patrol.

sentences.zh: 十年，定滿洲、漢軍、漢五城御史各一人。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the quota was fixed at one Five-Cities censor each for Manchus, Chinese Bannermen, and Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10 (1653) the quota was set at one Five-Cities censor each for Manchus, Chinese Bannermen, and Chinese.

sentences.zh: 十八年各增滿員一人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year one Manchu post was added to each.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 (1661) one Manchu post was added to each category.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年定滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng the quota was fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723) the quota was set at one Manchu and one Chinese each.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十九年漢軍停開列。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year of Qianlong Chinese Bannermen were dropped from the roster.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 39 (1774) Chinese Bannermen were dropped from the roster.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十九年，命左都御史馬齊同理籓院尚書阿喇尼列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Kangxi, Left Censor-in-Chief Ma Qi was ordered to serve jointly with Court of Colonial Affairs Minister Arani as deliberative ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 29 (1690) Left Censor-in-Chief Ma Qi was ordered to serve jointly with Court of Colonial Affairs Minister Arani as deliberative ministers.

sentences.zh: 故事，二院長官俱不豫議政，豫議自此始。

translations.literal: By precedent, chiefs of both yamens had not participated in deliberation; participation began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the chiefs of both yamens had not taken part in deliberation; participation began from this point.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，增置蒙古監察御史二人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year, two Mongol inspecting censors were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 57 (1718) two Mongol inspecting censors were added.

sentences.zh: 滿缺改。

translations.literal: Changed to Manchu quota.
translations.idiomatic: The posts were converted to Manchu quota.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，置內務府御史四人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng four Internal Affairs Department censors were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 (1724) four Internal Affairs Department censors were established.

sentences.zh: 十三年省。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年復置二人，本院御史內奏派。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong two were restored, appointed from among the Censorate's own censors by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3 (1738) two were restored, chosen from among the Censorate's own censors by memorial.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年停。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu they were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) they were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 五年，增置宗室御史二人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, two Imperial-clan censors were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727) two Imperial-clan censors were added.

sentences.zh: 滿缺改。

translations.literal: Changed to Manchu quota.
translations.idiomatic: The posts were converted to Manchu quota.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年復改二人，通舊為四人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong it was changed back to two, four in all counting the previous posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 (1749) the quota was changed back to two, four in all together with the earlier posts.

sentences.zh: 七年，置五城舖司巡檢各一人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, one precinct sub-inspector was established for each of the Five Cities.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 (1668) one precinct sub-inspector was established for each of the Five Cities.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初省。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年，詔按道定額。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong an edict fixed quotas by circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 (1749) an edict fixed quotas by circuit.

sentences.zh: 先是設十五道，唯河南、江南、浙江、山東、山西、陝西六道授印信，掌印者曰掌道，餘曰協道，京畿道亦給印信，未設專官。

translations.literal: Previously fifteen circuits had been established; only Henan, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi received seals—the seal-holder was called the circuit supervising censor and the rest assistant circuit censors; the Capital Metropolitan circuit also received a seal but had no dedicated official.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen circuits had been established earlier, but only Henan, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi received seals—the seal-holder was called the circuit supervising censor and the rest assistant circuit censors; the Capital Metropolitan circuit also received a seal but had no dedicated official.

sentences.zh: 湖廣等八道分隸之，曰坐道，不治事。

translations.literal: The other eight circuits, including Huguang, were placed in subordinate attendance; they were called sitting circuits and did not administer affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The other eight circuits, including Huguang, were placed in subordinate attendance as sitting circuits and did not administer affairs.

sentences.zh: 掌河南道兼理福建道，掌江南道兼理江西、四川道，掌浙江道兼理雲南道，掌山東道兼理廣西道，掌山西道兼理廣東、貴州道，掌陝西道兼理湖廣道。
