translations.literal: The Henan supervising censor also managed the Fujian circuit; the Jiangnan supervising censor also managed Jiangxi and Sichuan; the Zhejiang supervising censor also managed Yunnan; the Shandong supervising censor also managed Guangxi; the Shanxi supervising censor also managed Guangdong and Guizhou; the Shaanxi supervising censor also managed Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan supervising censor also managed Fujian; Jiangnan also managed Jiangxi and Sichuan; Zhejiang also managed Yunnan; Shandong also managed Guangxi; Shanxi also managed Guangdong and Guizhou; and Shaanxi also managed Huguang.

sentences.zh: 至是各道並給印信，規制始稱。

translations.literal: At this point every circuit received seals, and the institution at last matched its design.
translations.idiomatic: At this point every circuit received seals, and the institution at last matched its intended design.

sentences.zh: 二十年，覆命京畿道列河南道前，互易所掌，京畿道遂為要職。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, it was ordered that the Capital Metropolitan circuit be ranked before the Henan circuit and that their jurisdictions be exchanged; the Capital Metropolitan circuit thus became a key post.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 (1755) the Capital Metropolitan circuit was ordered ranked before Henan and their jurisdictions exchanged; the Capital Metropolitan circuit thus became a key post.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，改定都御史一人、副都御史二人，按省分道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu one censor-in-chief and two vice censor-in-chiefs were redefined, with circuits assigned by province.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) the quota was set at one censor-in-chief and two vice censor-in-chiefs, with circuits assigned by province.

sentences.zh: 增設遼瀋道，仿京畿道例，置掌道、協道各二人；

translations.literal: The Liaoshen circuit was added, following the Capital Metropolitan model, with two circuit supervising censors and two assistant circuit censors;
translations.idiomatic: The Liaoshen circuit was added on the Capital Metropolitan model, with two circuit supervising censors and two assistant circuit censors;

sentences.zh: 析江南為江蘇、安徽二道，湖廣為湖北、湖南二道；

translations.literal: Jiangnan was split into Jiangsu and Anhui circuits, and Huguang into Hubei and Hunan;
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan was split into Jiangsu and Anhui circuits, and Huguang into Hubei and Hunan;

sentences.zh: 並增甘肅、新疆二道，置滿、漢御史各一人。

translations.literal: Gansu and Xinjiang circuits were also added, each with one Manchu and one Chinese inspecting censor.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu and Xinjiang circuits were also added, each with one Manchu and one Chinese inspecting censor.

sentences.zh: 是為二十道。

translations.literal: These made twenty circuits in all.
translations.idiomatic: These made twenty circuits in all.

sentences.zh: 令訪求利病，專司糾察，後設之外務、農工商、民政諸部事件，多不關報。

translations.literal: They were ordered to seek out abuses and benefits and to specialize in scrutiny; affairs of the later-established ministries of Foreign Affairs, Agriculture, Industry and Commerce, and Civil Affairs mostly did not require reporting.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to investigate local conditions and specialize in scrutiny, but affairs of the later-established ministries—Foreign Affairs, Agriculture, Industry and Commerce, and Civil Affairs—mostly did not require reporting.

sentences.zh: 舊制，各部及各衙門分道稽察，至是停止。

translations.literal: Under the old system each ministry and each yamen had been inspected by assigned circuits; this was now discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system each ministry and yamen had been inspected by assigned circuits; this was now discontinued.

sentences.zh: 其制已灑然非舊雲。

translations.literal: The institution had already become wholly unlike the old order.
translations.idiomatic: The institution had already become wholly unlike the old order.

sentences.zh: 順治初，又有巡按御史，省各一人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi there were also provincial tour censors, one per province.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shunzhi there were also provincial tour censors, one per province.

sentences.zh: 十七年省。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 17 (1660) they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 巡鹽御史，兩淮、兩浙、長蘆、河東各一人。

translations.literal: Salt tour censors: one each for the Two Huai, Two Zhe, Changlu, and Hedong salt districts.
translations.idiomatic: Salt tour censors: one each for the Two Huai, Two Zhe, Changlu, and Hedong salt districts.

sentences.zh: 十年停，十二年復故。

translations.literal: In the tenth year they were discontinued; in the twelfth year the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10 they were discontinued; in Shunzhi 12 the former arrangement was restored.

sentences.zh: 康熙十一年停，尋復置。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Kangxi they were discontinued; shortly thereafter the posts were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 11 (1672) they were discontinued; shortly thereafter the posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 三十年復差福建、兩廣各一人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year one each was again dispatched to Fujian and the Two Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 30 (1691) one each was again dispatched to Fujian and the Two Guang.

sentences.zh: 五十九年停兩廣鹽差。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year the Two Guang salt assignment was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 59 (1720) the Two Guang salt assignment was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年停福建鹽差。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng the Fujian salt assignment was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723) the Fujian salt assignment was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 明年停長蘆、河東鹽差。

translations.literal: The following year the Changlu and Hedong salt assignments were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Changlu and Hedong salt assignments were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 四年停兩浙鹽差。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Two Zhe salt assignment was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 (1726) the Two Zhe salt assignment was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 巡漕御史一人。

translations.literal: One grain-transport tour censor.
translations.idiomatic: There was one grain-transport tour censor.

sentences.zh: 十四年停。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year it was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 14 (1657) it was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年定差淮安、通州各二人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng two were assigned each at Huai'an and Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 (1729) two were assigned each at Huai'an and Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年改差淮安、濟寧、天津、通州各一人。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong one was assigned each at Huai'an, Jining, Tianjin, and Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 (1755) one was assigned each at Huai'an, Jining, Tianjin, and Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年增差通州四人。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year four more were assigned at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 (1752) four more were assigned at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十三年停差天津一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Tianjin assignment of one was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 (1758) the Tianjin assignment of one was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 二十六年復差天津一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year one was again assigned at Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26 (1761) one was again assigned at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十三年定科、道並差。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jiaqing degree-holders and censorial officials were jointly assigned.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 13 (1808) degree-holders and censorial officials were jointly assigned.

sentences.zh: 道光二年俱停。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang all assignments were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 (1822) all assignments were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 巡視京、通各倉御史一人。

translations.literal: One censor inspecting the granaries of Beijing and Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was one censor inspecting the granaries of Beijing and Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年停，八年復故。

translations.literal: In the seventh year discontinued; in the eighth year restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 7 it was discontinued; in Shunzhi 8 it was restored.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年又停。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kangxi they were again discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 7 (1668) they were again discontinued.

sentences.zh: 二十年定差滿、漢各一人，二十六年再停。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year one Manchu and one Chinese were assigned; in the twenty-sixth year they were again discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20 (1681) one Manchu and one Chinese were assigned; in Kangxi 26 (1687) they were again discontinued.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年置巡察御史一人，總查倉弊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng one inspection censor was established to investigate granary abuses overall.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723) one inspection censor was established to investigate granary abuses overall.

sentences.zh: 五年改京、通倉各差一人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the assignment was changed to one each for the Beijing and Tongzhou granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727) the assignment was changed to one each for the Beijing and Tongzhou granaries.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年定科、道並差。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Qianlong degree-holders and censorial officials were jointly assigned.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 (1752) degree-holders and censorial officials were jointly assigned.

sentences.zh: 四十三年增差內倉一人。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year one more was assigned to the inner granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 (1778) one more was assigned to the inner granaries.

sentences.zh: 五十九年改令科、道監放，停差查倉官。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year degree-holders and censorial officials were ordered to supervise disbursement, and granary inspection assignments were discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 59 (1794) degree-holders and censorial officials were ordered to supervise disbursement, and granary inspection assignments were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年復故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing the former arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 (1799) the former arrangement was restored.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十八年又停。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu they were again discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 (1902) they were again discontinued.

sentences.zh: 巡視江南上下兩江御史二人。

translations.literal: Two censors inspecting the upper and lower Jiang districts of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: There were two censors inspecting the upper and lower Jiang districts of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 六年省。

translations.literal: In the sixth year they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 6 (1649) they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 巡視屯田御史一人。

translations.literal: One censor inspecting garrison farmland.
translations.idiomatic: There was one censor inspecting garrison farmland.

sentences.zh: 四年省。

translations.literal: In the fourth year it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 (1647) it was abolished.

sentences.zh: 督理陝甘洮宣等處茶馬御史一人。

translations.literal: One censor supervising tea and horse trade in Shaanxi, Gansu, Tao, Xuan, and adjacent districts.
translations.idiomatic: There was one censor supervising the tea-and-horse trade in Shaanxi, Gansu, Tao, Xuan, and adjacent districts.

sentences.zh: 康熙七年省，三十四年復故，四十二年又省。

translations.literal: Abolished in the seventh year of Kangxi, restored in the thirty-fourth year, abolished again in the forty-second year.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Kangxi 7 (1668), restored in Kangxi 34 (1695), and abolished again in Kangxi 42 (1703).

sentences.zh: 雍正間，置巡察各省御史，江寧、安徽一人，湖北、湖南一人，山東、河南一人。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng period inspection censors were posted to the provinces: one for Jiangning and Anhui, one for Hubei and Hunan, one for Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng period inspection censors were posted to the provinces: one for Jiangning and Anhui, one for Hubei and Hunan, and one for Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 巡視吉林、黑龍江科道，滿洲二人。

translations.literal: Degree-holders and censorial officials inspecting Jilin and Heilongjiang: two Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Degree-holders and censorial officials inspecting Jilin and Heilongjiang: two Manchus.

sentences.zh: 稽察奉天文武衙門御史一人。

translations.literal: One censor scrutinizing civil and military yamens in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: There was one censor scrutinizing civil and military yamens in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 巡視山東、河南工務御史一人。

translations.literal: One censor inspecting public works in Shandong and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: There was one censor inspecting public works in Shandong and Henan.

sentences.zh: 直隸巡查御史：順天、永平、宣化二人，保定、正定、河間二人，順德、廣平、大名二人。

translations.literal: Zhili patrol censors: two for Shuntian, Yongping, and Xuanhua; two for Baoding, Zhengding, and Hejian; two for Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili patrol censors: two for Shuntian, Yongping, and Xuanhua; two for Baoding, Zhengding, and Hejian; and two for Shunde, Guangping, and Daming.

sentences.zh: 巡農御史一人。

translations.literal: One agriculture tour censor.
translations.idiomatic: There was one agriculture tour censor.

sentences.zh: 先後俱省。

translations.literal: All were abolished in succession.
translations.idiomatic: All were abolished in succession.

sentences.zh: 六科給事中，吏、戶、禮、兵、刑、工六科掌印給事中，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Six Offices reviewing censors: in each of the Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works Offices one seal-holding reviewing censor, one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Offices reviewing censors: in each of the Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works Offices there was one seal-holding reviewing censor, one Manchu and one Chinese each.

sentences.zh: 初制，滿員四品，漢員七品。

translations.literal: Under the initial system Manchu incumbents were rank 4, Chinese incumbents rank 7.
translations.idiomatic: Under the initial system Manchu incumbents held the fourth rank and Chinese incumbents the seventh.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年改滿員七品，六年復為四品。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi Manchu incumbents were changed to rank 7; in the sixth year restored to rank 4.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 2 (1663) Manchu incumbents were reduced to the seventh rank; in Kangxi 6 (1667) they were restored to the fourth.

sentences.zh: 九年俱定七品。

translations.literal: In the ninth year both were fixed at rank 7.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 (1670) both were fixed at the seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年升正五品。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng promoted to the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 (1729) they were promoted to the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年升正四品。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu promoted to the fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) they were promoted to the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 給事中，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Reviewing censors, one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing censors: one Manchu and one Chinese each.

sentences.zh: 初制七品。

translations.literal: Under the initial system, rank 7.
translations.idiomatic: Under the initial system they held the seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年升正五品。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng promoted to the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 (1729) they were promoted to the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式八十人。

translations.literal: Eighty chancery clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There were eighty chancery clerks.

sentences.zh: 吏、戶、兵、刑各十有五人，禮、工各十人。

translations.literal: Personnel, Revenue, War, and Justice fifteen each; Rites and Works ten each.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel, Revenue, War, and Justice had fifteen each; Rites and Works had ten each.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年酌留三十人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu thirty were provisionally retained.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) thirty were provisionally retained.

sentences.zh: 掌言職，傳達綸音，勘鞫官府公事，以註銷文卷；

translations.literal: They held the speaking office, transmitted imperial pronouncements, investigated yamen business, and verified document cancellation;
translations.idiomatic: They held the speaking office, transmitted imperial pronouncements, investigated yamen business, and verified document cancellation;

sentences.zh: 吏科分稽銓衡，註銷吏部、順天府文卷。

translations.literal: The Personnel Office reviewed appointments and verified cancellation of Ministry of Personnel and Shuntian Prefecture documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Personnel Office reviewed appointments and verified cancellation of Ministry of Personnel and Shuntian Prefecture documents.

sentences.zh: 戶科分稽財賦，言主銷戶部文卷。

translations.literal: The Revenue Office audited fiscal levies and also supervised cancellation of Ministry of Revenue documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Revenue Office audited fiscal levies and also supervised cancellation of Ministry of Revenue documents.

sentences.zh: 禮科分稽典禮，註銷禮部、宗人府、理籓院、太常寺、光祿寺、鴻臚寺、國子監、欽天監文卷。

translations.literal: The Rites Office audited ceremonial matters and verified cancellation of Ministry of Rites, Imperial Clan Court, Court of Colonial Affairs, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Court of Imperial Entertainments, Court of State Ceremonial, Directorate of Education, and Imperial Observatory documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites Office audited ceremonial matters and verified cancellation of documents for the Ministry of Rites, Imperial Clan Court, Court of Colonial Affairs, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Court of Imperial Entertainments, Court of State Ceremonial, Directorate of Education, and Imperial Observatory.

sentences.zh: 兵科分稽軍政，註銷兵部、鑾輿衛、太僕寺文卷。

translations.literal: The War Office audited military administration and verified cancellation of Ministry of War, Imperial Guard, and Court of the Imperial Stud documents.
translations.idiomatic: The War Office audited military administration and verified cancellation of documents for the Ministry of War, Imperial Guard, and Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 刑科分稽刑名，註銷刑部文卷。

translations.literal: The Justice Office audited penal matters and verified cancellation of Ministry of Justice documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Justice Office audited penal matters and verified cancellation of Ministry of Justice documents.

sentences.zh: 工科分稽工程，註銷工部文卷。

translations.literal: The Works Office audited public works and verified cancellation of Ministry of Works documents.
translations.idiomatic: The Works Office audited public works and verified cancellation of Ministry of Works documents.

sentences.zh: 有封駁即聞。

translations.literal: When there was a seal-and-return, it was immediately reported.
translations.idiomatic: When there was a seal-and-return, it was immediately reported.

sentences.zh: 初沿明制，六科自為一署，給事中無員限，並置漢軍副理事官。

translations.literal: At first following the Ming system, the Six Offices formed a separate yamen; reviewing censors had no quota limit, and Chinese Banner assistant administering officials were also placed.
translations.idiomatic: At first, following the Ming system, the Six Offices formed a separate yamen; reviewing censors had no fixed quota, and Chinese Banner assistant administering officials were also appointed.

sentences.zh: 順治十八年，定滿、漢都給事中，左、右給事中，各一人，都給事中由左給事中轉，左給事中由右給事中轉。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi Manchu and Chinese chief reviewing censors and left and right associate reviewing censors were fixed at one each; the chief reviewing censor advanced from the left associate, and the left associate from the right.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 (1661) Manchu and Chinese chief reviewing censors and left and right associate reviewing censors were fixed at one each; the chief reviewing censor advanced from the left associate, and the left associate from the right.

sentences.zh: 漢給事中二人，省副理事官。

translations.literal: Two Chinese reviewing censors; assistant administering officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chinese reviewing censors; the assistant administering officials were abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，六科止留滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi the Six Offices retained only one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 (1664) the Six Offices retained only one Manchu and one Chinese each.

sentences.zh: 五年，改都給事中為掌印。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the chief reviewing censor was renamed seal-holding reviewing censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 5 (1666) the chief reviewing censor was renamed seal-holding reviewing censor.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，以六科內升外轉，始隸都察院。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng, as the Six Offices shifted to internal promotion and external transfer, they came under the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongzheng, as the Six Offices shifted to internal promotion and external transfer, they came under the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 凡城、倉、漕、鹽與御史並差，自是台省合而為一。

translations.literal: For city defense, granaries, grain transport, and the salt monopoly, appointments were made jointly with censors; from this the Censorate and Secretariat were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments to city defense, granaries, grain transport, and the salt monopoly were thereafter made jointly with censors, and from that point the Censorate and Secretariat were united as one.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年，省六科名，別鑄給事中印，額定二十人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Guangxu the names of the Six Offices were abolished, separate seals were cast for reviewing censors, and the quota was fixed at twenty.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) the Six Offices titles were abolished, new seals were cast for reviewing censors, and the establishment was fixed at twenty posts.

sentences.zh: 通政使司通政使，初制，滿員二品，漢員三品。

translations.literal: Commissioner of Transmission of the Office of Transmission: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 2a, Chinese incumbents rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of transmission of the Office of Transmission was originally rank 2a for Manchus and rank 3a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年，並定為三品。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi both were fixed at the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) both were fixed at the third rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年復故。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi the former ranks were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 (1667) the former ranks were restored.

sentences.zh: 九年仍改定正三品。

translations.literal: In the ninth year both were again fixed at the third positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 (1670) both were again fixed at the third positive rank.

sentences.zh: 副使，初制，滿員三品，漢員四品。

translations.literal: Deputy commissioner: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 3a, Chinese incumbents rank 4a.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy commissioner was originally rank 3a for Manchus and rank 4a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年並定為四品，康熙六年復故，九年仍改定正四品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 both were fixed at the fourth rank; in Kangxi 6 the former ranks were restored; in Kangxi 9 both were again fixed at the fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) both were fixed at the fourth rank; in Kangxi 6 (1667) the former ranks were restored; in Kangxi 9 (1670) both were again fixed at the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 參議，初制，滿員四品，漢員五品。

translations.literal: Consultative secretary: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 4a, Chinese incumbents rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: The consultative secretary was originally rank 4a for Manchus and rank 5a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年並定正五品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 both were fixed at the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) both were fixed at the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 其屬：經歷司經歷、正七品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: secretariat director of the secretariat directorate, rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates was the secretariat director of the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 知事，初制四品，後改正七品。

translations.literal: Administrative aide: under the original system rank 4a; later changed to the seventh positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The administrative aide was originally rank 4a and was later changed to the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲六人，漢軍二人。

translations.literal: Clerks: six Manchus, two Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Manchu clerks and two Chinese Banner clerks.

sentences.zh: 通政使掌受各省題本，校閱送閣，稽覈程限，違式劾之。

translations.literal: The commissioner of transmission received routine memorials from the provinces, collated and forwarded them to the Grand Secretariat, checked deadlines, and impeached violations of form.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of transmission received the provinces' routine memorials, reviewed them and forwarded them to the Grand Secretariat, audited processing deadlines, and impeached any breach of proper form.

sentences.zh: 洪疑大獄，偕部、院豫議。

translations.literal: In grave doubts and major cases he joined ministries and courts in preliminary deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In cases of grave doubt or capital gravity he joined the ministries and courts in preliminary deliberation.

sentences.zh: 副使、參議佐之。

translations.literal: The deputy commissioner and consultative secretaries assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy commissioner and consultative secretaries assisted him.

sentences.zh: 經歷、知事，分掌出納文移。

translations.literal: The secretariat director and administrative aide separately managed receipt and dispatch of documents.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat director and administrative aide separately managed the receipt and dispatch of official correspondence.

sentences.zh: 其兼領者：登聞鼓□，以參議一人分直，知事帥役巡察。

translations.literal: Among concurrent duties: the Direct Petition Drum [character missing]; one consultative secretary took rotating duty, and the administrative aide led runners on inspection rounds.
translations.idiomatic: Among its concurrent duties was the Direct Petition Drum (a character is missing in the source); one consultative secretary served in rotation, and the administrative aide led runners on inspection rounds.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲、漢軍各一人，掌敘雪冤滯，誣控越訴者論如法。

translations.literal: Clerks, one Manchu and one Chinese Bannerman each, handled petitions to redress wrongs and prolonged grievances; false accusation and improper appeal were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu and one Chinese Banner clerk each handled petitions to redress wrongs and long-standing grievances; false accusations and improper appeals were punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 初，順治元年，詔：「自今內外章奏，俱由通政司封進。

translations.literal: At first, in the first year of Shunzhi, an edict stated: "From now on all memorials from within and without shall be sealed and submitted through the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, in Shunzhi 1 (1644), an edict declared: "Henceforth all memorials from within and without the capital shall be sealed and submitted through the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 」置滿、漢通政使各一人，左通政使各一人。

translations.literal: " One Manchu and one Chinese commissioner of transmission were established, and one left commissioner of transmission each.
translations.idiomatic: " One Manchu and one Chinese commissioner of transmission were appointed, with one left commissioner of transmission for each.

sentences.zh: 漢右通政使二人。

translations.literal: Two Chinese right commissioners of transmission.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chinese right commissioners of transmission.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十年省一人，十三年俱省。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 10 one post was abolished; in Qianlong 13 all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 10 (1745) one post was abolished; in Qianlong 13 (1748) the remainder were abolished.

sentences.zh: 左參議，滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Left consultative secretaries, two Manchus and two Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two left consultative secretaries each for Manchus and Chinese.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十三年省漢一人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 53 one Chinese post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 53 (1714) one Chinese post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年各省一人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 one post was abolished in each category.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748) one post was abolished in each category.

sentences.zh: 右參議，漢二人。

translations.literal: Right consultative secretaries, two Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chinese right consultative secretaries.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省一人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 38 one post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 (1699) one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年俱省。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748) all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢司務各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese registrar each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese registrar apiece.

sentences.zh: 後改經歷。

translations.literal: Later changed to secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: The post was later redesignated secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 知事，滿洲二人、漢軍一人。

translations.literal: Administrative aides: two Manchus, one Chinese Bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchu administrative aides and one Chinese Banner administrative aide.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年改滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 17 changed to one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 (1752) the establishment was changed to one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十一年，以登聞鼓□筆帖式來屬。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 61 the clerks of the Direct Petition Drum [character missing] were transferred to this office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 61 (1722) the clerks of the Direct Petition Drum (a character is missing in the source) were transferred to this office.

sentences.zh: 故事，通狀、通政司狀。

translations.literal: By precedent, transmission petitions went to the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, transmission petitions were handled by the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 鼓狀，登聞院狀。

translations.literal: Drum petitions went to the Direct Petition Court.
translations.idiomatic: Drum petitions were handled by the Direct Petition Court.

sentences.zh: 紛爭無已。

translations.literal: Disputes were unending.
translations.idiomatic: Disputes over jurisdiction were unending.

sentences.zh: 自控訴者赴都察院，以給事中或御史一人主受訴訟，至是停科道差，改隸本司。

translations.literal: Previously petitioners went to the Censorate, where one reviewing censor or inspecting censor chiefly received lawsuits; at this point the rotation of censorate officials was stopped and the duty was transferred to this office.
translations.idiomatic: Previously petitioners had gone to the Censorate, where a reviewing censor or inspecting censor chiefly received lawsuits; at this point the rotation of censorate officials was discontinued and the duty was placed under this office.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，改左通政使為副使，去左、右銜；

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 the left commissioner of transmission was renamed deputy commissioner, and the left and right designations were removed;
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748) the left commissioner of transmission was redesignated deputy commissioner, and the left and right titles were dropped;

sentences.zh: 參議亦如之。

translations.literal: the consultative secretaries were treated likewise.
translations.idiomatic: the consultative secretaries were treated likewise.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，省入內閣，尋復故。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 24 the office was abolished and absorbed into the Grand Secretariat, but soon restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 (1898) the office was abolished and absorbed into the Grand Secretariat, but was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以改題為奏，職無專司，復省。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, because routine memorials were changed to palace memorials and there was no separate specialized duty, it was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 (1902), because routine memorials were replaced by palace memorials and the office no longer had a distinct function, it was abolished again.

sentences.zh: 大理寺卿，初制，滿員二品，漢員三品。

translations.literal: Director of the Court of Judicial Review: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 2a, Chinese incumbents rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: The director of the Court of Judicial Review was originally rank 2a for Manchus and rank 3a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順冶十六年並定為三品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 both were fixed at the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) both were fixed at the third rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年復故，九年仍改定正三品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 the former ranks were restored; in Kangxi 9 both were again fixed at the third positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 (1667) the former ranks were restored; in Kangxi 9 (1670) both were again fixed at the third positive rank.

sentences.zh: 少卿，初制，滿員三品，漢員四品。

translations.literal: Vice director: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 3a, Chinese incumbents rank 4a.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director was originally rank 3a for Manchus and rank 4a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年並定為四品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 both were fixed at the fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) both were fixed at the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年復故，九年仍改定正四品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 the former ranks were restored; in Kangxi 9 both were again fixed at the fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 (1667) the former ranks were restored; in Kangxi 9 (1670) both were again fixed at the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 其屬：堂評事，初制四品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: chief case reviewer, under the original system rank 4a.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates was the chief case reviewer, originally of the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年改七品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 changed to the seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) the post was reduced to the seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年升五品，九年定正七品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 raised to the fifth rank; in Kangxi 9 fixed at the seventh positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 (1667) it was raised to the fifth rank; in Kangxi 9 (1670) it was fixed at the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu incumbent.

sentences.zh: 司務□司務，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Registrars [character missing] registrars, one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: Two registrar posts (a character is missing in the source), one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 左、右寺丞，初制，滿員四品，漢員六品。

translations.literal: Left and right assistant court directors: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 4a, Chinese incumbents rank 6a.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right assistant court directors were originally rank 4a for Manchus and rank 6a for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年並定為六品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 both were fixed at the sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 (1659) both were fixed at the sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年升五品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 raised to the fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 (1667) both were raised to the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 九年仍改定正六品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 both were again fixed at the sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 (1670) both were again fixed at the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲、漢軍、漢俱各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu, one Chinese Bannerman, and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu, one Chinese Bannerman, and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 左、右評事，漢各一人。

translations.literal: Left and right case reviewers, one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese left and one Chinese right case reviewer.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲四人，漢軍二人。

translations.literal: Clerks: four Manchus, two Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Manchu clerks and two Chinese Banner clerks.

sentences.zh: 卿掌平反重辟，以貳邦刑。

translations.literal: The director handled reversal of grave sentences and assisted in state criminal justice.
translations.idiomatic: The director reviewed and reversed grave sentences and served as the court's second authority in national criminal justice.

sentences.zh: 與刑部、都察院稱三法司。

translations.literal: Together with the Ministry of Justice and the Censorate it was called the Three Judicial Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the Ministry of Justice and the Censorate it formed the Three Judicial Offices.

sentences.zh: 凡審錄，刑部定疑讞，都察院糾覈。

translations.literal: In all trial reviews the Ministry of Justice fixed doubtful verdicts and the Censorate scrutinized them.
translations.idiomatic: In all trial reviews the Ministry of Justice determined doubtful verdicts and the Censorate scrutinized them.

sentences.zh: 獄成，歸寺平決。

translations.literal: When the case was complete, it returned to the court for final judgment.
translations.idiomatic: When the case record was complete, it returned to the court for final judgment.

sentences.zh: 不協，許兩議，上奏取裁。

translations.literal: If they did not agree, dual opinions were permitted and a memorial was submitted for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: If the offices disagreed, dual opinions were permitted and a memorial was submitted for the emperor's decision.

sentences.zh: 並參豫朝廷大政事。

translations.literal: He also joined in deliberating major court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He also participated in deliberating major affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 少卿佐之。

translations.literal: The vice director assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director assisted him.

sentences.zh: 寺丞掌覈內外刑名，質成長官，參糾部讞。

translations.literal: Assistant court directors handled review of internal and external criminal cases, checked findings with superiors, and joined in scrutinizing ministry verdicts.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant court directors reviewed criminal cases from within and without the capital, verified findings with their superiors, and joined in scrutinizing the ministry's verdicts.

sentences.zh: 評事掌繕左、右兩寺章奏。

translations.literal: Case reviewers managed drafting of memorials for the left and right courts.
translations.idiomatic: The case reviewers managed the drafting of memorials for the left and right courts.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，定滿、漢卿各一人。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 one Manchu and one Chinese director were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) one Manchu and one Chinese director were established.

sentences.zh: 少卿滿洲一人、漢二人。

translations.literal: Vice directors: one Manchu, two Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu vice director and two Chinese vice directors.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年省一人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 one post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748) one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 滿寺丞一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu assistant court director.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu assistant court director.

sentences.zh: 正五品。

translations.literal: Fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The post held the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 38 abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 (1699) the post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 漢司務二人。

translations.literal: Two Chinese registrars.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chinese registrars.

sentences.zh: 十五年定滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 (1658) the establishment was fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 左、右寺正，正六品。

translations.literal: Left and right court directors, sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right court directors held the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲、漢軍、漢各一人；

translations.literal: One Manchu, one Chinese Bannerman, and one Chinese each;
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu, one Chinese Bannerman, and one Chinese apiece;

sentences.zh: 左、右寺副，從六品。

translations.literal: left and right assistant court directors, sixth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: the left and right assistant court directors held the sixth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 38 abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 (1699) these posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 堂評事，滿、漢各一人；

translations.literal: Chief case reviewers, one Manchu and one Chinese each;
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese chief case reviewer apiece;

sentences.zh: 康熙三十八年省漢軍一人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 38 one Chinese Banner post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 38 (1699) one Chinese Banner post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 左、右評事，漢各一人。

translations.literal: Left and right case reviewers, one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese left and one Chinese right case reviewer.

sentences.zh: 十一年，差寺正、寺副各一人充各省恤刑官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year one court director and one assistant court director each were dispatched to serve as provincial mercy-review officials.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 11 (1654) one court director and one assistant court director each were dispatched to serve as provincial mercy-review officials.

sentences.zh: 刑部差郎中、員外郎十三人。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Justice dispatched thirteen bureau directors and vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice dispatched thirteen bureau directors and vice directors.

sentences.zh: 尋省。

translations.literal: Soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The arrangement was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年，改左、右寺正為寺丞。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 17 the left and right court directors were renamed assistant court directors.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 (1752) the left and right court directors were redesignated assistant court directors.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，省入刑部，尋復故。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 24 abolished and absorbed into the Ministry of Justice, but soon restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 (1898) the court was abolished and absorbed into the Ministry of Justice, but was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，更寺為院。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year the court was renamed an academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32 (1906) the court was redesignated an academy.

sentences.zh: 翰林院掌院學士，初制正五品。

translations.literal: Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy: under the original system, fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor of the Hanlin Academy originally held the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年升正三品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 promoted to the third positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644) the post was raised to the third positive rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年升從二品。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 8 promoted to the second subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 (1730) it was raised to the second subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 大學士、尚書內特簡。

translations.literal: Specially selected from among grand secretaries and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Appointees were specially selected from among grand secretaries and ministers.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 侍讀學士、初制從四品。

translations.literal: Reader-expositors: under the original system, fourth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The reader-expositors were originally of the fourth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年升正四品。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 29 promoted to the fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 it was raised to the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 侍講學士，初制從四品。

translations.literal: Exposition lecturers: under the original system, fourth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The exposition lecturers were originally of the fourth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升正四品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 promoted to the fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 it was raised to the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲各二人，漢各三人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus each, three Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus and three Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 侍讀、初制正六品。

translations.literal: Readers: under the original system, sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The readers were originally of the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年升從五品。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 3 promoted to the fifth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 they were raised to the fifth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年升正五品。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 29 promoted to the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 they were raised to the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升從四品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 promoted to the fourth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 they were raised to the fourth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 侍講，初制正六品。

translations.literal: Lecturers: under the original system, sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The lecturers were originally of the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年升從五品。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 3 promoted to the fifth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 they were raised to the fifth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升從四品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 promoted to the fourth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 they were raised to the fourth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲各三人，漢各四人。

translations.literal: Three Manchus each, four Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were three Manchus and four Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 修撰、初制從六品。

translations.literal: Compilers: under the original system, sixth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The compilers were originally of the sixth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 編修、初制正七品。

translations.literal: Revisers: under the original system, seventh positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The revisers were originally of the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 檢討、初制從七品。

translations.literal: Expositors: under the original system, seventh subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The expositors were originally of the seventh subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 自修撰以下，宣統元年並改從五品。

translations.literal: From compilers downward, in Xuantong 1 all were changed to the fifth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: From the compilers downward, all were changed to the fifth subordinate rank in Xuantong 1.

sentences.zh: 庶吉士，由新進士改用。

translations.literal: Junior compilers were selected from newly passed jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Junior compilers were drawn from newly passed jinshi.

sentences.zh: 試博學鴻詞入式，或奉特旨改館職者，間得除授。

translations.literal: Those who passed the erudite and eloquent examination, or were transferred to Hanlin posts by special edict, were occasionally appointed directly.
translations.idiomatic: Those who passed the erudite and eloquent examination, or were transferred to Hanlin posts by special edict, were occasionally appointed directly.

sentences.zh: 光緒末停科舉，改由外國留學畢業及本國大學畢業者，廷試後授之，食七品俸。

translations.literal: At the end of Guangxu the civil examinations were suspended; graduates of foreign study abroad and of domestic universities were appointed after palace examination and received seventh-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Guangxu reign the civil examinations were suspended; graduates of foreign study and of domestic universities were appointed after palace examination and received seventh-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 或徑授編修、檢討，與舊制殊。

translations.literal: Some were appointed directly as revisers or expositors, unlike the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Some were appointed directly as revisers or expositors, unlike the old system.

sentences.zh: 俱無定員。

translations.literal: All had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: None of these posts had a fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 其屬：主事，滿洲二人，漢軍一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: bureau directors, two Manchus, one Chinese Bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates were bureau directors: two Manchus and one Chinese Bannerman.

sentences.zh: 典簿□典簿、從八品。

translations.literal: Archive clerks [character missing] archive clerks, eighth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two archive clerk posts (a character is missing in the source), of the eighth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 孔目，滿員從九品，漢員未入流。

translations.literal: Registrars: Manchu incumbents ninth subordinate rank, Chinese incumbents outside the regular ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Registrars ranked ninth subordinate for Manchus and were outside the regular ranks for Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 待詔□待詔，從九品。

translations.literal: Awaiting-edict officials [character missing] awaiting-edict officials, ninth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two awaiting-edict official posts (a character is missing in the source), of the ninth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus and two Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus and two Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲四十人，漢軍四人。

translations.literal: Clerks: forty Manchus, four Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were forty Manchu clerks and four Chinese Banner clerks.

sentences.zh: 掌院掌國史筆翰，備左右顧問。

translations.literal: The chancellor managed the national history and brushwork and served as an adviser at the emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor managed the national history and literary work and served as an adviser at the emperor's side.

sentences.zh: 侍讀學士以下掌撰著記載。

translations.literal: From reader-expositors downward they managed composition and record keeping.
translations.idiomatic: From the reader-expositors downward they managed composition and record keeping.

sentences.zh: 祭告郊廟神祇，撰擬祝文。

translations.literal: For sacrifices announcing to suburban altars and temple deities they drafted prayer texts.
translations.idiomatic: For sacrifices announcing to suburban altars and temple deities they drafted prayer texts.

sentences.zh: 恭上徽號、冊立、冊封，撰擬冊文、寶文，及賜內外文武官祭文、碑文。

translations.literal: For reverently presenting honorific titles, investiture, and enfeoffment they drafted patent texts and seal inscriptions, as well as sacrificial texts and stele inscriptions granted to civil and military officials within and without.
translations.idiomatic: For reverently presenting honorific titles, investiture, and enfeoffment they drafted patent texts and seal inscriptions, as well as sacrificial texts and stele inscriptions granted to civil and military officials inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 南書房侍直，尚書房教習，咸與其選。

translations.literal: Attendance in the Southern Study, teaching in the Master-of-Writings Study — all were chosen from among them.
translations.idiomatic: Attendance in the Southern Study and teaching in the Master-of-Writings Study were all drawn from their ranks.

sentences.zh: 修實錄、史、志，充提調、總纂、纂修、協修等官。

translations.literal: In compiling veritable records, histories, and gazetteers they served as supervising editors, chief compilers, compilers, and assistant compilers.
translations.idiomatic: In compiling veritable records, histories, and gazetteers they served as supervising editors, chief compilers, compilers, and assistant compilers.

sentences.zh: 庶吉士入館，分習清、漢書，吏部疏請簡用大臣二人領教習事。

translations.literal: When junior compilers entered the academy they studied Manchu and Chinese texts separately; the Ministry of Personnel memorialized requesting two senior ministers to lead instruction.
translations.idiomatic: When junior compilers entered the academy they studied Manchu and Chinese texts separately; the Ministry of Personnel memorialized requesting two senior ministers to lead instruction.

sentences.zh: 初以內院學士為之，侍讀等官亦間有與者。

translations.literal: At first inner-court academicians filled the role; readers and other officials also occasionally served.
translations.idiomatic: At first inner-court academicians filled the role; readers and other officials also occasionally served.

sentences.zh: 後令掌院兼其職。

translations.literal: Later the chancellor was ordered to hold the duty concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Later the chancellor was ordered to hold the duty concurrently.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，始以工部尚書陳元龍領之，自是尚書、侍郎、內閣學士並得充之。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 Minister of Works Chen Yuanlong was first appointed to lead it; from then ministers, vice ministers, and grand secretariat academicians could all serve.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 Minister of Works Chen Yuanlong was first appointed to lead it; thereafter ministers, vice ministers, and grand secretariat academicians could all serve.

sentences.zh: 是為大教習。

translations.literal: This was the chief instructor.
translations.idiomatic: This was the chief instructor.

sentences.zh: 其小教習由掌院選派，始於康熙三十三年。

translations.literal: Junior instructors were selected and dispatched by the chancellor, beginning in Kangxi 33.
translations.idiomatic: Junior instructors were selected and dispatched by the chancellor, beginning in Kangxi 33.

sentences.zh: 雍正間停止，高宗復舊制。

translations.literal: It was suspended in the Yongzheng period; the Gaozong emperor restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: It was suspended in the Yongzheng period; the Qianlong emperor restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 侍讀、侍講司訓課，派編、檢二人提調館餼。

translations.literal: Readers and lecturers managed instruction; two revisers and expositors were dispatched to supervise academy provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Readers and lecturers managed instruction; two revisers and expositors were dispatched to supervise academy provisions.

sentences.zh: 三年考試，分別散留。

translations.literal: After three years of examination they were separately released or retained.
translations.idiomatic: After three years of examination they were separately released or retained.

sentences.zh: 辦事翰林，滿、漢各二人，雍正元年，命俸淺編、檢主定稿說堂，此清秘堂辦事翰林之始。

translations.literal: Handling Hanlin officials, one Manchu and one Chinese each; in Yongzheng 1 junior revisers and expositors were ordered to finalize drafts and lecture in hall — this was the beginning of handling Hanlin officials in the Qing Secretariat Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Handling Hanlin officials, one Manchu and one Chinese apiece; in Yongzheng 1 junior revisers and expositors were ordered to finalize drafts and lecture in hall — this marked the beginning of handling Hanlin officials in the Qing Secretariat Hall.

sentences.zh: 厥後人數稍增，有奏辦、協辦之目。

translations.literal: Thereafter the number increased slightly, with categories of memorial-handling and assistant-handling officials.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the number increased slightly, with categories of memorial-handling and assistant-handling officials.

sentences.zh: 侍讀、侍講間亦為之。

translations.literal: Readers and lecturers also occasionally served.
translations.idiomatic: Readers and lecturers also occasionally served.

sentences.zh: 掌帥□官治事。

translations.literal: The chancellor supervised [character missing] officials in managing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor supervised the officials in managing affairs (a character is missing in the source).

sentences.zh: 主事、典簿、孔目，掌章奏文移，董帥吏役。

translations.literal: Bureau directors, archive clerks, and registrars managed memorials and documents and directed runners and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau directors, archive clerks, and registrars managed memorials and documents and directed runners and clerks.

sentences.zh: 待詔掌繕寫校勘。

translations.literal: Awaiting-edict officials managed copying and collation.
translations.idiomatic: The awaiting-edict officials managed copying and collation.

sentences.zh: 初，翰林之職隸內三院。

translations.literal: At first Hanlin duties were subordinate to the Three Inner Courts.
translations.idiomatic: At first Hanlin duties were subordinate to the Three Inner Courts.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，設翰林院，定掌院學士為專官，置漢員一人，兼禮部侍郎銜。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 the Hanlin Academy was established, the chancellor was fixed as a separate post, one Chinese incumbent was appointed, concurrently holding vice-minister of Rites rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 the Hanlin Academy was established, the chancellor was fixed as a separate post, one Chinese incumbent was appointed with concurrent vice-minister of Rites rank.

sentences.zh: 侍讀學士、侍講學士各二人。

translations.literal: Two reader-expositors and two exposition lecturers each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two reader-expositors and two exposition lecturers apiece.

sentences.zh: 十五年各增二人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year two more were added to each.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 two more were added to each category.

sentences.zh: 侍讀、侍講各二人。

translations.literal: Two readers and two lecturers each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two readers and two lecturers apiece.

sentences.zh: 十五年各增一人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year one more was added to each.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 one more was added to each category.

sentences.zh: 修撰、編修、檢討、庶吉士，無定員。

translations.literal: Compilers, revisers, expositors, and junior compilers had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Compilers, revisers, expositors, and junior compilers had no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 典簿二人，十五年改一人為滿缺。

translations.literal: Two archive clerks; in the fifteenth year one post was changed to a Manchu slot.
translations.idiomatic: There were two archive clerks; in Shunzhi 15 one post was changed to a Manchu slot.

sentences.zh: 孔目一人，十五年增滿洲一人。

translations.literal: One registrar; in the fifteenth year one Manchu was added.
translations.idiomatic: There was one registrar; in Shunzhi 15 one Manchu registrar was added.

sentences.zh: 俱漢人為之。

translations.literal: All were filled by Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: All were filled by Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 明年，省入內三院。

translations.literal: The next year it was abolished and absorbed into the Three Inner Courts.
translations.idiomatic: The next year it was abolished and absorbed into the Three Inner Courts.

sentences.zh: 十五年，復舊制，增滿洲掌院學士一人，兼銜如故。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the old system was restored, one Manchu chancellor was added, and concurrent titles remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 the old system was restored, one Manchu chancellor was added, and concurrent titles remained as before.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年停。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 58 it was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 58 the concurrent title was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 置待詔六人。

translations.literal: Six awaiting-edict officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: Six awaiting-edict officials were established.

sentences.zh: 滿員四人，滿員二人。

translations.literal: Four Manchu incumbents, two Chinese incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: Four posts were reserved for Manchus and two for Chinese; the source text repeats the term for Manchu incumbents where Chinese incumbents is expected.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復歸內三院。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year it was again returned to the Three Inner Courts.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 it was again returned to the Three Inner Courts.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，定滿、漢侍讀學士、侍講學士、侍讀、侍講，各三人；

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 fixed at three Manchu and three Chinese reader-expositors, exposition lecturers, readers, and lecturers each;
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 there were fixed at three Manchu and three Chinese reader-expositors, exposition lecturers, readers, and lecturers apiece;

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十年省滿洲各一人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 50 one Manchu post was abolished in each category.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 one Manchu post was abolished in each category.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年增侍讀、侍講滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 29 two Manchu and two Chinese readers and lecturers were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 two Manchu and two Chinese readers and lecturers were added.

sentences.zh: 典簿、孔目各一人，待詔各二人。

translations.literal: One archive clerk and one registrar each, two awaiting-edict officials each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one archive clerk and one registrar apiece, and two awaiting-edict officials each.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年定滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 the establishment was fixed at one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 十六年，命侍講學士張英等入直南書房。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year exposition lecturer Zhang Ying and others were ordered to attend duty in the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 exposition lecturer Zhang Ying and others were ordered to attend duty in the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 先是詔冊詞命多由院擬，至是始為西清專職。

translations.literal: Previously edicts and patent compositions were mostly drafted by the academy; from this point it became the specialized duty of the Western Pure Office.
translations.idiomatic: Previously edicts and patent compositions were mostly drafted by the academy; from this point it became the specialized duty of the Western Pure Office.

sentences.zh: 後改歸軍機處。

translations.literal: Later it was transferred to the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Later the duty was transferred to the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以院務隳廢，命大學士徐元文兼掌院事，重臣兼領自此始。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, because academy affairs had fallen into neglect, Grand Secretary Xu Yuanwen was ordered to manage the chancellorship concurrently; senior ministers holding concurrent charge began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28, because academy affairs had fallen into neglect, Grand Secretary Xu Yuanwen was ordered to manage the chancellorship concurrently; senior ministers holding concurrent charge began from this point.

sentences.zh: 明年定尚書、侍郎、左都御史俱得兼攝。

translations.literal: The next year it was fixed that ministers, vice ministers, and the left censor-in-chief could all hold the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The next year it was fixed that ministers, vice ministers, and the left censor-in-chief could all hold the post concurrently.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年，增置堂主事，滿洲二人、漢一人。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 29 hall bureau directors were added: two Manchus, one Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 hall bureau directors were added: two Manchus and one Chinese.

sentences.zh: 是歲省詹事府，以詞臣敘進無階，增置滿、漢學士正三品。

translations.literal: That year the Household of the Heir Apparent was abolished; because literary officials had no rank for advancement, Manchu and Chinese academicians of the third positive rank were added.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Household of the Heir Apparent was abolished; because literary officials had no rank for advancement, Manchu and Chinese academicians of the third positive rank were added.

sentences.zh: 各一人，撰文正六品。

translations.literal: One each; document drafters, sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one of each; document drafters held the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升正五品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 promoted to the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 they were raised to the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 各二人。

translations.literal: Two each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two apiece.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，增置秘書郎，從六品。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year secretary officials were added, sixth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 secretary officials of the sixth subordinate rank were added.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升正五品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 promoted to the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 they were raised to the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus and two Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus and two Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 並設講習館，令翰林官研習學科，備各部丞、參選。

translations.literal: A lecture and study hall was also established, ordering Hanlin officials to study specialized subjects in preparation for selection as vice directors and consultative secretaries in the ministries.
translations.idiomatic: A lecture and study hall was also established, ordering Hanlin officials to study specialized subjects in preparation for selection as vice directors and consultative secretaries in the ministries.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，復崇侍講學士以下品秩，停止外班升用。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 the ranks from exposition lecturer downward were restored to honor, and promotion from the external roster was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 the ranks from exposition lecturer downward were restored to honor, and promotion from the external roster was stopped.

sentences.zh: 初制、翰、詹出缺，編、檢不敷升轉，以部、院科甲出身司員升用，是為外班。

translations.literal: Under the original system, when Hanlin and Heir Apparent posts fell vacant and revisers and expositors were insufficient for promotion, ministry and court officials of jinshi origin were promoted — this was the external roster.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system, when Hanlin and Heir Apparent posts fell vacant and revisers and expositors were insufficient for promotion, ministry and court officials of jinshi origin were promoted — this was the external roster.

sentences.zh: 初制，進士論甲第，修撰、編修、檢討不分升降。

translations.literal: Under the original system jinshi were ranked by examination grade; compilers, revisers, and expositors were not distinguished by promotion or demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system jinshi were ranked by examination grade; compilers, revisers, and expositors were not distinguished by promotion or demotion.

sentences.zh: 順治間，授編修程芳朝等為修撰，檢討李霨等為編修，姜元衡以編修降檢討，不為定制。

translations.literal: In the Shunzhi period reviser Cheng Fangchao and others were appointed compilers, expositor Li Bi and others were appointed revisers, and reviser Jiang Yuanheng was demoted to expositor — this was not fixed practice.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shunzhi period reviser Cheng Fangchao and others were appointed compilers, expositor Li Bi and others were appointed revisers, and reviser Jiang Yuanheng was demoted to expositor — this was not fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 又內三院編修等官不必盡由科目，靳輔、劉兆麟等並以官學生授編修，蓋亦創舉。

translations.literal: Moreover, compilers and other officials of the Three Inner Courts did not all come through the examinations; Jin Fu, Liu Zhaolin, and others were all appointed revisers as students of the official schools — these too were exceptional cases.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, compilers and other officials of the Three Inner Courts did not all come through the examinations; Jin Fu, Liu Zhaolin, and others were all appointed revisers as students of the official schools — these too were exceptional cases.

sentences.zh: 庶吉士舊隸內弘文院，後設本院，始來屬。

translations.literal: Junior compilers were formerly subordinate to the Inner Hongwen Court; after this academy was established they came under it.
translations.idiomatic: Junior compilers were formerly subordinate to the Inner Hongwen Court; after this academy was established they came under it.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，建庶常館。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 13 the Junior Compiler Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 the Junior Compiler Hall was built.

sentences.zh: 故事，散館後始授職，然亦有未選庶常而遽授者，均異數也。

translations.literal: By precedent appointment came only after release from the academy, yet there were also cases of immediate appointment without selection as junior compiler — all were exceptional.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent appointment came only after release from the academy, yet there were also cases of immediate appointment without selection as junior compiler — all were exceptional.

sentences.zh: 文淵閣領閣事三人，掌典綜冊府。

translations.literal: The Wenyuan Pavilion had three pavilion chiefs managing the archive in general.
translations.idiomatic: The Wenyuan Pavilion had three pavilion chiefs who managed the archive in general.

sentences.zh: 大學士、協辦大學士、掌院學士兼充。

translations.literal: Grand secretaries, associate grand secretaries, and the Hanlin chancellor served concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries, associate grand secretaries, and the Hanlin chancellor served concurrently.

sentences.zh: 直閣事六人，掌典守釐緝。

translations.literal: Six direct pavilion officials managed custody, collation, and binding.
translations.idiomatic: Six direct pavilion officials managed custody, collation, and binding.

sentences.zh: 內閣學士、少詹事、講讀學士兼充。

translations.literal: Grand secretariat academicians, junior tutors of the Heir Apparent, and exposition and reading lecturers served concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretariat academicians, junior tutors of the Heir Apparent, and exposition and reading lecturers served concurrently.

sentences.zh: 校理十有六人，掌註冊點驗。

translations.literal: Sixteen collators managed registration and inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen collators managed registration and inspection.

sentences.zh: 庶子、講、讀、編、檢兼充。

translations.literal: Sub-tutors, lecturers, readers, revisers, and expositors served concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Sub-tutors, lecturers, readers, revisers, and expositors served concurrently.

sentences.zh: 檢閱八人。

translations.literal: Eight proofreaders.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight proofreaders.

sentences.zh: 內閣中書派充。

translations.literal: Dispatched from among grand secretariat secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: They were dispatched from among grand secretariat secretaries.

sentences.zh: 內務府司員、筆帖式各四人。

translations.literal: Four Imperial Household Department officials and four clerks each.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Imperial Household Department officials and four clerks apiece.

sentences.zh: 由提舉閣事大臣番選奏充。

translations.literal: Selected in rotation by the minister supervising pavilion affairs and memorialized for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: They were selected in rotation by the minister supervising pavilion affairs and memorialized for appointment.

sentences.zh: 國史館總裁，特簡，無定員。

translations.literal: Chief directors of the State Historiography Institute were specially selected with no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Chief directors of the State Historiography Institute were specially selected, with no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 掌修國史。

translations.literal: They managed compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: They managed compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 清文總校一人。

translations.literal: One chief collator of Manchu texts.
translations.idiomatic: There was one chief collator of Manchu texts.

sentences.zh: 滿洲侍郎內特簡。

translations.literal: Specially selected from among Manchu vice ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The appointee was specially selected from among Manchu vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 提調，滿洲、內閣侍讀學士或侍讀派充。

translations.literal: Supervising editors: dispatched from among Manchu grand secretariat reader-expositors or readers.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising editors were dispatched from among Manchu grand secretariat reader-expositors or readers.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、內閣蒙古堂或理籓院員司派充。

translations.literal: Mongol posts: dispatched from among Mongol grand secretariat officials or Court of Colonial Affairs staff.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol posts were filled from among Mongol grand secretariat officials or Court of Colonial Affairs staff.

sentences.zh: 漢翰林院侍讀學士以下官派充。

translations.literal: Chinese posts: dispatched from among Hanlin reader-expositors and officials below them.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese posts were filled from among Hanlin reader-expositors and officials below them.

sentences.zh: 各二人。

translations.literal: Two each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two apiece.

sentences.zh: 總纂，滿洲四人，蒙古二人，漢六人。

translations.literal: Chief compilers: four Manchus, two Mongols, six Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Manchu, two Mongol, and six Chinese chief compilers.

sentences.zh: 纂修、協修，無定員。

translations.literal: Compilers and assistant compilers had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Compilers and assistant compilers had no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 蒙古由理籓院司官充。

translations.literal: Mongols were filled by Court of Colonial Affairs officials.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol posts were filled by Court of Colonial Affairs officials.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢由編、檢充。

translations.literal: Manchus and Chinese were filled by revisers and expositors.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu and Chinese posts were filled by revisers and expositors.

sentences.zh: 校對，滿、蒙、漢俱各八人。

translations.literal: Collators: eight Manchus, eight Mongols, and eight Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight Manchu, eight Mongol, and eight Chinese collators apiece.

sentences.zh: 內閣中書充。

translations.literal: Filled by grand secretariat secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: They were filled by grand secretariat secretaries.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，增置筆削員十人。

translations.literal: In the Guangxu period ten editorial revisers were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the Guangxu period ten editorial revisers were added.

sentences.zh: 經筵講官，滿、漢各八人，掌進讀講章，敷陳訓典。

translations.literal: Classics Mat lecturers, eight Manchus and eight Chinese each, managed reading and lecturing on the classics and expounding canonical instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Classics Mat lecturers, eight Manchus and eight Chinese apiece, read and lectured on the classics and expounded canonical instruction.

sentences.zh: 歲仲春、仲秋兩舉之。

translations.literal: Held twice each year in mid-spring and mid-autumn.
translations.idiomatic: The mat was held twice each year, in mid-spring and mid-autumn.

sentences.zh: 滿員由大學士以下、都察院副都御史以上各官兼充。

translations.literal: Manchu incumbents were filled concurrently by officials from grand secretaries downward and from vice censors-in-chief of the Censorate upward.
translations.idiomatic: Manchu posts were filled concurrently by officials from grand secretaries downward and from Censorate vice censors-in-chief upward.

sentences.zh: 漢員由大學士、尚書、侍郎、副都御史、掌院學士、侍讀學士、侍講學士、詹事府詹事、少詹事、國子監祭酒等官，由翰林出身者兼充。

translations.literal: Chinese incumbents were filled concurrently by grand secretaries, ministers, vice ministers, vice censors-in-chief, the Hanlin chancellor, reader-expositors, exposition lecturers, tutors of the Heir Apparent, junior tutors, and chancellor of the Directorate of Education — all of Hanlin origin.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese posts were filled concurrently by grand secretaries, ministers, vice ministers, vice censors-in-chief, the Hanlin chancellor, reader-expositors, exposition lecturers, tutors and junior tutors of the Heir Apparent, and the chancellor of the Directorate of Education — all of Hanlin origin.

sentences.zh: 講官滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Two Manchu and two Chinese lecturers each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchu and two Chinese lecturers apiece.

sentences.zh: 翰林院請旨簡派。

translations.literal: The Hanlin Academy memorialized requesting imperial selection and appointment.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy memorialized requesting imperial selection and appointment.

sentences.zh: 初制以大學士知經筵事。

translations.literal: Under the original system grand secretaries managed Classics Mat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system grand secretaries managed Classics Mat affairs.

sentences.zh: 後定經筵講官滿、漢各六人，閣臣遂不進講。

translations.literal: Later six Manchu and six Chinese Classics Mat lecturers were fixed, and grand secretariat officials no longer lectured.
translations.idiomatic: Later six Manchu and six Chinese Classics Mat lecturers were fixed, and grand secretariat officials no longer lectured.

sentences.zh: 自徐元文、熊賜履輩相繼以尚書擢大學士，仍與兼充，嗣是以為常。

translations.literal: From Xu Yuanwen, Xiong Cilu, and others who were successively promoted from ministers to grand secretaries and still served concurrently, this thereafter became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: From Xu Yuanwen, Xiong Cilu, and others who were successively promoted from ministers to grand secretaries and still served concurrently, this thereafter became regular practice.

sentences.zh: 宣統初，各部丞、參亦間有與者。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuantong, vice directors and consultative secretaries of the ministries also occasionally served.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuantong, ministry vice directors and consultative secretaries also occasionally served.

sentences.zh: 起居注館，日講起居注官，滿洲十人，漢十有二人。

translations.literal: Diarist Hall: daily-lecture diarists, ten Manchus, twelve Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: The Diarist Hall had daily-lecture diarists: ten Manchus and twelve Chinese.

sentences.zh: 由翰、詹各官簡用。

translations.literal: Selected from among Hanlin and Heir Apparent officials.
translations.idiomatic: They were selected from among Hanlin and Heir Apparent officials.

sentences.zh: 唯滿、漢掌院學士例各兼一缺。

translations.literal: Only the Manchu and Chinese Hanlin chancellors each routinely held one concurrent post.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Manchu and Chinese Hanlin chancellors each routinely held one concurrent post.

sentences.zh: 主事，滿洲二人，漢一人。

translations.literal: Bureau directors: two Manchus, one Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchu bureau directors and one Chinese bureau director.

sentences.zh: 以科甲出身者充之。

translations.literal: Filled by officials of jinshi origin.
translations.idiomatic: They were filled by officials of jinshi origin.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲十有四人，漢軍二人。

translations.literal: Clerks: fourteen Manchus, two Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were fourteen Manchu clerks and two Chinese Banner clerks.

sentences.zh: 日講官掌侍直起居，記言記動。

translations.literal: Daily-lecture officials managed attendance at imperial actions, recording words and deeds.
translations.idiomatic: Daily-lecture officials attended imperial actions on duty, recording words and deeds.

sentences.zh: 經筵臨雍，御門聽政，祭祀耕耤，朝會燕饗，勾決重囚，並以二人侍班。
