translations.literal: At the Classics Mat, imperial lectures at the Confucian temple, imperial audiences at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, sacrificial rites and plowing ceremonies, court assemblies and banquets, and review of capital cases — in all these two officials served on duty.
translations.idiomatic: At the Classics Mat, imperial lectures at the Confucian temple, imperial audiences at the Gate of Supreme Harmony, sacrificial rites and plowing ceremonies, court assemblies and banquets, and review of capital cases — in all these two officials served on duty.

sentences.zh: 凡謁陵、校獵、巡狩方岳，請旨、扈從、侍直，敬聆綸音，退而謹書之。

translations.literal: For visits to imperial tombs, hunts, and tours of the sacred mountains they requested instructions, accompanied the emperor, served on duty, respectfully heard imperial pronouncements, and upon withdrawal carefully recorded them.
translations.idiomatic: For visits to imperial tombs, hunts, and tours of the sacred mountains they requested instructions, accompanied the emperor, served on duty, respectfully heard imperial pronouncements, and upon withdrawal carefully recorded them.

sentences.zh: 月要歲會，貯置鐵，送內閣尊藏。

translations.literal: Monthly summaries and annual compilations were stored in iron cases and sent to the Grand Secretariat for reverent safekeeping.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly summaries and annual compilations were stored in iron cases and sent to the Grand Secretariat for reverent safekeeping.

sentences.zh: 主事掌出納文移，校勘典籍。

translations.literal: Bureau directors managed receipt and dispatch of documents and collation of texts.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau directors managed receipt and dispatch of documents and collation of texts.

sentences.zh: 初，天聰二年，命儒臣分兩直，巴克什達海等譯漢字書，即日講所繇始，巴克什庫爾纏等記注政事，即起居注官所繇始。

translations.literal: At first, in the second year of Tiancong, Confucian officials were ordered to divide into two shifts; bakshi Dahai and others translated Chinese books — this was the origin of daily lecture; bakshi Kuerchan and others recorded state affairs — this was the origin of diarist officials.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in Tiancong 2 (1628), Confucian officials were ordered to divide into two shifts; bakshi Dahai and others translated Chinese books — this was the origin of daily lecture; bakshi Kuerchan and others recorded state affairs — this was the origin of diarist officials.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，始置日講官。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 12 daily-lecture officials were first established.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 daily-lecture officials were first established.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，始設起居注館，在太和門西廡。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 the Diarist Hall was first established in the western corridor of the Gate of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 the Diarist Hall was first established in the western corridor of the Gate of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 置滿洲記注官四人，漢八人，以日講官兼攝。

translations.literal: Four Manchu recording officials and eight Chinese were established, filled concurrently by daily-lecture officials.
translations.idiomatic: Four Manchu recording officials and eight Chinese were established, filled concurrently by daily-lecture officials.

sentences.zh: 十二年增滿洲一人，漢二人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year one Manchu and two Chinese were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 12 one Manchu and two Chinese were added.

sentences.zh: 十六年復增滿洲一人。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year one more Manchu was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 one more Manchu was added.

sentences.zh: 二十年增漢八人。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year eight Chinese were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 20 eight Chinese were added.

sentences.zh: 三十年定漢員十有二人。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Chinese incumbents were fixed at twelve.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 30 Chinese incumbents were fixed at twelve.

sentences.zh: 時日講與起居注各自為職，並置滿洲主事二人，漢軍一人。

translations.literal: At that time daily lecture and diarist duties were separate posts, and two Manchu bureau directors and one Chinese Banner bureau director were also established.
translations.idiomatic: At that time daily lecture and diarist duties were separate posts, and two Manchu bureau directors and one Chinese Banner bureau director were also established.

sentences.zh: 五十七年省。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 57 they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年置滿洲二人。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 1 two Manchu posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 two Manchu posts were established.

sentences.zh: 十二年增漢一人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year one Chinese was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 one Chinese was added.

sentences.zh: 二十五年停日講，其起居注官仍系銜「日講」二字。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year daily lecture was suspended; diarist officials still bore the two characters "daily lecture" in their titles.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 25 daily lecture was suspended; diarist officials still bore the two characters "daily lecture" in their titles.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，省起居注館，改隸內閣，遇理事日，以翰林官五人侍班。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year the Diarist Hall was abolished and placed under the Grand Secretariat; on days of business five Hanlin officials served on duty.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 57 the Diarist Hall was abolished and placed under the Grand Secretariat; on days of business five Hanlin officials served on duty.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，復置日講起居注，滿洲六人，漢十有二人。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 1 daily-lecture diarists were restored: six Manchus, twelve Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 daily-lecture diarists were restored: six Manchus and twelve Chinese.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，增滿員二人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1 two Manchu posts were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 two Manchu posts were added.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年，復增滿員二人。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 8 two more Manchu posts were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 8 two more Manchu posts were added.

sentences.zh: 於是日講、起居注合而為一。

translations.literal: Daily lecture and diarist duties were thus united as one.
translations.idiomatic: Daily lecture and diarist duties were thus united as one.

sentences.zh: 詹事府詹事，正三品。

translations.literal: Tutor of the Heir Apparent, third positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The tutor of the Heir Apparent held the third positive rank.

sentences.zh: 少詹事，正四品。

translations.literal: Junior tutor, fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The junior tutor held the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 左春坊左庶子，正五品。

translations.literal: Left sub-tutor of the Eastern Quarters, fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The left sub-tutor of the Eastern Quarters held the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 左中允，正六品。

translations.literal: Left attendant, sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The left attendant held the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 左贊善，從六品。

translations.literal: Left adviser, sixth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The left adviser held the sixth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 右春坊右庶子，右中允，右贊善，品秩俱同左。

translations.literal: Right sub-tutor of the Western Quarters, right attendant, and right adviser — ranks all the same as the left.
translations.idiomatic: The right sub-tutor of the Western Quarters, right attendant, and right adviser held the same ranks as their left counterparts.

sentences.zh: 司經局洗馬，從五品。

translations.literal: Master of Classics groom, fifth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The master of classics groom held the fifth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 其屬：主簿□主簿，從七品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: secretaries [character missing] secretaries, seventh subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates were two secretary posts (a character is missing in the source), of the seventh subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲六人。

translations.literal: Clerks: six Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Manchu clerks.

sentences.zh: 詹事、少詹事掌文學侍從。

translations.literal: The tutor and junior tutor managed literary attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The tutor and junior tutor managed literary attendance on the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 經筵充日講官。

translations.literal: At the Classics Mat they served as daily-lecture officials.
translations.idiomatic: At the Classics Mat they served as daily-lecture officials.

sentences.zh: 編纂書籍，典試提學，如翰林。

translations.literal: They compiled books, presided over examinations, and served as education intendant, like Hanlin officials.
translations.idiomatic: They compiled books, presided over examinations, and served as education intendant, like Hanlin officials.

sentences.zh: 並豫秋錄大典。

translations.literal: They also participated in autumn examination review and the palace examination grand ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: They also participated in autumn examination review and the palace examination grand ceremony.

sentences.zh: 左、右春坊各官掌記注撰文。

translations.literal: Officials of the left and right quarters managed recording and drafting.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the left and right quarters managed recording and drafting.

sentences.zh: 洗馬掌圖書經籍。

translations.literal: The master of classics groom managed books and classics.
translations.idiomatic: The master of classics groom managed books and classical texts.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌文移案牘。

translations.literal: The secretary managed documents and case files.
translations.idiomatic: The secretary managed documents and case files.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，置少詹事一人，掌府事。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 one junior tutor was established to manage household affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 one junior tutor was established to manage household affairs.

sentences.zh: 其冬省入內三院。

translations.literal: That winter it was abolished and absorbed into the Three Inner Courts.
translations.idiomatic: That winter it was abolished and absorbed into the Three Inner Courts.

sentences.zh: 九年，復置詹事一人，少詹事二人，主簿一人，錄事、通事舍人各二人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year one tutor, two junior tutors, one secretary, and two recorders and two interpreter attendants each were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 one tutor, two junior tutors, one secretary, and two recorders and two interpreter attendants apiece were restored.

sentences.zh: 並從九品。

translations.literal: All were ninth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: All held the ninth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 左、右春坊庶子、諭德各一人，中允、贊善各二人，司經局洗馬一人，正字二人，從九品。

translations.literal: Left and right sub-tutors and preceptors one each, attendants and advisers two each, one master of classics groom, two orthographers — all ninth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one left and one right sub-tutor and preceptor, two attendants and two advisers apiece, one master of classics groom, and two orthographers — all of the ninth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 俱漢人為之，令內三院官兼攝。

translations.literal: All were filled by Chinese, with Three Inner Court officials ordered to hold the posts concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: All were filled by Chinese officials, with Three Inner Court officials ordered to hold the posts concurrently.

sentences.zh: 專置滿洲詹事一人，掌府印。

translations.literal: One Manchu tutor was separately established to hold the household seal.
translations.idiomatic: One Manchu tutor was separately established to hold the household seal.

sentences.zh: 十五年，省詹事府官。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Heir Apparent household officials were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 Heir Apparent household officials were abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，復置滿、漢詹事各一人，漢員兼翰林院侍讀學士銜。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 14 one Manchu and one Chinese tutor were restored; the Chinese incumbent concurrently held Hanlin reader-expositor rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 one Manchu and one Chinese tutor were restored; the Chinese incumbent concurrently held Hanlin reader-expositor rank.

sentences.zh: 少詹事各二人，漢員兼翰林院侍講學士銜。

translations.literal: Two junior tutors each; Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin exposition lecturer rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were two junior tutors apiece; Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin exposition lecturer rank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年省滿員一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year one Manchu post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 one Manchu post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年省漢員一人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 one Chinese post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 one Chinese post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 主簿各一人，錄事各二人。

translations.literal: One secretary each, two recorders each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one secretary and two recorders apiece.

sentences.zh: 三十七年省滿缺，留漢一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year the Manchu slot was abolished, leaving one Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 the Manchu slot was abolished, leaving one Chinese secretary.

sentences.zh: 五十二年俱省。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 左、右春坊置滿、漢左、右庶子各一人，滿員以四品冠帶食五品俸，左、右同。

translations.literal: Left and right quarters established one Manchu and one Chinese left and right sub-tutor each; Manchu incumbents wore fourth-rank insignia and received fifth-rank salary; left and right were the same.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right quarters each had one Manchu and one Chinese left and right sub-tutor; Manchu incumbents wore fourth-rank insignia and received fifth-rank salary, the same for left and right.

sentences.zh: 漢左庶子兼翰林院侍讀銜，右庶子兼翰林院侍講銜。

translations.literal: The Chinese left sub-tutor concurrently held Hanlin reader rank; the right sub-tutor concurrently held Hanlin lecturer rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Chinese left sub-tutor concurrently held Hanlin reader rank; the right sub-tutor concurrently held Hanlin lecturer rank.

sentences.zh: 左、右諭德各一人，漢員兼翰林院修撰銜。

translations.literal: One left and one right preceptor each; Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin compiler rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one left and one right preceptor apiece; Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin compiler rank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年省滿右諭德一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year one Manchu right preceptor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 one Manchu right preceptor was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五十七年省漢右諭德一人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year one Chinese right preceptor was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 57 one Chinese right preceptor was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年俱省。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 13 all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 左、右中允各二人，滿員以五品冠帶食六品俸。

translations.literal: Two left and two right attendants each; Manchu incumbents wore fifth-rank insignia and received sixth-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: There were two left and two right attendants apiece; Manchu incumbents wore fifth-rank insignia and received sixth-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 漢員兼翰林院編修銜。

translations.literal: Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin reviser rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin reviser rank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年省滿員各一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year one Manchu post was abolished in each category.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 one Manchu post was abolished in each category.

sentences.zh: 明年，省漢右中允一人。

translations.literal: The next year one Chinese right attendant was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year one Chinese right attendant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五十二年省漢左中允一人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year one Chinese left attendant was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 one Chinese left attendant was abolished.

sentences.zh: 左、右贊善各二人。

translations.literal: Two left and two right advisers each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two left and two right advisers apiece.

sentences.zh: 漢員兼翰林院檢討銜。

translations.literal: Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin expositor rank.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese incumbents concurrently held Hanlin expositor rank.

sentences.zh: 三十七年省滿員各一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year one Manchu post was abolished in each category.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 one Manchu post was abolished in each category.

sentences.zh: 明年，省漢右贊善一人。

translations.literal: The next year one Chinese right adviser was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year one Chinese right adviser was abolished.

sentences.zh: 五十二年省漢左贊善一人。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year one Chinese left adviser was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 one Chinese left adviser was abolished.

sentences.zh: 司經局滿、漢洗馬各一人，漢員兼翰林院修撰銜。

translations.literal: Master of Classics Bureau: one Manchu and one Chinese master of classics groom each; the Chinese incumbent concurrently held Hanlin compiler rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Classics Bureau had one Manchu and one Chinese master of classics groom apiece; the Chinese incumbent concurrently held Hanlin compiler rank.

sentences.zh: 以上各兼銜，俱乾隆五十四年停。

translations.literal: All concurrent ranks above were discontinued in Qianlong 54.
translations.idiomatic: All concurrent ranks above were discontinued in Qianlong 54.

sentences.zh: 正字各二人。

translations.literal: Two orthographers each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two orthographers apiece.

sentences.zh: 三十七年省滿員缺。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year the Manchu slot was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 37 the Manchu slot was abolished.

sentences.zh: 明年，省漢一人。

translations.literal: The next year one Chinese post was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The next year one Chinese post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 例以應選內閣中書者除授，遂為中書兼銜。

translations.literal: By precedent those selected as grand secretariat secretaries were appointed, thus becoming concurrent secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent those selected as grand secretariat secretaries were appointed, thus becoming concurrent secretaries.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年俱省。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 36 all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36 all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，命詹事湯斌、少詹事耿介等為皇太子講官，尚沿宮僚舊制。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Tutor Tang Bin, Junior Tutor Geng Jie, and others were ordered to serve as lecturers to the crown prince, still following the old palace staff system.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 25 Tutor Tang Bin, Junior Tutor Geng Jie, and others were ordered to serve as lecturers to the crown prince, still following the old palace staff system.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，命徐元夢入直上書房，皇子在上書房讀書，選翰林官分侍講讀，簡大臣為總師傅。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Xu Yuanmeng was ordered to attend duty in the Master-of-Writings Study; princes studied in the Master-of-Writings Study, Hanlin officials were selected to serve in rotation for lecture and reading, and senior ministers were chosen as chief tutors.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 31 Xu Yuanmeng was ordered to attend duty in the Master-of-Writings Study; princes studied there, Hanlin officials were selected to serve in rotation for lecture and reading, and senior ministers were chosen as chief tutors.

sentences.zh: 總師傅之稱，自乾隆二十二年以介福、觀保等為總師傅始，曩時俱稱入直。

translations.literal: The title chief tutor began in Qianlong 22 when Jiefu, Guanbao, and others were made chief tutors; previously all were called attending duty.
translations.idiomatic: The title chief tutor began in Qianlong 22 when Jiefu, Guanbao, and others were made chief tutors; previously all were called attending duty.

sentences.zh: 嗣是本府坊、局止備詞臣遷轉之階。

translations.literal: Thereafter the quarters and bureaus of this household served only as steps for literary officials' promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the quarters and bureaus of this household served only as steps for literary officials' promotion.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，以府事改隸翰林院。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 2 household affairs were transferred to the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 household affairs were transferred to the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 五年，復舊制。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 the old system was restored.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，仍省入翰林院，尋復故。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 24 it was again abolished and absorbed into the Hanlin Academy, but soon restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 it was again abolished and absorbed into the Hanlin Academy, but was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，再省入。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year it was again abolished and absorbed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28 it was again abolished and absorbed into the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 太常寺管理寺事大臣一人。

translations.literal: One minister managing Court of Imperial Sacrifices affairs.
translations.idiomatic: There was one minister managing Court of Imperial Sacrifices affairs.

sentences.zh: 滿洲禮部尚書兼。

translations.literal: Held concurrently by the Manchu minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The post was held concurrently by the Manchu minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 卿，正三品。

translations.literal: Director, third positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The director held the third positive rank.

sentences.zh: 少卿，正四品。

translations.literal: Vice director, fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director held the fourth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 其屬：寺丞，正六品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: court director assistants, sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates were court director assistants of the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各二人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus and two Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus and two Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 贊禮郎，宗室二人，滿、漢二十有八人；

translations.literal: Sacrifice officiants: two imperial clansmen, twenty-eight Manchus and Chinese;
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice officiants numbered two imperial clansmen and twenty-eight Manchus and Chinese;

sentences.zh: 初制，滿員四品。

translations.literal: under the original system, Manchu incumbents rank 4a.
translations.idiomatic: under the original system Manchu incumbents held the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 順治十六年改九品。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 16 changed to the ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 they were reduced to the ninth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年升六品，六年升五品，九年仍改九品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 4 raised to the sixth rank; in Kangxi 6 to the fifth; in Kangxi 9 again changed to the ninth.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 they were raised to the sixth rank; in Kangxi 6 to the fifth; in Kangxi 9 again to the ninth.

sentences.zh: 尋定由護軍校、驍騎校選授者六品職銜，八品筆帖式、庫監生選授者八品職銜，無品筆帖式、庫使、前鋒護軍選授者九品職銜。

translations.literal: Soon fixed: those selected from company commanders and brigade commanders held sixth-rank title; eighth-rank clerks and warehouse students held eighth-rank title; rankless clerks, warehouse keepers, and vanguard guardsmen held ninth-rank title.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it was fixed that appointees drawn from company commanders and brigade commanders held sixth-rank title; eighth-rank clerks and warehouse students held eighth-rank title; and rankless clerks, warehouse keepers, and vanguard guardsmen held ninth-rank title.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年改定以六品冠帶食七品俸。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1 fixed to wear sixth-rank insignia and receive seventh-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 they were fixed to wear sixth-rank insignia and receive seventh-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 學習，宗室四人，滿洲五人，漢十有四人。

translations.literal: Trainees: four imperial clansmen, five Manchus, fourteen Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: Trainees numbered four imperial clansmen, five Manchus, and fourteen Chinese.

sentences.zh: 正九品。

translations.literal: Ninth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: They held the ninth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 讀祝官，宗室一人，滿洲十有一人；

translations.literal: Prayer readers: one imperial clansman, eleven Manchus;
translations.idiomatic: Prayer readers numbered one imperial clansman and eleven Manchus;

sentences.zh: 初制五品。

translations.literal: under the original system, fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: under the original system they held the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年改正九品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 changed to the ninth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 they were fixed at the ninth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 尋定品秩如贊禮郎，視出身為差。

translations.literal: Soon ranks were fixed like sacrifice officiants, varying by origin of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Soon ranks were fixed like those of sacrifice officiants, varying by origin of appointment.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年改定以六品冠帶食七品俸。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1 fixed to wear sixth-rank insignia and receive seventh-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 they were fixed to wear sixth-rank insignia and receive seventh-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 學習，宗室三人，滿洲五人。

translations.literal: Trainees: three imperial clansmen, five Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: Trainees numbered three imperial clansmen and five Manchus.

sentences.zh: 正九品。

translations.literal: Ninth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: They held the ninth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 博士□博士，滿洲、漢軍、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Erudites [character missing] erudites: one Manchu, one Chinese Bannerman, and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: Two erudite posts (a character is missing in the source): one Manchu, one Chinese Bannerman, and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 典簿□典簿，滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: Archive clerks [character missing] archive clerks, one Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: Two archive clerk posts (a character is missing in the source), one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 滿洲司庫一人，博士以下並正七品。

translations.literal: One Manchu warehouse manager; from erudites downward all were seventh positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu warehouse manager; from erudites downward all held the seventh positive rank.

sentences.zh: 庫使二人。

translations.literal: Two warehouse keepers.
translations.idiomatic: There were two warehouse keepers.

sentences.zh: 正九品。

translations.literal: Ninth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: They held the ninth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿洲九人，漢軍一人。

translations.literal: Clerks: nine Manchus, one Chinese Bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: There were nine Manchu clerks and one Chinese Banner clerk.

sentences.zh: 卿掌典守壇壝廟社，以歲時序祭祀，詔禮節，供品物，辨器類。

translations.literal: The director managed custody of altars, enclosures, temples, and shrines, ordering sacrifices by season, proclaiming ritual forms, supplying offerings, and distinguishing vessel types.
translations.idiomatic: The director managed custody of altars, enclosures, temples, and shrines, ordering sacrifices by season, proclaiming ritual forms, supplying offerings, and distinguishing vessel types.

sentences.zh: 前期奉祝版，稽百官齋戒，祭日帥屬以供事。

translations.literal: Beforehand he presented prayer boards, checked officials' fasting and abstinence, and on the sacrifice day led subordinates in service.
translations.idiomatic: Beforehand he presented prayer boards, checked officials' fasting and abstinence, and on the sacrifice day led subordinates in service.

sentences.zh: 少卿佐之。

translations.literal: The vice director assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director assisted him.

sentences.zh: 寺丞掌祭祀品式，辨職事以詔有司，並遴補吏員，勾稽廩餼。

translations.literal: Court director assistants managed sacrifice forms and offerings, distinguished duties to instruct responsible officials, selected and filled staff posts, and audited provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Court director assistants managed sacrifice forms and offerings, distinguished duties to instruct responsible officials, selected and filled staff posts, and audited provisions.

sentences.zh: 贊禮郎、讀祝官分掌相儀序事，備物絜器，並習趨蹌讀祝，祭祀各充執事。

translations.literal: Sacrifice officiants and prayer readers separately managed ritual guidance and ordering affairs, prepared objects and purified vessels, practiced deportment and prayer reading, and each served as ritual officers at sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice officiants and prayer readers separately managed ritual guidance and ordering affairs, prepared objects and purified vessels, practiced deportment and prayer reading, and each served as ritual officers at sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 博士考祝文禮節，著籍為式，壇廟陳序畢，引禮部侍郎省□，並歲覈祀賦。

translations.literal: Erudites examined prayer texts and ritual forms, registered them as models; when altars and temples were fully arranged they led the vice minister of Rites in inspection [character missing], and annually audited sacrificial levies.
translations.idiomatic: Erudites examined prayer texts and ritual forms and registered them as models; when altars and temples were fully arranged they led the vice minister of Rites in inspection (a character is missing in the source), and annually audited sacrificial levies.

sentences.zh: 典簿掌察祭品，陳牲牢，治吏役。

translations.literal: Archive clerks inspected sacrificial offerings, arranged sacrificial animals, and managed runners and clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Archive clerks inspected sacrificial offerings, arranged sacrificial animals, and managed runners and clerks.

sentences.zh: 庫使掌守庫藏。

translations.idiomatic: Heralds numbered sixteen Manchus; in Qianlong 37 two were transferred to the Imperial Procession Guard.

translations.idiomatic: Trainee ushers had no fixed quota.

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 it was fixed that they were selected by examination from Confucian students of Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9 the quota was fixed at twelve.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 the quota was fixed at six for Zhili and two each for the other provinces.

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year four posts from Shandong and other provinces abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 four posts from Shandong and the other provinces were abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡事由禮部具題，十六年改歸本寺，十八年仍隸禮部。

translations.idiomatic: All affairs were submitted by memorial through the Ministry of Rites; in Shunzhi 16 they were transferred to this court; in Shunzhi 18 the court was again subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10 the former system was restored; in Yongzheng 4 the court was again placed under Ministry of Rites jurisdiction.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 a Manchu minister was first appointed to head court affairs.

translations.idiomatic: There was one minister managing Directorate of Education affairs.

translations.idiomatic: Later both were changed to the seventh positive rank.

translations.idiomatic: Two erudite posts (a character is missing in the source), of the seventh subordinate rank.

translations.idiomatic: Under the original system Chinese incumbents held the eighth rank.

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1 changed to match Manchu incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 Chinese incumbents were brought into line with Manchu incumbents.

sentences.zh: 典簿□典簿，從八品。

translations.literal: Archive clerks [character missing] archive clerks, eighth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two archive clerk posts (a character is missing in the source), of the eighth subordinate rank.

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: In each case there was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

translations.idiomatic: Two archivist posts (a character is missing in the source), of the ninth subordinate rank.

translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese archivist.

sentences.zh: 率性、修道、誠心、正義、崇志、廣業六堂：助教，初制，從八品。

translations.literal: The six halls—Following Nature, Cultivating the Way, Sincere Heart, Upright Principle, Elevating Aspiration, and Broad Achievement: instructors, under the original system eighth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The six halls—Following Nature, Cultivating the Way, Sincere Heart, Upright Principle, Elevating Aspiration, and Broad Achievement—had instructors who originally held the eighth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年升從七品。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1 raised to the seventh subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 they were raised to the seventh subordinate rank.

translations.literal: Student directors and student registrars: the four halls Following Nature, Cultivating the Way, Sincere Heart, and Upright Principle were called student directors; the two halls Elevating Aspiration and Broad Achievement were called student registrars.
translations.idiomatic: Student directors and student registrars: the four halls Following Nature, Cultivating the Way, Sincere Heart, and Upright Principle had student directors; the two halls Elevating Aspiration and Broad Achievement had student registrars.

sentences.zh: 初制，學正正九品，學錄從九品。

translations.literal: Under the original system student directors ninth positive rank, student registrars ninth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system student directors held the ninth positive rank and student registrars the ninth subordinate rank.

translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 both were raised to the eighth positive rank.

translations.idiomatic: There was one of each.

translations.idiomatic: Banner official-school instructors numbered two Manchus and one Mongol in each school.

translations.idiomatic: Teachers numbered one Manchu, two Mongols, and four Chinese in each case.

sentences.zh: 祭酒、司業掌成均之法。

translations.idiomatic: The chancellor and vice chancellor managed Imperial Academy standards.

translations.idiomatic: For all state students and selected talents they delivered instruction on schedule and ranked performance as superior or inferior.

sentences.zh: 歲仲春、秋上丁，釋奠，釋菜，綜典禮儀。

translations.idiomatic: Each year on the first ding day of mid-spring and mid-autumn they performed the meat and vegetable offerings and managed all ritual forms.

translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited the Academy, he lectured on the classics and led students to the circular bridge to observe and listen.

translations.idiomatic: Newly advanced jinshi leaving student garb sat in the Hall of Constant Order to perform the bowing and flower-pinning rite.

translations.idiomatic: Director assistants issued regulations, checked diligence and idleness, equalized provisions, audited disbursements, and recorded Banner teachers' merits and faults.

translations.idiomatic: Erudites managed teaching by classic division, examined examination essays, and together with instructors, student directors, and student registrars managed Southern Academy affairs.

translations.idiomatic: The Document Room and Funds Office also had staff detailed to manage their affairs (a character is missing in the source).

translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchu vice chancellors; in Qianlong 13 one post was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: There was one Mongol and one Chinese apiece, each concurrently holding Court of Imperial Sacrifices court director assistant rank.

translations.idiomatic: Later the concurrent rank was discontinued.

translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese director assistant and archive clerk apiece, and three Chinese erudites.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 10 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十二年省一人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 52 one post abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 52 one post was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: Banner official schools were established with sixteen Manchu instructors; in Kangxi 57 four posts were abolished.

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year four posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 18 four posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年復故。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 3 restored to the former quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 the former quota was restored.

translations.idiomatic: Six halls were separately established with Manchu and Chinese instructors; in Shunzhi 15 six posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十七年省四人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 57 four posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 57 four posts were abolished.

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 four posts were added again.

translations.literal: Twelve each;

translations.idiomatic: There was one archivist.

translations.idiomatic: It was subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 the former system was restored.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 one Manchu erudite was established.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 2 it was again subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10 it was again returned to this directorate.

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 an edict ordered that director assistants and other posts cease purchase appointments.

translations.literal: The next year a senior minister was specially selected to manage directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The next year a senior minister was specially selected to manage directorate affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，建南學。

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 the Southern Academy was established.

translations.literal: Those pursuing studies within the academy were the Southern Academy; those pursuing studies outside who came to the academy for examinations were the Northern Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Students pursuing their studies within the academy formed the Southern Academy; those pursuing studies elsewhere who came to the academy for examinations formed the Northern Academy.

translations.literal: When the High Emperor took the throne he favored Confucian learning in governance; Grand Secretary Zhao Guolin, Minister Yang Shi, and Sun Jiagan headed Imperial Academy affairs, while Guan Xianyao, Zhuang Hengyang, and others jointly managed the six halls—they were called the Four Worthies and Five Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozong took the throne he favored Confucian learning in governance; Grand Secretary Zhao Guolin, Minister Yang Shi, and Sun Jiagan headed Imperial Academy affairs, while Guan Xianyao, Zhuang Hengyang, and others jointly managed the six halls—they were known as the Four Worthies and Five Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十八年，建辟雍於集賢門，國學規制斯為隆備。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 48 the walled academy was built at the Gate of Assembled Worthies, and Imperial Academy regulations reached their fullest form.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48 the walled academy was built at the Gate of Assembled Worthies, and Imperial Academy regulations reached their fullest form.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，以成均風勵中外，詔監臣無曠厥職。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 3, because Imperial Academy standards inspired court and country alike, an edict ordered directorate officials not to neglect their duties.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3, because Imperial Academy standards inspired court and country alike, an edict ordered directorate officials not to neglect their duties.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十三年，省入學部。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 33 abolished and absorbed into the Ministry of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33 (1907) the directorate was abolished and absorbed into the Ministry of Education.

sentences.zh: 嗣以文廟、辟雍典禮隆重，特置國子丞以次各官，分治其事。

translations.literal: Later, because Confucian temple and walled academy ceremonies were solemn, State Academy director and subordinate officials were specially established to divide management of their affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because Confucian temple and walled academy ceremonies were solemn, a State Academy director and subordinate officials were specially established to divide management of their affairs.

sentences.zh: 初制，詔各省選諸生文行兼優者，與鄉試副榜貢生，入監肄業。

translations.literal: Under the original system an edict ordered each province to select students of combined literary and moral excellence, together with provincial examination associate-list tribute graduates, to enter the directorate for study.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system an edict ordered each province to select students of combined literary and moral excellence, together with provincial examination associate-list tribute graduates, to enter the directorate for study.

sentences.zh: 聖祖初政，給事中晏楚瀾疏停鄉試副榜貢生，遂不復舉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Sacred Ancestor's reign, supervising secretary Yan Chulan memorialized to stop provincial examination associate-list tribute graduates, and the practice was not resumed.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Shengzu's reign, supervising secretary Yan Chulan memorialized to stop provincial examination associate-list tribute graduates, and the practice was not resumed.

sentences.zh: 康熙五年，徐元文為祭酒，始請學政間歲一舉優生，鄉試仍取副榜，自是為恆制。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 5, when Xu Yuanwen was chancellor, he first requested that education commissioners every other year recommend outstanding students and provincial examinations again take the associate list—this became the permanent system.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 5, when Xu Yuanwen was chancellor, he first requested that education commissioners every other year recommend outstanding students and that provincial examinations again take the associate list—this became the permanent system.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，並推廣舉人入監，時風稍振。

translations.literal: During the Guangxu period juren entry to the directorate was also expanded, and scholarly morale revived somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: During the Guangxu period juren entry to the directorate was also expanded, and scholarly morale revived somewhat.

sentences.zh: 未幾科舉廢，此制替已。

translations.literal: Before long the examination system was abolished and this institution ended.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the examination system was abolished and this institution ended.

sentences.zh: 衍聖公孔氏世襲。

translations.literal: Duke Yansheng of the Kong clan, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke Yansheng of the Kong clan was hereditary.

sentences.zh: 正一品。

translations.literal: First positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The title held the first positive rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，授孔子六十五世孫允植襲封。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 Confucius's sixty-fifth-generation descendant Yunzhi was invested with the hereditary title.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 Confucius's sixty-fifth-generation descendant Yunzhi was invested with the hereditary title.

sentences.zh: 其屬：司樂，典籍，屯田管勾，俱由衍聖公保舉題授。

translations.literal: Subordinates: director of music, archivist, and field-estate manager—all recommended and appointed by memorial through the Duke Yansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Among his subordinates were the director of music, archivist, and field-estate manager—all recommended and appointed by memorial through the Duke Yansheng.

sentences.zh: 管勾之屬，屯官八人，分掌鉅野、鄆城、平陽、東阿、獨山五屯。

translations.literal: Under the field-estate manager: eight field officials divided management of the five estates at Juye, Yuncheng, Pingyang, Dong'e, and Dushan.
translations.idiomatic: Under the field-estate manager were eight field officials who divided management of the five estates at Juye, Yuncheng, Pingyang, Dong'e, and Dushan.

sentences.zh: 林廟守衛司百戶，秩視衛守備。

translations.literal: Forest and temple guard company commander, rank equivalent to garrison commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The forest and temple guard company commander held rank equivalent to a garrison commandant.

sentences.zh: 以上為兵、農、禮、樂四司。

translations.literal: The above formed the four bureaus of military, agriculture, rites, and music.
translations.idiomatic: The above formed the four bureaus of military, agriculture, rites, and music.

sentences.zh: 知印，掌書，書寫，奏差，啟事，各一人。

translations.literal: Seal keeper, chief secretary, scribe, memorial courier, and aide: one each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one seal keeper, chief secretary, scribe, memorial courier, and aide apiece.

sentences.zh: 隨朝伴官六人。

translations.literal: Six court-attending companion officials.
translations.idiomatic: There were six court-attending companion officials.

translations.literal: Under the original system one.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system there was one.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十五年定為六人。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 15 fixed at six.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 15 the quota was fixed at six.

translations.idiomatic: From the director of music downward, all held the seventh positive rank and were recommended and appointed or supplemented by memorial through the Duke Yansheng.

translations.idiomatic: There were forty ritual officers of the Sage's temple.

translations.idiomatic: There were two third rank, four fourth rank, six fifth rank, eight seventh rank, ten eighth rank, and ten ninth rank; they were selected and filled by the Duke Yansheng together with the Shandong education commissioner from Kong clansmen.

sentences.zh: 翰林院世襲五經博士，正八品。

translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academy hereditary erudites of the Five Classics held the eighth positive rank.

translations.literal: One from the southern branch.
translations.idiomatic: One post was held by the southern branch.

translations.idiomatic: After Ming Yancheng received appointment, the title went unclaimed for several generations.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 41 Confucius's sixty-sixth-generation descendant Xingling was first appointed to maintain the Quzhou temple sacrifice.

translations.idiomatic: For the Dongye clan: in Kangxi 23 Yuan Sage Duke of Zhou's seventy-third-generation descendant Dongye Peiran was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Ji clan: in Qianlong 43 Duke of Zhou's seventy-seventh-generation descendant Zhaoxun was appointed to maintain the Xianyang temple sacrifice.

translations.idiomatic: For the Yan clan: in Shunzhi 1 Restored Sage Master Yan Yuan's sixty-eighth-generation descendant Shaoxu was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Zeng clan: in Shunzhi 1 Sage Ancestor Master Zeng Yu's sixty-fourth-generation descendant Wenda was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Meng clan: in Shunzhi 1 Second Sage Master Meng Ziyu's sixty-third-generation descendant Zhenren was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Zhong clan: in Shunzhi 2 Venerated Sage Zhongzi Lu's sixty-first-generation descendant Yusheng was appointed.

sentences.zh: 閔氏、康熙三十八年，授先賢閔子騫六十五世孫衍籀。

translations.idiomatic: For the Min clan: in Kangxi 38 Venerated Sage Minzi Qian's sixty-fifth-generation descendant Yanshou was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Ran clan: in Yongzheng 2 Venerated Sage Ranzi Boniu's sixty-fifth-generation descendant Shipu was appointed.

sentences.zh: 冉氏、雍正二年，授先賢冉子仲弓六十七世孫天琳。

translations.idiomatic: For the Ran clan: in Yongzheng 2 Venerated Sage Ranzi Zhonggong's sixty-seventh-generation descendant Tianlin was appointed.

translations.literal: Duanmu clan: in Kangxi 38 Venerated Sage Duanmuzi Gong's seventieth-generation descendant Qian was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Duanmu clan: in Kangxi 38 Venerated Sage Duanmuzi Gong's seventieth-generation descendant Qian was appointed.

sentences.zh: 卜氏、康熙五十九年，授先賢卜子夏六十四世孫尊賢。

translations.idiomatic: For the Bu clan: in Kangxi 59 Venerated Sage Buzi Xia's sixty-fourth-generation descendant Zunxian was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Yan clan: in Kangxi 51 Venerated Sage Yanzi You's seventy-third-generation descendant Dejian was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Zhuansun clan: in Yongzheng 2 Venerated Sage Zhuansunzi Zhang's sixty-sixth-generation descendant Chengdao was appointed; in Daoguang 4 the title passed to the eldest legitimate son Shuxun.

translations.idiomatic: For the You clan: in Qianlong 53 Venerated Sage Youzi Ruo's seventy-second-generation descendant Shouye was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: For the Fu clan: in Jiaqing 10 Venerated Scholar Fuzi Sheng's sixty-fifth-generation descendant Jingzu was appointed.

sentences.zh: 韓氏、乾隆三年，授先儒韓子愈三十世孫法祖。

translations.idiomatic: For the Han clan: in Qianlong 3 Venerated Scholar Hanzi Yu's thirtieth-generation descendant Fazu was appointed.

sentences.zh: 張氏、康熙二十六年，授先儒張子載二十八世孫守先，主鳳翔廟祀。

translations.literal: Zhang clan: in Kangxi 26 Venerated Scholar Zhangzi Zai's twenty-eighth-generation descendant Shouxian was appointed to maintain the Fengxiang temple sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: For the Zhang clan: in Kangxi 26 Venerated Scholar Zhangzi Zai's twenty-eighth-generation descendant Shouxian was appointed to maintain the Fengxiang temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 邵氏，康熙四十一年，授先儒邵子雍三十世孫延祀。

translations.literal: Shao clan: in Kangxi 41 Venerated Scholar Shaozi Yong's thirtieth-generation descendant Yansi was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Shao clan: in Kangxi 41 Venerated Scholar Shaozi Yong's thirtieth-generation descendant Yansi was appointed.

sentences.zh: 俱各一人。

translations.literal: One each in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: In each case there was one.

sentences.zh: 硃氏二人。

translations.literal: Two Zhu clan posts.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Zhu clan posts.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，授先儒硃子熹徽派十五世孫煌，奉婺源廟祀。

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 Venerated Scholar Zhuzi Xi's Huizhou branch fifteenth-generation descendant Huang was appointed to maintain the Wuyuan temple sacrifice.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 29 the Fujian branch eighteenth-generation descendant Rong was appointed to maintain the Jian'an temple sacrifice.

translations.idiomatic: There were three Guan clan posts.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 58 Lord Guan Yu's fifty-seventh-generation descendant Wei was appointed to maintain the Luoyang temple sacrifice.

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 4 the fifty-second-generation descendant Jubin was appointed to maintain the Jiezhou temple sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 the fifty-second-generation descendant Jubin was appointed to maintain the Jiezhou temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授五十二世孫朝泰，主當陽廟祀。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the fifty-second-generation descendant Chaotai was appointed to maintain the Dangyang temple sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 the fifty-second-generation descendant Chaotai was appointed to maintain the Dangyang temple sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其屬於孔氏者，又有太常寺世襲博士一人；

translations.literal: Among those belonging to the Kong clan there was also one hereditary Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite;
translations.idiomatic: Among Kong clan offices there was also one hereditary Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite;

sentences.zh: 正七品。

translations.literal: Seventh positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The post held the seventh positive rank.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 Kong Yunming was temporarily appointed to maintain the Shengze Academy sacrifice.

translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 26 the sixty-seventh-generation descendant Yucong was appointed.

sentences.zh: 國子監學正一人；

translations.literal: One Directorate of Education student director;
translations.idiomatic: There was one Directorate of Education student director;

translations.literal: Eighth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The post held the eighth positive rank.

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 8 the sixty-fifth-generation descendant Yunqi was appointed on the Duke Yansheng's recommendation.

sentences.zh: 尼山書院學錄，正八品。

translations.literal: Nishan Academy student registrar, eighth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Nishan Academy student registrar held the eighth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，授六十二世孫聞然，由衍聖公咨送弟侄題補。

translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 the sixty-second-generation descendant Wenran was appointed after the Duke Yansheng forwarded younger brothers and nephews for appointment by memorial.

sentences.zh: 洙泗書院學錄，順治元年，授六十四世孫尚澄。

translations.idiomatic: The Zhusi Academy student registrar: in Shunzhi 1 the sixty-fourth-generation descendant Shangcheng was appointed.

translations.idiomatic: Hereditary sixth-rank officials were selected and filled by the Duke Yansheng from clansmen.

sentences.zh: 各一人；

translations.literal: One each;
translations.idiomatic: There was one of each;

translations.idiomatic: Professors of the four clans Kong, Yan, Zeng, and Meng held the seventh positive rank.

translations.idiomatic: Student registrars were promoted after six years of salary service.

translations.idiomatic: Student registrars were forwarded by the Duke Yansheng from Kong clan students for appointment by memorial.

translations.literal: One each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one of each.

translations.idiomatic: The Duke Yansheng managed maintenance of the Supreme Sage's Qufu temple sacrifice.

translations.idiomatic: Hanlin erudites among sage and worthy descendants each managed maintenance of their forebears' sacrifices.

translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers managed secondary offerings at sacrifices and also handled goblets, silks, incense, and prayers.

translations.idiomatic: The director of music managed musical scores and instruments.

translations.idiomatic: The archivist managed books and ritual assistants.

translations.idiomatic: The field-estate manager managed receipts and disbursements of sacrificial field funds and grain.

translations.idiomatic: The memorial courier managed successive tables, letters, and memorials.

translations.idiomatic: Court-attending companion officials managed attendance at court audiences and related business.
