translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 the Duke Yansheng and the four clans' Hanlin erudites and other titles were restored; Kong Yunzhi was ordered to attend court audience and ranked above grand secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 the Duke Yansheng and the four clans' Hanlin erudites and other titles were restored; Kong Yunzhi was ordered to attend court audience and ranked above grand secretaries.

sentences.zh: 明年，改錫三台銀印。

translations.literal: The next year a three-tier silver seal was granted in place of the old one.
translations.idiomatic: The next year a three-tier silver seal was granted in place of the old one.

sentences.zh: 十六年改滿、漢文三台銀印。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year changed to a three-tier silver seal in Manchu and Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 it was changed to a three-tier silver seal in Manchu and Chinese.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年，復改清、漢篆文三台銀印。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 14 again changed to a three-tier silver seal in Manchu and Chinese seal script.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 14 it was again changed to a three-tier silver seal in Manchu and Chinese seal script.

sentences.zh: 九年，世祖視學釋奠，召衍聖公孔興燮及四氏博士赴京陪祀觀禮，自後以為常。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Founding Emperor visited the Academy for the meat offering; the Duke Yansheng Kong Xingxie and the four clans' erudites were summoned to the capital to attend sacrifice and observe the rite—this became regular practice thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 the Founding Emperor visited the Academy for the meat offering; the Duke Yansheng Kong Xingxie and the four clans' erudites were summoned to the capital to attend sacrifice and observe the rite—this became regular practice thereafter.

sentences.zh: 十三年，依例授光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, according to precedent, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 13, according to precedent, the title Grand Master of Splendid Happiness was conferred.

sentences.zh: 康熙六十一年，定錫廕視正一品，廕一子五品官，著為例。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 61 hereditary privilege was fixed equivalent to the first positive rank, ennobling one son as a fifth-rank official—established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 61 hereditary privilege was fixed equivalent to the first positive rank, ennobling one son as a fifth-rank official—established as precedent.

sentences.zh: 舊制，衍聖公錫廕依正二品。

translations.literal: Under the old system the Duke Yansheng's hereditary privilege followed the second positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system the Duke Yansheng's hereditary privilege followed the second positive rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，以崇奉祀典，廣置聖廟執事官，各按品級給予章服。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 8, to honor sacrificial rites, sage temple ritual officers were broadly established and insignia and robes were granted by rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8, to honor sacrificial rites, sage temple ritual officers were broadly established and insignia and robes were granted by rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，改世職知縣孔傳令為世襲六品官。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 21 the hereditary county magistrate Kong Chuanling was changed to a hereditary sixth-rank official.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 21 the hereditary county magistrate Kong Chuanling was changed to a hereditary sixth-rank official.

sentences.zh: 先是曲阜知縣為世職，由衍聖公選族人題授。

translations.literal: Previously the Qufu county magistrate was a hereditary post, selected from clansmen by the Duke Yansheng and appointed by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Qufu county magistrate was a hereditary post, selected from clansmen by the Duke Yansheng and appointed by memorial.

sentences.zh: 至是改為在外揀選調補。

translations.literal: At this point it was changed to selection and transfer from outside.
translations.idiomatic: At this point it was changed to selection and transfer from outside the clan.

sentences.zh: 五十年，詔：「博士有枉法婪贓革職治罪者，停其承襲。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year an edict said: "Erudites who violate law through corruption and are dismissed and punished shall have inheritance stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 50 an edict said: "Erudites who violate law through corruption and are dismissed and punished shall have inheritance stopped.

sentences.zh: 」定例衍聖公歸長子襲，北宗博士次子襲，太常博士三子襲，餘並以嫡子襲。

translations.literal: " It was fixed by precedent that the Duke Yansheng passed to the eldest son, the northern-branch erudite to the second son, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite to the third son, and all others to the eldest legitimate son.
translations.idiomatic: " It was fixed by precedent that the Duke Yansheng passed to the eldest son, the northern-branch erudite to the second son, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite to the third son, and all others to the eldest legitimate son.

sentences.zh: 東野氏及聖門各賢裔，由衍聖公達部上名，餘各報部雲。

translations.literal: The Dongye clan and worthy descendants of the Sage's gate submitted names to the ministry through the Duke Yansheng; the rest each reported to the ministry by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongye clan and worthy descendants of the Sage's gate submitted names to the ministry through the Duke Yansheng; the rest each reported to the ministry by memorial.

sentences.zh: 欽天監管理監事王大臣一人。

translations.literal: One minister managing Imperial Observatory affairs.
translations.idiomatic: There was one minister managing Imperial Observatory affairs.

sentences.zh: 特簡。

translations.literal: Specially selected.
translations.idiomatic: The post was specially selected.

sentences.zh: 監正，初制，滿員四品。

translations.literal: Director: under the original system Manchu incumbents fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The director: under the original system Manchu incumbents held the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年升三品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 raised to the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 the rank was raised to the third.

sentences.zh: 九年，滿、漢並定正五品。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Manchu and Chinese both fixed at the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 Manchu and Chinese directors were both fixed at the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 左、右監副，初制，五品。

translations.literal: Left and right vice directors: under the original system fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right vice directors originally held the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年升四品，九年定正六品。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 6 raised to the fourth rank; in Kangxi 9 fixed at the sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 they were raised to the fourth rank; in Kangxi 9 fixed at the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 其屬：主簿□主簿，正八品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: chief clerks [character missing] chief clerks, eighth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates were two chief clerk posts (a character is missing in the source), of the eighth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 時憲科五官正，從六品。

translations.literal: Time and Calendar Section office directors, sixth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Time and Calendar Section office directors held the sixth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、蒙各二人，漢軍一人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus and two Mongols each, one Chinese Bannerman.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus and two Mongols apiece, and one Chinese Bannerman.

sentences.zh: 春官正、夏官正、中官正、秋官正、冬官正，並從六品。

translations.literal: Directors of Spring, Summer, Center, Autumn, and Winter, all sixth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Directors of Spring, Summer, Center, Autumn, and Winter all held the sixth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese apiece.

sentences.zh: 司書，正九品。

translations.literal: Record keepers, ninth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Record keepers held the ninth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 漢一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese record keeper.

sentences.zh: 博士，從九品。

translations.literal: Erudites, ninth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Erudites held the ninth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲四人，蒙古二人，漢軍一人，漢十有六人。

translations.literal: Four Manchus, two Mongols, one Chinese Bannerman, sixteen Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Manchus, two Mongols, one Chinese Bannerman, and sixteen Chinese erudites.

sentences.zh: 天文科五官靈台郎，從七品。

translations.literal: Astronomy Section observatory platform officers, seventh subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy Section observatory platform officers held the seventh subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿洲二人，蒙古、漢軍各一人，漢四人。

translations.literal: Two Manchus, one Mongol, one Chinese Bannerman, four Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchus, one Mongol, one Chinese Bannerman, and four Chinese platform officers.

sentences.zh: 監候，正九品。

translations.literal: Observation officers, ninth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Observation officers held the ninth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 漢一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese observation officer.

sentences.zh: 博士，滿洲四人，漢二人。

translations.literal: Erudites: four Manchus, two Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were four Manchu erudites and two Chinese erudites.

sentences.zh: 漏刻科挈壺正，從八品。

translations.literal: Water Clock Section clepsydra directors, eighth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Water Clock Section clepsydra directors held the eighth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 滿、蒙各一人，漢二人。

translations.literal: One Manchu and one Mongol each, two Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Manchu and one Mongol apiece, and two Chinese clepsydra directors.

sentences.zh: 司晨，從九品。

translations.literal: Dawn announcers, ninth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn announcers held the ninth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 漢軍一人，漢七人。

translations.literal: One Chinese Bannerman, seven Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese Banner dawn announcer and seven Chinese dawn announcers.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式，滿州十有一人，蒙古四人，漢軍二人。

translations.literal: Clerks: eleven Manchus, four Mongols, two Chinese Bannermen.
translations.idiomatic: There were eleven Manchu clerks, four Mongol clerks, and two Chinese Banner clerks.

sentences.zh: 天文生，食九品俸。

translations.literal: Astronomy students received ninth-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy students received ninth-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 滿、蒙各十有六人，漢軍八人，漢二十有四人。

translations.literal: Sixteen Manchus and sixteen Mongols each, eight Chinese Bannermen, twenty-four Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were sixteen Manchus and sixteen Mongols apiece, eight Chinese Bannermen, and twenty-four Chinese astronomy students.

sentences.zh: 食糧天文生，漢五十有六人。

translations.literal: Salaried astronomy students: fifty-six Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were fifty-six salaried Chinese astronomy students.

sentences.zh: 食糧陰陽生，漢十人。

translations.literal: Salaried yin-yang students: ten Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten salaried Chinese yin-yang students.

sentences.zh: 並給九品冠帶。

translations.literal: All were granted ninth-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: All were granted ninth-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 助教□助教一人，教習二人。

translations.literal: Instructors [character missing] one instructor, two teachers.
translations.idiomatic: There was one instructor post (a character is missing in the source) and two teachers.

sentences.zh: 監正掌治術數，典歷象日月星辰，宿離不貸。

translations.literal: The director managed calendrical and mathematical arts, kept custody of celestial phenomena, sun, moon, and stars, and allowed no deviation in stellar positions.
translations.idiomatic: The director managed calendrical and mathematical arts, kept custody of celestial phenomena, sun, moon, and stars, and allowed no deviation in stellar positions.

sentences.zh: 歲終奏新歷，送禮部頒行。

translations.literal: At year's end he memorialized the new calendar and sent it to the Ministry of Rites for promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end he memorialized the new calendar and sent it to the Ministry of Rites for promulgation.

sentences.zh: 監副佐之。

translations.literal: The vice director assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The vice director assisted him.

sentences.zh: 時憲科掌推天行之度，驗歲差以均節氣，制時憲書，以國書、蒙文譯布者，滿、蒙五官正司之。

translations.literal: The Time and Calendar Section calculated celestial motion, verified annual difference to balance solar terms, and compiled the calendar; Manchu and Mongol office directors managed editions translated and issued in Manchu and Mongolian.
translations.idiomatic: The Time and Calendar Section calculated celestial motion, verified annual difference to balance solar terms, and compiled the calendar; Manchu and Mongol office directors managed editions translated and issued in Manchu and Mongolian.

sentences.zh: 推算日月交食、七政相距、沖退留伏、交宮同度，漢五官正司之。

translations.literal: Calculating solar and lunar eclipses, distances among the seven luminaries, conjunction, opposition, retrograde, stationary, and occultation, and zodiacal conjunction at the same degree—Chinese office directors managed these.
translations.idiomatic: Calculating solar and lunar eclipses, distances among the seven luminaries, conjunction, opposition, retrograde, stationary, and occultation, and zodiacal conjunction at the same degree was managed by Chinese office directors.

sentences.zh: 頒之四方。

translations.literal: They were promulgated to all regions.
translations.idiomatic: They were promulgated to all regions.

sentences.zh: 天文科掌觀天象，書雲物禨祥；

translations.literal: The Astronomy Section observed celestial phenomena and recorded clouds, objects, and omens;
translations.idiomatic: The Astronomy Section observed celestial phenomena and recorded clouds, objects, and omens;

sentences.zh: 率天文生登觀象台，凡晴雨、風雷、雲霓、暈珥、流星、異星，匯錄冊簿，應奏者送監，密疏上聞。

translations.literal: leading astronomy students to ascend the observatory platform; for rain, clear skies, wind, thunder, clouds, rainbows, halos, meteors, and unusual stars they compiled registers; what required memorializing was sent to the directorate and reported by confidential memorial.
translations.idiomatic: leading astronomy students to ascend the observatory platform; for rain, clear skies, wind, thunder, clouds, rainbows, halos, meteors, and unusual stars they compiled registers; what required memorializing was sent to the directorate and reported by confidential memorial.

sentences.zh: 漏刻科掌調壺漏，測中星，審緯度；

translations.literal: The Water Clock Section managed clepsydra adjustment, measured culmination stars, and verified latitude;
translations.idiomatic: The Water Clock Section managed clepsydra adjustment, measured culmination stars, and verified latitude;

sentences.zh: 祭祀、朝會、營建，諏吉日，辨禁忌。

translations.literal: for sacrifices, court assemblies, and construction it selected auspicious days and distinguished taboos.
translations.idiomatic: for sacrifices, court assemblies, and construction it selected auspicious days and distinguished taboos.

sentences.zh: 主簿掌章奏文移，簿籍員數。

translations.literal: Chief clerks managed memorials and documents and registers of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerks managed memorials and documents and registers of personnel.

sentences.zh: 天文生分隸三科，掌司觀候推算。

translations.literal: Astronomy students were divided among the three sections and managed observation and calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy students were divided among the three sections and managed observation and calculation.

sentences.zh: 陰陽生隸漏刻科，掌主譙樓直更，監官以時考其術業而進退之。

translations.literal: Yin-yang students were subordinate to the Water Clock Section, managing watchtower night watches; supervising officials periodically examined their skills and promoted or dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: Yin-yang students were subordinate to the Water Clock Section, managing watchtower night watches; supervising officials periodically examined their skills and promoted or dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 助教掌分教算學諸生。

translations.literal: Instructors managed separate instruction of mathematics students.
translations.idiomatic: Instructors managed separate instruction of mathematics students.

sentences.zh: 初，順治元年設欽天監，分天文、時憲、漏刻、回回四科，置監正、監副、五官正、保章正、挈壺正、靈台郎、監候、司晨、司書、博士、主簿等官，並漢人為之，行文具題隸禮部。

translations.literal: Initially, in Shunzhi 1 the Imperial Observatory was established with four sections—Astronomy, Time and Calendar, Water Clock, and Muslim—appointing director, vice director, office directors, observatory platform directors, clepsydra directors, platform officers, observation officers, dawn announcers, record keepers, erudites, chief clerks, and other posts, all held by Chinese, with routine business submitted by memorial and subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, in Shunzhi 1 the Imperial Observatory was established with four sections—Astronomy, Time and Calendar, Water Clock, and Muslim—appointing director, vice director, office directors, observatory platform directors, clepsydra directors, platform officers, observation officers, dawn announcers, record keepers, erudites, chief clerks, and other posts, all held by Chinese, with routine business submitted by memorial and subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 是歲仲秋朔日食，以西人湯若望推算密合，大統、回回兩法時刻俱差。

translations.literal: That year on the first day of mid-autumn there was a solar eclipse; the Western scholar Adam Schall's calculation matched closely, while the Great Unity and Muslim methods were both off in timing.
translations.idiomatic: That year on the first day of mid-autumn there was a solar eclipse; the Western scholar Adam Schall's calculation matched closely, while the Great Unity and Muslim methods were both off in timing.

sentences.zh: 令修時憲，領監務。

translations.literal: He was ordered to revise the calendar and head directorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to revise the calendar and head directorate affairs.

sentences.zh: 十四年，省回回科，改其職隸秋官正，尋復舊制。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Muslim section was abolished and its duties transferred to the Autumn office director; soon the old system was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 14 the Muslim section was abolished and its duties transferred to the Autumn office director; soon the old system was restored.

sentences.zh: 十五年，定與禮部分析職掌。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year duties were fixed separately from the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 duties were fixed separately from the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，仍屬禮部。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 2 it again belonged to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 2 it again belonged to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 明年，增置天文科滿洲官五人，滿員入監自此始。

translations.literal: The next year five Manchu posts were added to the Astronomy Section; Manchu entry into the directorate began from this point.
translations.idiomatic: The next year five Manchu posts were added to the Astronomy Section; Manchu entry into the directorate began from this point.

sentences.zh: 又明年，定滿、漢監正各一人，左、右監副各二人，主簿各一人，滿、蒙五官正各二人。

translations.literal: The year after that one Manchu and one Chinese director each were fixed, two left and two right vice directors each, one chief clerk each, and two Manchu and two Mongol office directors each.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that one Manchu and one Chinese director apiece were fixed, two left and two right vice directors each, one chief clerk apiece, and two Manchu and two Mongol office directors apiece.

sentences.zh: 省回回科博士仍隸秋官正。

translations.literal: The abolished Muslim section's erudites remained subordinate to the Autumn office director.
translations.idiomatic: The abolished Muslim section's erudites remained subordinate to the Autumn office director.

sentences.zh: 置漢軍秋官正一人，春、夏、中、秋、冬五官正漢各一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese Banner Autumn office director was established; one Chinese director each for Spring, Summer, Center, Autumn, and Winter.
translations.idiomatic: One Chinese Banner Autumn office director was established, with one Chinese director apiece for Spring, Summer, Center, Autumn, and Winter.

sentences.zh: 滿洲靈台郎三人，乾隆四十七年改一人為蒙古員缺。

translations.literal: Three Manchu platform officers; in Qianlong 47 one post was changed to a Mongol slot.
translations.idiomatic: There were three Manchu platform officers; in Qianlong 47 one post was changed to a Mongol slot.

sentences.zh: 漢軍一人，漢四人。

translations.literal: One Chinese Bannerman, four Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese Banner platform officer and four Chinese platform officers.

sentences.zh: 滿洲挈壺正二人，乾隆四十七年改一人為蒙古員缺。

translations.literal: Two Manchu clepsydra directors; in Qianlong 47 one post was changed to a Mongol slot.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Manchu clepsydra directors; in Qianlong 47 one post was changed to a Mongol slot.

sentences.zh: 漢二人。

translations.literal: Two Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chinese clepsydra directors.

sentences.zh: 漢監候一人，保章正二人，正八品。

translations.literal: One Chinese observation officer, two observatory platform directors, eighth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese observation officer and two observatory platform directors of the eighth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 十四年省。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 司書二人。

translations.literal: Two record keepers.
translations.idiomatic: There were two record keepers.

sentences.zh: 十四年省一人。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year one post abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 one post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 漢軍司晨一人，漢一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese Banner dawn announcer, one Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Chinese Banner dawn announcer and one Chinese dawn announcer.

sentences.zh: 十四年省。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 滿洲博士六人，乾隆四十七年改一人為蒙古員缺。

translations.literal: Six Manchu erudites; in Qianlong 47 one post was changed to a Mongol slot.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Manchu erudites; in Qianlong 47 one post was changed to a Mongol slot.

sentences.zh: 漢軍二人，漢三十有六人。

translations.literal: Two Chinese Bannermen, thirty-six Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: There were two Chinese Banner erudites and thirty-six Chinese erudites.

sentences.zh: 尋省十四人，五年復置二人，通舊二十有四人。

translations.literal: Soon fourteen posts abolished; in the fifth year two restored; with the old quota twenty-four in all.
translations.idiomatic: Soon fourteen posts were abolished; in Kangxi 5 two were restored, for twenty-four in all with the old quota.

sentences.zh: 並定監官升轉不離本署，積勞止加升銜，著為例。

translations.literal: It was also fixed that directorate officials on promotion did not leave the office; accumulated service received only added rank title—established as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: It was also fixed that directorate officials on promotion did not leave the office; accumulated service received only added rank title—established as precedent.

sentences.zh: 先是新安衛官生楊光先請誅邪教，鐫若望職。

translations.literal: Previously Xin'an Guard student official Yang Guangxian requested execution of heterodox teaching and removal of Schall from office.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Xin'an Guard student official Yang Guangxian requested execution of heterodox teaching and removal of Schall from office.

sentences.zh: 至是以光先為監副，尋升監正，仍用回回法。

translations.literal: At this point Yang Guangxian was made vice director, soon promoted to director, still using the Muslim method.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Yang Guangxian was made vice director, soon promoted to director, still using the Muslim method.

sentences.zh: 南懷仁具疏訟冤。

translations.literal: Ferdinand Verbiest submitted a memorial pleading his case.
translations.idiomatic: Ferdinand Verbiest submitted a memorial pleading his case.

sentences.zh: 八年，復罷光先，以南懷仁充漢監正，更名監修，用西法如初。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Yang Guangxian was again dismissed; Verbiest was appointed Chinese director, renamed calendar reviser, and the Western method was used as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 Yang Guangxian was again dismissed; Verbiest was appointed Chinese director, renamed calendar reviser, and the Western method was used as before.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，實授西人戴進賢監正，去監修名。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 3 the Western scholar Ignatius Kögler was formally appointed director and the calendar reviser title was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 the Western scholar Ignatius Kögler was formally appointed director and the calendar reviser title was dropped.

sentences.zh: 八年，增置西洋監副一人。

translations.literal: In the eighth year one Western vice director was added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 one Western vice director was added.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，置漢算學助教一人，隸國子監。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 4 one Chinese mathematics instructor was established, subordinate to the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 4 one Chinese mathematics instructor was established, subordinate to the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 十年，定監副以滿、漢、西洋分用。

translations.literal: In the tenth year it was fixed that vice directors were divided among Manchu, Chinese, and Western appointees.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 10 it was fixed that vice directors were divided among Manchu, Chinese, and Western appointees.

sentences.zh: 十八年省滿、漢各一人，增西洋二人，分左、右。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year one Manchu and one Chinese post abolished; two Western posts added, divided left and right.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 one Manchu and one Chinese post were abolished; two Western posts were added, divided left and right.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，更命親王領之。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year a prince was again ordered to head it.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 44 a prince was again ordered to head it.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，仍定滿、漢監正各一人，左、右監副各二人。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 6 one Manchu and one Chinese director each were again fixed, with two left and two right vice directors each.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6 one Manchu and one Chinese director apiece were again fixed, with two left and two right vice directors each.

sentences.zh: 時西人高拱宸等或歸或沒，本監已諳西法，遂止外人入官。

translations.literal: By then Westerners such as Gao Gongchen had returned home or died; the directorate already mastered Western methods, and foreign appointment to office ceased.
translations.idiomatic: By then Westerners such as Gao Gongchen had returned home or died; the directorate already mastered Western methods, and foreign appointment to office ceased.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十一年，改國子監助教始來隸。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 31 the revised Directorate of Education instructor first came to be subordinate here.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 the revised Directorate of Education instructor first came to be subordinate here.

sentences.zh: 太醫院管理院事王大臣一人。

translations.literal: One minister managing Imperial Medical Academy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: There was one minister managing Imperial Medical Academy affairs.

sentences.zh: 特簡。

translations.literal: Specially selected.
translations.idiomatic: The post was specially selected.

sentences.zh: 院使，初制正五品。

translations.literal: Academy director: under the original system fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The academy director originally held the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升正四品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 raised to the fourth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 (1909) the rank was raised to the fourth positive.

sentences.zh: 左、右院判，初制正六品。

translations.literal: Left and right vice directors: under the original system sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right vice directors originally held the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升正五品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 raised to the fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 they were raised to the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 俱漢一人。

translations.literal: One Chinese each in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: In each case there was one Chinese official.

sentences.zh: 其屬：御醫十有三人，內兼首領□事二人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: thirteen imperial physicians, including two who also served as leading [character missing] officers.
translations.idiomatic: Among its subordinates were thirteen imperial physicians, including two who also served as leading officers (a character is missing in the source).

sentences.zh: 初制正八品。

translations.literal: Under the original system eighth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: They originally held the eighth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年升七品，給六品冠帶。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 7 raised to the seventh rank and granted sixth-rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 they were raised to the seventh rank and granted sixth-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年升正六品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 raised to the sixth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 they were raised to the sixth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 吏目二十有六人，內兼首領□事一人。

translations.literal: Twenty-six record officers, including one who also served as leading [character missing] officer.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty-six record officers, including one who also served as leading officer (a character is missing in the source).

sentences.zh: 初制八、九品各十有三人。

translations.literal: Under the original system thirteen each of the eighth and ninth ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system there were thirteen each of the eighth and ninth ranks.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，改八品為七品，九品為八品。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 the eighth rank was changed to the seventh and the ninth to the eighth.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 the eighth rank was changed to the seventh and the ninth to the eighth.

sentences.zh: 醫士二十人，內兼首領□事一人，給從九品冠帶。

translations.literal: Twenty medical officers, including one who also served as leading [character missing] officer, granted ninth subordinate rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty medical officers, including one who also served as leading officer (a character is missing in the source), granted ninth subordinate rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 醫生三十人。

translations.literal: Thirty medical students.
translations.idiomatic: There were thirty medical students.

sentences.zh: 院使、院判掌考九科之法，帥屬供醫事。

translations.literal: The academy director and vice directors managed examination of the nine specialties' methods and led subordinates in supplying medical service.
translations.idiomatic: The academy director and vice directors managed examination of the nine specialties' methods and led subordinates in supplying medical service.

sentences.zh: 御醫、吏目、醫士各專一科，曰大方脈、小方脈、傷寒科、婦人科、瘡瘍科、針灸科、眼科、咽喉科、正骨科，是為九科。

translations.literal: Imperial physicians, record officers, and medical officers each specialized in one specialty: Great Internal Medicine, Minor Internal Medicine, Cold Damage, Gynecology, Sores and Ulcers, Acupuncture and Moxibustion, Ophthalmology, Throat, and Orthopedics—these were the nine specialties.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial physicians, record officers, and medical officers each specialized in one specialty: Great Internal Medicine, Minor Internal Medicine, Cold Damage, Gynecology, Sores and Ulcers, Acupuncture and Moxibustion, Ophthalmology, Throat, and Orthopedics—these were the nine specialties.

sentences.zh: 初設十一科。

translations.literal: Initially eleven specialties were established.
translations.idiomatic: Initially eleven specialties were established.

sentences.zh: 後痘疹科歸小方脈，咽喉、口齒並為一科。

translations.literal: Later the Smallpox specialty was merged into Minor Internal Medicine, and Throat and Dentistry were combined into one specialty.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Smallpox specialty was merged into Minor Internal Medicine, and Throat and Dentistry were combined into one specialty.

sentences.zh: 掌分班侍直，給事宮中曰宮直，給事外廷曰六直。

translations.literal: They managed shift duty: service within the palace was called palace duty; service in the outer court was called sixfold duty.
translations.idiomatic: They managed shift duty: service within the palace was called palace duty; service in the outer court was called sixfold duty.

sentences.zh: 西苑壽樂房以本院官二人直宿。

translations.literal: The Western Park Longevity Music Hall had two academy officials on overnight duty.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Park Longevity Music Hall had two academy officials on overnight duty.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，置院使，左、右院判各一人，吏目三十人，十八年省二十人，康熙九年復故。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 an academy director and one left and one right vice director each were established, with thirty record officers; in the eighteenth year twenty posts abolished; in Kangxi 9 restored to the former quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 an academy director and one left and one right vice director apiece were established, with thirty record officers; in Shunzhi 18 twenty posts were abolished; in Kangxi 9 the former quota was restored.

sentences.zh: 十四年省十人，雍正元年又復。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year ten posts abolished; in Yongzheng 1 restored again.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 14 ten posts were abolished; in Yongzheng 1 they were restored again.

sentences.zh: 豫授吏目十人，十八年省。

translations.literal: Ten pre-appointed record officers; in the eighteenth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten pre-appointed record officers; they were abolished in Shunzhi 18.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年復故，三十一年又省。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 restored to the former quota; in Kangxi 31 abolished again.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 the former quota was restored; in Kangxi 31 abolished again.

sentences.zh: 御醫十人，康熙五十三年省二人。

translations.literal: Ten imperial physicians; in Kangxi 53 two posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten imperial physicians; in Kangxi 53 two posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年復故，七年增五人。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 1 restored to the former quota; in the seventh year five added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 the former quota was restored; in Yongzheng 7 five were added.

sentences.zh: 道光二十三年省二人。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 23 two posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 23 two posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 醫士二十人。

translations.literal: Twenty medical officers.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty medical officers.

sentences.zh: 十八年省二十人。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year twenty posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 twenty posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年復故，十四年省十人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 9 restored to the former quota; in the fourteenth year ten posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 the former quota was restored; in Kangxi 14 ten posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年增二十人。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 1 twenty added.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 twenty were added.

sentences.zh: 凡藥材出入隸禮部。

translations.literal: All medicinal materials receipts and disbursements were subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: All medicinal materials receipts and disbursements were subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 十六年，改歸本院。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year changed to return to this academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 it was changed to return to this academy.

sentences.zh: 十八年，生藥庫復隸禮部。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the raw medicine treasury again subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18 the raw medicine treasury was again subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，定直省歲解藥材，並折色錢糧，由戶部收儲付庫。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 3 it was fixed that provinces annually delivered medicinal materials and commuted funds and grain, received and stored by the Board of Revenue and paid to the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 it was fixed that provinces annually delivered medicinal materials and commuted funds and grain, received and stored by the Board of Revenue and paid to the treasury.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，定八品吏目十人，九品二十人。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 7 fixed at ten eighth-rank record officers and twenty ninth-rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 the quota was fixed at ten eighth-rank record officers and twenty ninth-rank.

sentences.zh: 後定各十三人。

translations.literal: Later fixed at thirteen each.
translations.idiomatic: Later the quota was fixed at thirteen each.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年，命內府大臣領院務。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 58 an Inner Court minister was ordered to head academy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 58 an Inner Court minister was ordered to head academy affairs.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，院使張仲元疏請變通舊制，特崇院使以次各官品秩。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1 Academy Director Zhang Zhongyuan memorialized requesting modification of the old system and special elevation of the academy director and subordinate officials' ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1 Academy Director Zhang Zhongyuan memorialized requesting modification of the old system and special elevation of the academy director and subordinate officials' ranks.

sentences.zh: 初制，入院肄業，考補恩糧，歷時甚久，軍營、刑獄醫士悉由院簡選。

translations.literal: Under the original system entry to the academy for study and examination for grace salary took a very long time; medical officers for military camps and prisons were all selected by the academy.
translations.idiomatic: Under the original system entry to the academy for study and examination for grace salary took a very long time; medical officers for military camps and prisons were all selected by the academy.

sentences.zh: 光緒末葉，民政部醫官，陸軍部軍醫司長，與院使、院判品秩相等。

translations.literal: In the late Guangxu period Ministry of Civil Affairs medical officers and the Army Ministry chief of the medical corps held rank equal to the academy director and vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: In the late Guangxu period Ministry of Civil Affairs medical officers and the Army Ministry chief of the medical corps held rank equal to the academy director and vice directors.

sentences.zh: 至是釐定，崇內廷體制也。

translations.literal: At this point it was clarified to honor Inner Court protocol.
translations.idiomatic: At this point ranks were clarified to honor Inner Court protocol.

sentences.zh: 又定制，院官遷轉不離本署。

translations.literal: It was also fixed by regulation that academy officials on transfer did not leave the office.
translations.idiomatic: It was also fixed by regulation that academy officials on transfer did not leave the office.

sentences.zh: 同治間，曾議吏目食俸六年，升用按察司經歷、州判。

translations.literal: During the Tongzhi period it was once proposed that after six years on salary record officers be promoted to provincial surveillance commission secretary or prefectural vice magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi period it was once proposed that after six years on salary record officers be promoted to provincial surveillance commission secretary or prefectural vice magistrate.

sentences.zh: 嗣以與素所治相剌，乃寢。

translations.literal: Later, because this conflicted with what they normally practiced, the proposal was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because this conflicted with what they normally practiced, the proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 壇廟官天壇尉，地壇尉，各八人。

translations.literal: Altar and temple officials: Temple of Heaven wardens and Temple of Earth wardens, eight each.
translations.idiomatic: Altar and temple officials included Temple of Heaven wardens and Temple of Earth wardens, eight apiece.

sentences.zh: 五品一人，六品七人。

translations.literal: One fifth rank, seven sixth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There was one fifth rank and seven sixth rank.

sentences.zh: 太廟尉十人。

translations.literal: Ten Imperial Ancestral Temple wardens.
translations.idiomatic: There were ten Imperial Ancestral Temple wardens.

sentences.zh: 四品二人，五品八人。

translations.literal: Two fourth rank, eight fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: There were two fourth rank and eight fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 社稷壇尉五人。

translations.literal: Five Altar of Soil and Grain wardens.
translations.idiomatic: There were five Altar of Soil and Grain wardens.

sentences.zh: 五品一人，六品四人，並隸太常寺。

translations.literal: One fifth rank, four sixth rank, all subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: There was one fifth rank and four sixth rank, all subordinate to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 堂子尉八人。

translations.literal: Eight Tangzi wardens.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight Tangzi wardens.

sentences.zh: 七品二人，八品六人，隸禮部。

translations.literal: Two seventh rank, six eighth rank, subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: There were two seventh rank and six eighth rank, subordinate to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 俱滿員。

translations.literal: All Manchu incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: All were Manchu incumbents.

sentences.zh: 掌管鑰，守衛直宿，朔望奉薌以行禮。

translations.literal: They managed keys, guarded and kept overnight watch, and on new and full moons presented incense to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: They managed keys, guarded and kept overnight watch, and on new and full moons presented incense to perform rites.

sentences.zh: 天壇、地壇、朝日壇、夕月壇、先農壇，各祠祭署奉祀、從七品。

translations.literal: Temple of Heaven, Temple of Earth, Altar of the Sun, Altar of the Moon, and Altar of Agriculture: each sacrifice office had a sacrifice attendant of the seventh subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Temple of Heaven, Temple of Earth, Altar of the Sun, Altar of the Moon, and Altar of Agriculture each had a sacrifice attendant of the seventh subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 祀丞，從八品。

translations.literal: Sacrifice director assistant, eighth subordinate rank.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice director assistant held the eighth subordinate rank.

sentences.zh: 俱各一人。

translations.literal: One each in all cases.
translations.idiomatic: In each case there was one.

sentences.zh: 日、月二壇祀丞後省。

translations.literal: Sacrifice director assistants for the Sun and Moon altars were later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice director assistants for the Sun and Moon altars were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 帝王廟祠祭署無專員。

translations.literal: The Imperial Temple sacrifice office had no dedicated official.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Temple sacrifice office had no dedicated official.

sentences.zh: 以漢贊禮郎、司樂內一人委充，並隸樂部。

translations.literal: One Chinese sacrifice officiant or director of music was detailed to fill the post, all subordinate to the Music Office.
translations.idiomatic: One Chinese sacrifice officiant or director of music was detailed to fill the post, all subordinate to the Music Office.

sentences.zh: 俱漢員。

translations.literal: All Chinese incumbents.
translations.idiomatic: All were Chinese incumbents.

sentences.zh: 掌典守神庫，以時巡視，督役氾埽；

translations.literal: They managed custody of the spirit treasury, inspected on schedule, and supervised dredging and sweeping;
translations.idiomatic: They managed custody of the spirit treasury, inspected on schedule, and supervised dredging and sweeping;

sentences.zh: 凡葺治牆宇、樹藝林木，並敬供厥事。

translations.literal: for all repair of walls and buildings, planting of trees, and reverent supply of their duties.
translations.idiomatic: for all repair of walls and buildings, planting of trees, and reverent performance of their duties.

sentences.zh: 四品尉以五品序升，其下以是為差。

translations.literal: Fourth-rank wardens were promoted in order from the fifth rank; lower ranks followed the same principle.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth-rank wardens were promoted in order from the fifth rank; lower ranks followed the same principle.

sentences.zh: 唯太廟尉以各壇六品尉及各部院休致郎員間次選授。

translations.literal: Only Imperial Ancestral Temple wardens were selected in rotation from sixth-rank wardens of the various altars and retired section members of ministries and courts.
translations.idiomatic: Only Imperial Ancestral Temple wardens were selected in rotation from sixth-rank wardens of the various altars and retired section members of ministries and courts.

sentences.zh: 六品等尉吏部牒八旗番送除授，奉祀以祀丞序升，祀丞以祝版生番選除授。

translations.literal: Sixth-rank and similar wardens were appointed by rotation through the Ministry of Personnel's dispatches to the Eight Banners; sacrifice attendants were promoted in order from sacrifice director assistants; sacrifice director assistants were selected in rotation from prayer-board students for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth-rank and similar wardens were appointed by rotation through the Ministry of Personnel's dispatches to the Eight Banners; sacrifice attendants were promoted in order from sacrifice director assistants; sacrifice director assistants were selected in rotation from prayer-board students for appointment.

sentences.zh: 陵寢官三陵總理事務大臣，盛京將軍兼充。

translations.literal: Mausoleum officials: minister for general management of the Three Tombs affairs, held concurrently by the Shengjing governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Among mausoleum officials, the minister for general management of the Three Tombs affairs was held concurrently by the Shengjing governor-general.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年改歸東三省總督。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 30 changed to the Three Eastern Provinces governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30 (1904) the post was transferred to the Three Eastern Provinces governor-general.

sentences.zh: 承辦事務衙門大臣，光緒三十一年，改盛京守護大臣置。

translations.literal: Minister of the affairs-handling office: in Guangxu 31 established by redesignating the Shengjing guardian minister.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of the affairs-handling office was established in Guangxu 31 (1905) by redesignating the Shengjing guardian minister.

sentences.zh: 各一人。

translations.literal: One each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one of each.

sentences.zh: 主事，委署主事，各一人。

translations.literal: One section chief and one acting section chief each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one section chief and one acting section chief apiece.

sentences.zh: 讀祝官八人。

translations.literal: Eight prayer readers.
translations.idiomatic: There were eight prayer readers.

sentences.zh: 贊禮郎十有六人。

translations.literal: Sixteen sacrifice officiants.
translations.idiomatic: There were sixteen sacrifice officiants.

sentences.zh: 四品、五品、七品官各一人，六品官四人，外郎九人。

translations.literal: One fourth-rank, one fifth-rank, and one seventh-rank official each; four sixth-rank officials; nine outer secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: There was one fourth-rank, one fifth-rank, and one seventh-rank official apiece; four sixth-rank officials; and nine outer secretaries.

sentences.zh: 舊置戶部六品官二人。

translations.literal: Previously two Board of Revenue sixth-rank officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: Previously two Board of Revenue sixth-rank officials were established.

sentences.zh: 禮部六、七品官，工部四、五、六品官，各一人。

translations.literal: One Ministry of Rites sixth- and seventh-rank official each; one Ministry of Works fourth-, fifth-, and sixth-rank official each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Ministry of Rites sixth- and seventh-rank official apiece and one Ministry of Works fourth-, fifth-, and sixth-rank official apiece.

sentences.zh: 又戶、禮、工三部外郎二十人。

translations.literal: Also twenty outer secretaries from the Boards of Revenue, Rites, and Works.
translations.idiomatic: There were also twenty outer secretaries from the Boards of Revenue, Rites, and Works.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十一年，省外郎十有一人。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 31 eleven outer secretary posts abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 eleven outer secretary posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 自讀祝以下，並改隸三陵總理事務衙門。

translations.literal: From prayer readers downward, all were changed to be subordinate to the Three Tombs general affairs office.
translations.idiomatic: From prayer readers downward, all were changed to be subordinate to the Three Tombs general affairs office.

sentences.zh: 永陵：掌關防官，四品。

translations.literal: Yongling: seal custody official, fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongling there was a seal custody official of the fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 副關防官兼內管領，正五品。

translations.literal: Deputy seal custody official concurrently inner steward, fifth positive rank.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy seal custody official concurrently serving as inner steward held the fifth positive rank.

sentences.zh: 副關防官兼尚膳正，五品。

translations.literal: Deputy seal custody official concurrently meals director, fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy seal custody official concurrently serving as meals director held the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 尚茶副，尚膳副，副內管領，並八品。

translations.literal: Deputy tea director, deputy meals director, and deputy inner steward, all eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy tea director, deputy meals director, and deputy inner steward all held the eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 各一人。

translations.literal: One each.
translations.idiomatic: There was one of each.

sentences.zh: 筆帖式二人。

translations.literal: Two clerks.
translations.idiomatic: There were two clerks.

sentences.zh: 福陵、昭陵：掌關防官各一人，副關防官各二人。

translations.literal: Fuling and Zhaoling: one seal custody official each, two deputy seal custody officials each.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuling and Zhaoling there was one seal custody official apiece and two deputy seal custody officials apiece.

sentences.zh: 五品。

translations.literal: Fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: They held the fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 尚茶正，尚膳正，並五品。

translations.literal: Tea director and meals director, both fifth rank.

translations.literal: All remaining posts were Manchu slots.

sentences.zh: 總管大臣掌督帥官兵巡防游徼，以翊衛陵寢。

translations.literal: The supervising minister commanded and led officers and soldiers in patrol and guard to protect the mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising minister commanded and led officers and soldiers in patrol and guard to protect the mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 內務府官掌奉祭祀奠享之禮，司掃除開闔。

translations.literal: Imperial Household Department officials managed sacrificial offerings and libations and oversaw sweeping and opening and closing gates.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Household Department officials managed sacrificial offerings and libations and oversaw sweeping and opening and closing gates.

sentences.zh: 禮部官掌判署文案，監視禮儀，歲供品物，以序祀事。

translations.literal: Ministry of Rites officials managed drafting and endorsement of documents, supervised ritual forms, and supplied annual offerings to order sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Rites officials managed drafting and endorsement of documents, supervised ritual forms, and supplied annual offerings to order sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 工部官掌修葺繕治，凡祭祀供厥楮幣。

translations.literal: Ministry of Works officials managed repair and maintenance and supplied paper offerings for all sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Works officials managed repair and maintenance and supplied paper offerings for all sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 順治十三年，置福陵、昭陵掌關防等官。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 13 seal custody and other officials were established for Fuling and Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 13 seal custody and other officials were established for Fuling and Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，復置各陵寢內府、禮部、工部司官。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 2 officials of the Inner Court, Ministry of Rites, and Ministry of Works were re-established for each mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 2 officials of the Inner Court, Ministry of Rites, and Ministry of Works were re-established for each mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十一年，改盛京戶、禮、工三部陵寢官隸總理三陵事務衙門。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 31 mausoleum officials of the Shengjing Boards of Revenue, Rites, and Works were changed to be subordinate to the Three Tombs general affairs office.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31 (1905) mausoleum officials of the Shengjing Boards of Revenue, Rites, and Works were changed to be subordinate to the Three Tombs general affairs office.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，陵寢郎、員、主各缺並改歸內務府，帶禮部、工部銜如故。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 3 all mausoleum director, vice director, and section chief posts were changed to the Imperial Household Department, retaining Ministry of Rites and Ministry of Works concurrent rank as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 (1911) all mausoleum director, vice director, and section chief posts were transferred to the Imperial Household Department, retaining Ministry of Rites and Ministry of Works concurrent rank as before.
